zh.tag: 浏览器里的实时全球态势感知模拟器
zh.what: 这是一个在浏览器中运行的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的。它在一个逼真的3D地球上实时展示飞机、船舶、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头等公开信号，并支持语音控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的Web应用源码，包括3D地球渲染、实时数据图层、语音控制AI代理、以及清晰的标注（如模拟与实时区分）。
zh.stack: 主要使用JavaScript，可能涉及Three.js或类似3D库、WebSocket实时数据、语音识别API等。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending日榜排名第一，今日新增近2000星，因其独特的'真实数据间谍卫星'概念和病毒式传播的YouTube系列而迅速走红。
uses: 对开源情报、地理空间数据可视化感兴趣的开发者或研究者。
希望体验实时全球动态（航班、船舶、卫星等）的科技爱好者。
教育场景中用于演示实时数据源和3D可视化技术。

en.tag: A real-time global situational awareness simulator in your browser
en.what: A spy-satellite simulator in your browser with real data. It visualizes live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras on a photorealistic 3D globe, with hands-free voice control.
en.content: The repo contains the full web app source code, including 3D globe rendering, live data layers, a voice-controlled AI agent, and clear labeling of simulated vs. live feeds.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely using Three.js or similar 3D libraries, WebSocket for real-time data, and speech recognition APIs.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending daily with ~2,000 stars added today, it went viral due to its unique 'real-data spy satellite' concept and the popular YouTube series behind it.
uses: Developers or researchers interested in open-source intelligence and geospatial data visualization.
Tech enthusiasts who want to experience real-time global dynamics (flights, ships, satellites, etc.).
Educational settings for demonstrating real-time data sources and 3D visualization techniques.

zh.tag: 注重隐私的 Twitter 替代前端
zh.what: Nitter 是一个免费开源的 Twitter 替代前端，专注于隐私和性能。它无需 JavaScript 和广告，所有请求通过后端，防止 Twitter 追踪用户的 IP 或浏览器指纹。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Nim 编写的 Nitter 源码，提供 RSS 订阅、主题、移动端支持等功能，并带有社区维护的实例列表和浏览器扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Nim 语言，利用 Twitter 非官方 API，无需开发者账户。
zh.hot: 在 X Corp. 发出停止函后，项目热度飙升，今日新增 71 星，总星数达 13921，位居日榜第二。
uses: 注重隐私的用户，希望在不被追踪的情况下浏览 Twitter。
开发者或研究者，需要轻量级、无 JavaScript 的 Twitter 数据访问方式。
希望自建实例以完全掌控数据流的个人或组织。

en.tag: Privacy-focused alternative Twitter front-end
en.what: Nitter is a free and open-source alternative Twitter front-end focused on privacy and performance. It works without JavaScript and ads, routes all requests through the backend, and prevents Twitter from tracking your IP or browser fingerprint.
en.content: The repository contains the Nim source code for Nitter, offering features like RSS feeds, themes, and mobile support, along with community-maintained instance lists and browser extensions.
en.stack: Primarily written in Nim, leveraging Twitter's unofficial API without requiring a developer account.
en.hot: After receiving cease and desist letters from X Corp., the project gained significant attention, adding 71 stars today and reaching 13,921 total, ranking second on the daily trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to browse Twitter without being tracked.
Developers or researchers needing a lightweight, JavaScript-free way to access Twitter data.
Individuals or organizations wanting to self-host an instance for full control over data flow.

zh.tag: GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库
zh.what: 这是一个为 GPT-Image2 图像生成模型打造的提示词工程资源库，包含 500+ 逆向工程案例和 20+ 工业级模板，将提示词视为代码进行管理和复用。项目提供可视化网站用于浏览和复制提示词，并持续更新。
zh.content: 仓库包含数据目录（案例图片与提示词）、源码（网站前端）、模板库、技能提炼文档，以及多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主要基于 JavaScript，可能使用前端框架（如 React/Vue）构建可视化网站，依赖 GitHub Pages 或类似服务部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 500+ 逆向工程案例和 20+ 工业级模板，为 GPT-Image2 用户提供高质量提示词参考，今日新增 409 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: AI 图像生成爱好者：快速获取高质量提示词，提升生成效果。
提示词工程师：学习逆向工程案例，提炼可复用的技能。
产品团队：将提示词作为代码管理，实现工业化生成流程。

en.tag: Industrial prompt engine & template library for GPT-Image2
en.what: This is a prompt engineering resource library for the GPT-Image2 image generation model, featuring 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, treating prompts as code for management and reuse. It provides a visual website for browsing and copying prompts, with continuous updates.
en.content: The repository contains data directories (case images and prompts), source code (website frontend), template library, skill extraction docs, and multilingual README.
en.stack: Primarily based on JavaScript, likely using a frontend framework (e.g., React/Vue) for the visual website, deployed via GitHub Pages or similar.
en.hot: With 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, it offers high-quality prompt references for GPT-Image2 users, gaining 409 stars today and trending on GitHub.
uses: AI image generation enthusiasts: quickly obtain high-quality prompts to improve output.
Prompt engineers: learn from reverse-engineered cases and extract reusable skills.
Product teams: manage prompts as code for industrial generation workflows.

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: 让 AI 编码代理写出现代 Go 代码的官方指南
zh.what: 这是一个由 JetBrains 维护的指南仓库，旨在解决 AI 编码代理生成过时 Go 代码的问题。它提供了一套规则，让代理能根据项目的 Go 版本使用最新的语言特性和标准库，例如用 max(a,b) 代替 if-else，用 slices.Contains 代替手写循环。
zh.content: 仓库包含一份核心指南文件（plugin/skills/use-modern-go/SKILL.md），以及用于 Junie、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等工具的集成插件和 CLI。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Go 语言，利用 Go 工具链和 go.mod 版本检测，通过 CLI 安装到本地缓存，不修改项目。
zh.hot: 今日新增 300 星，总星数达 2199，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5。因为 AI 编程助手普遍生成过时 Go 代码，这个官方指南直击痛点，且由 JetBrains 背书，迅速获得开发者关注。
uses: 使用 AI 编码代理（如 Junie、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor）编写 Go 代码的开发者，希望生成更现代、更简洁的代码。
Go 项目维护者，希望统一团队代码风格，减少后续重构工作。
对 Go 新特性感兴趣的学习者，可以通过指南了解 Go 1.0 到 1.27 的实用特性。

en.tag: Official guidelines to help AI coding agents write modern Go code
en.what: This is a repository maintained by JetBrains that provides guidelines to help AI coding agents write modern Go code. It addresses the problem of agents generating outdated Go by giving them rules to use the latest language features and standard library based on the project's Go version, such as using max(a,b) instead of if-else, and slices.Contains instead of manual loops.
en.content: The repository contains a core guideline file (plugin/skills/use-modern-go/SKILL.md), plus integrations and a CLI for tools like Junie, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
en.stack: Primarily based on Go, leveraging the Go toolchain and go.mod version detection, installed via CLI into a local cache without modifying the project.
en.hot: Gained 300 stars today, reaching 2199 total, and ranked #5 on GitHub Trending daily. It addresses the pain point of AI assistants generating outdated Go code, backed by JetBrains, quickly gaining attention.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents (like Junie, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to write Go code, who want more modern and concise output.
Maintainers of Go projects who want to standardize code style and reduce future refactoring.
Learners interested in new Go features, as the guidelines cover useful features from Go 1.0 to 1.27.

zh.tag: Claude Code 官方插件市场，高质量插件目录
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 官方维护的 Claude Code 插件目录，收录了内部开发的高质量插件以及经过审核的第三方插件。用户可以通过 Claude Code 的插件系统直接安装这些插件，扩展 Claude Code 的功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 /plugins 目录（Anthropic 内部插件）和 /external_plugins 目录（第三方插件），每个插件遵循标准结构，包含 plugin.json、可选命令、代理、技能和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，插件基于 Claude Code 插件系统，支持 MCP 服务器配置、斜杠命令、代理和技能定义。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方插件市场，上线即受关注，3.4 万 star 显示开发者对 Claude Code 生态的高度热情。
uses: Claude Code 用户：发现并安装官方或社区插件，扩展编码助手功能。
插件开发者：参考内部插件示例，提交高质量第三方插件进入官方市场。
团队管理者：通过标准插件结构统一管理团队的工具链和自动化流程。

en.tag: Official Anthropic-managed marketplace for high-quality Claude Code plugins
en.what: This is the official Anthropic-managed directory of high-quality plugins for Claude Code, featuring both internally developed plugins and vetted third-party plugins. Users can install these plugins directly via Claude Code's plugin system to extend its functionality.
en.content: The repository contains /plugins (internal plugins) and /external_plugins (third-party plugins), each following a standard structure with plugin.json, optional commands, agents, skills, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily Python, plugins built on Claude Code's plugin system, supporting MCP server configs, slash commands, agents, and skill definitions.
en.hot: As the official Anthropic plugin marketplace, it gained immediate attention, with 34k stars reflecting high developer enthusiasm for the Claude Code ecosystem.
uses: Claude Code users: discover and install official or community plugins to extend the coding assistant.
Plugin developers: reference internal examples and submit high-quality third-party plugins to the official marketplace.
Team managers: standardize toolchains and automation workflows via the standard plugin structure.

zh.tag: 把任意 AI 代理变成科学家的技能库，覆盖生物、化学、医学等 163 个技能
zh.what: 这是一个开源的科学 Agent 技能库，提供 163 个即用型技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物学、化学、医学和药物发现。它兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理，并遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准，让任何 AI 代理都能执行科学任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、测试用例、文档和示例，以及一个可选的本地 AI 协同科学家工具 K-Dense BYOK。技能以标准格式组织，便于集成和扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Agent Skills 标准，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3.47 万星标和 17.5 万科学家用户，它填补了 AI 代理在科学领域应用的空白，成为最受欢迎的科学技能库。
uses: 科研人员：快速让 AI 代理执行文献分析、实验设计等任务。
开发者：为 AI 代理集成科学技能，构建垂直领域应用。
教育者：在教学中使用 AI 辅助科学探索，提升学生参与度。

en.tag: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist with 163 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases.
en.what: An open-source library of scientific Agent Skills, offering 163 ready-to-use skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, following the open Agent Skills standard, enabling any agent to perform scientific tasks.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions, tests, documentation, examples, and an optional local AI co-scientist tool K-Dense BYOK. Skills are organized in a standard format for easy integration and extension.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, relying on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 34.7k stars and 175k+ scientist users, it fills a gap in AI agent applications for science, becoming the most popular scientific skills library.
uses: Researchers: quickly enable AI agents to perform literature analysis, experiment design, etc.
Developers: integrate scientific skills into AI agents to build domain-specific applications.
Educators: use AI-assisted scientific exploration in teaching to boost student engagement.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理像最懒的高级工程师一样写最少代码
zh.what: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 库/技能包，注入到 AI 代理中，使其倾向于生成极简代码，避免过度工程。它通过内置的“懒人”提示和规则，让代理在实现功能时优先使用浏览器原生能力或现有依赖，从而大幅减少代码量、成本和延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、CLI 工具、基准测试脚本和文档。核心是注入到代理的提示词和规则集，支持 20 多种代理；基准测试展示了在真实仓库上的代码量减少（平均 54%，最高 94%）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，通过 npm 分发，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）。依赖较少，核心是提示词工程。
zh.hot: 11 万星且日增近千，因为直击 AI 编程痛点：过度工程。它用幽默的“懒人”形象，承诺减少代码量、成本和延迟，且保持安全，引发开发者共鸣。
uses: AI 编程工具使用者：希望减少 AI 生成的冗余代码，提升代码质量。
团队技术负责人：想降低维护成本，让 AI 代理产出更简洁的代码。
对提示工程感兴趣者：学习如何通过提示词约束 AI 行为。

en.tag: Makes your AI agent write minimal code like a lazy senior dev
en.what: Ponytail is a JavaScript library/skill pack that injects a 'lazy senior dev' mindset into AI agents, pushing them to write minimal code and avoid over-engineering. It uses built-in prompts and rules to make agents prefer native browser features or existing dependencies, cutting code volume, cost, and latency.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, CLI tools, benchmark scripts, and docs. The core is a set of prompts and rules injected into agents, supporting 20+ agents; benchmarks show code reduction (mean 54%, up to 94%) on real repos.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, distributed via npm, compatible with 20+ AI agents (e.g., Claude Code). Minimal dependencies, core is prompt engineering.
en.hot: 111k stars with ~1k daily, because it hits the pain point of AI coding: over-engineering. With a humorous 'lazy dev' persona, it promises less code, lower cost, and faster execution while staying safe, resonating with developers.
uses: AI coding tool users: want to reduce redundant code and improve code quality.
Tech leads: aim to lower maintenance costs and get cleaner code from AI agents.
Prompt engineering enthusiasts: learn how to constrain AI behavior via prompts.

zh.tag: 开源智能体视频制作系统，把AI编程助手变成视频工作室
zh.what: OpenMontage 是全球首个开源的智能体视频制作系统，提供12条生产流水线、100多个工具和700多个智能体技能与制作知识文件。它能让你的AI编程助手（如Claude、ChatGPT）直接生成完整视频，从脚本到成片全流程自动化。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心Python代码、12条生产流水线（pipelines）、100多个工具模块、700多个智能体技能和制作知识文件，以及文档、赞助商信息和吉祥物素材。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python，依赖AI编程助手（如Claude、ChatGPT）作为智能体后端，集成多种视频处理和生成工具。
zh.hot: 凭借5.2万星标和日增1292星的火爆势头，OpenMontage 登上GitHub Trending日榜第9名，因其首创的智能体视频制作概念和强大的自动化能力吸引了大量关注。
uses: 内容创作者：快速生成视频脚本、分镜和成片，提升制作效率
开发者：将AI编程助手扩展为视频制作工具，实现自动化工作流
视频制作团队：利用12条流水线覆盖不同视频类型，降低制作门槛

en.tag: Open-source agentic video production system turning AI coding assistants into a full video studio
en.what: OpenMontage is the world's first open-source, agentic video production system with 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, and 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. It turns your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio, automating the entire workflow from script to final video.
en.content: The repository contains core Python code, 12 production pipelines, 100+ tool modules, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files, along with documentation, sponsor info, and mascot assets.
en.stack: Primarily Python, leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) as agent backends, integrating various video processing and generation tools.
en.hot: With 52.5k stars and 1,292 new stars today, OpenMontage ranks #9 on GitHub Trending daily, drawing massive attention for its pioneering agentic video production concept and powerful automation capabilities.
uses: Content creators: quickly generate scripts, storyboards, and final videos to boost production efficiency
Developers: extend AI coding assistants into video production tools for automated workflows
Video production teams: leverage 12 pipelines covering various video types to lower production barriers

zh.tag: 从零到精通的 AI 工程实战课程
zh.what: 这是一个免费开源的 AI 工程学习课程，包含 511 节课、20 个阶段，约 329 小时的学习内容。课程强调实践，每一课都会产出可复用的成果，如提示词、技能、代理或 MCP 服务器。
zh.content: 仓库包含课程内容、多语言翻译（i18n）、网站源码（site/）以及构建脚本（build.js）。课程覆盖 Python、TypeScript、Rust 和 Julia 等多种语言。

zh.hot: 该仓库因提供系统化、实战导向的 AI 学习路径而迅速走红，48k+ 星标，30 天内 15 万读者，反映了市场对实用 AI 技能的巨大需求。
uses: 希望系统学习 AI 工程、从零构建项目的开发者
需要实战经验以提升职场竞争力的学生和转行者
教育者或培训师，可将其作为课程大纲或教学资源

en.tag: Hands-on AI engineering curriculum from scratch to mastery
en.what: A free, open-source AI engineering curriculum with 511 lessons, 20 phases, and ~329 hours of content. It emphasizes hands-on learning, where each lesson produces a reusable artifact like a prompt, skill, agent, or MCP server.
en.content: The repository contains curriculum content, i18n translations, website source (site/), and build scripts (build.js). The curriculum covers multiple languages including Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with TypeScript, Rust, and Julia. The website likely uses a static site generator with build.js.
en.hot: This repo went viral for its systematic, hands-on AI learning path, amassing 48k+ stars and 150k readers in 30 days, reflecting huge demand for practical AI skills.
uses: Developers who want to systematically learn AI engineering and build projects from scratch
Students and career switchers needing hands-on experience to boost employability
Educators or trainers who can use it as a curriculum outline or teaching resource

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程代理打造的生产级技能合集
zh.what: garden-skills 是一个精选的 Agent Skills 集合，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等 AI 编程代理设计。它提供多种技能，如网页视频演示、网页设计、图像生成和文章美化，帮助代理更高效地完成特定任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能模块，每个技能都有独立的目录和说明文档，并提供了多种安装方式，如 CLI、插件市场、ZIP 下载等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 CSS 和 Markdown，遵循 SKILL.md 规范，支持通过 npx 安装，兼容主流 AI 编程代理。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程代理的流行，开发者需要现成的技能库来扩展代理能力，该仓库提供了高质量、生产可用的技能，因此迅速获得 1 万+ star。
uses: 使用 Claude Code 或 Cursor 的开发者，希望快速集成网页设计、图像生成等技能。
需要将任意内容转化为美观文章的内容创作者或开发者。
想要学习 Agent Skills 规范并贡献自定义技能的开发者。

en.tag: Production-ready Agent Skills collection for AI coding agents
en.what: garden-skills is a curated collection of Agent Skills designed for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. It offers various skills such as web video presentation, web design, image generation, and article beautification to help agents perform specific tasks more efficiently.
en.content: The repository contains multiple skill modules, each with its own directory and documentation, and offers various installation methods including CLI, plugin marketplace, ZIP download, and more.
en.stack: Primarily uses CSS and Markdown, follows the SKILL.md spec, supports installation via npx, and is compatible with major AI coding agents.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers need ready-made skill libraries to extend agent capabilities. This repo offers high-quality, production-ready skills, quickly gaining over 10k stars.
uses: Developers using Claude Code or Cursor who want to quickly integrate skills like web design and image generation.
Content creators or developers who need to transform any source into beautiful articles.
Developers who want to learn the Agent Skills spec and contribute custom skills.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理提供跨会话持久记忆与上下文压缩注入
zh.what: claude-mem 是一个为 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等）设计的持久记忆系统。它捕获代理在会话中的所有操作，利用 AI 进行压缩，并在未来的会话中注入相关上下文，从而实现跨会话的连续性和个性化。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心记忆压缩引擎、与多种代理的集成适配器、CLI 工具、文档（支持多语言）以及配置示例。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js（>=20），依赖 AI 模型进行压缩和检索，支持多种代理平台。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理的普及，跨会话记忆成为关键需求，该项目以 91.7k 星标迅速走红，本周新增 794 星，位列 JavaScript 周榜第 12。
uses: 开发者使用 Claude Code 等代理进行长期项目开发，希望代理记住项目上下文和决策。
团队希望共享代理记忆，实现知识沉淀和协作效率提升。
需要为代理定制记忆策略，如压缩频率、上下文注入方式的高级用户。

en.tag: Persistent memory compression system for AI agents, injecting relevant context across sessions
en.what: claude-mem is a persistent memory system for AI agents like Claude Code and Codex. It captures everything an agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions, enabling continuity and personalization across sessions.
en.content: The repository includes the core memory compression engine, integration adapters for various agents, CLI tools, documentation (multi-language), and configuration examples.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js (>=20), relies on AI models for compression and retrieval, supports multiple agent platforms.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents, cross-session memory is a critical need; the project gained 91.7k stars, +794 this week, ranking #12 on the JavaScript weekly trending list.
uses: Developers using Claude Code or similar agents for long-term projects, wanting the agent to remember project context and decisions.
Teams looking to share agent memory for knowledge accumulation and improved collaboration efficiency.
Advanced users who want to customize memory strategies, such as compression frequency and context injection methods.

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 的 C++ 测试框架，用于编写和运行单元测试。它支持自动测试发现、丰富的断言、死亡测试、参数化测试等，并集成了 GoogleMock 用于模拟对象。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的源码、文档、示例以及构建配置。文档托管在 GitHub Pages 上，提供用户指南和入门教程。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，要求 C++17 或更高版本（1.18.x 分支）。计划依赖 Abseil 库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方测试框架，拥有近 3.9 万 Star，是 C++ 社区的事实标准，持续维护并发布新版本。
uses: C++ 开发者编写单元测试，确保代码质量
需要模拟对象进行依赖隔离的测试场景
在 CI/CD 流程中集成自动化测试
学习 xUnit 测试框架设计的最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework for writing and running unit tests. It supports automatic test discovery, rich assertions, death tests, parameterized tests, and integrates GoogleMock for mocking.
en.content: The repository contains source code, documentation, examples, and build configuration for GoogleTest and GoogleMock. Docs are hosted on GitHub Pages with user guide and primer.
en.stack: Built on C++, requires C++17 or later (1.18.x branch). Plans to depend on Abseil.
en.hot: As Google's official testing framework, it has nearly 39k stars, is the de facto standard in C++ community, and is actively maintained with new releases.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests to ensure code quality
Scenarios requiring mocking objects for dependency isolation
Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Learning best practices of xUnit test framework design

zh.tag: 用 Claude Code 打造自组织 AI 第二大脑，连接 Obsidian 知识图谱
zh.what: claude-obsidian 是一个本地优先的知识管理系统，集成 Claude Code 和 Obsidian。它自动捕获、链接和整理你的笔记，构建一个互联的知识图谱，所有内容都是纯 Markdown，完全由你掌控。它基于 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式，旨在成为 Notion 的开源替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含 15 个 Agent Skills（如捕获、检索、维护、可视化映射）、工作流文档、安装指南、以及用于构建知识循环的脚本和配置。输出是普通的 Markdown 和 JSON 文件，可在 Obsidian 中直接使用。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Python，依赖 Claude Code 和 Agent Skills 框架，兼容 Obsidian 插件。使用内容寻址存储来保留源文件，并利用 Markdown 和 JSON 进行数据组织。
zh.hot: 凭借 11.8k 星标和日增 310 星，它抓住了 AI 笔记和个人知识管理的热潮，提供了开源、本地优先的 Notion 替代方案，并基于 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式，受到开发者社区追捧。
uses: 知识工作者：希望用 AI 自动整理笔记、构建个人知识库，同时保持数据完全本地可控。
开发者：想基于 Claude Code 和 Agent Skills 构建自定义 AI 工作流，或扩展 Obsidian 功能。
研究人员：需要从大量文献中提取、链接和引用信息，形成可追溯的知识网络。
Notion 用户：寻求开源、本地优先的替代方案，避免云锁定和隐私问题。

en.tag: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code, turning sources into a connected knowledge graph
en.what: claude-obsidian is a local-first knowledge system that integrates Claude Code and Obsidian. It automatically captures, links, and organizes your notes into a connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown, fully owned by you. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern, it serves as an open-source alternative to Notion.
en.content: The repo includes 15 Agent Skills (capture, retrieval, maintenance, visual mapping), workflow docs, installation guides, and scripts/configs for the compounding knowledge loop. Output is plain Markdown and JSON files, usable directly in Obsidian.
en.stack: Primarily Python, built on Claude Code and Agent Skills framework, compatible with Obsidian plugins. Uses content-addressed storage for source preservation and Markdown/JSON for data organization.
en.hot: With 11.8k stars and +310 today, it taps into the AI note-taking and PKM trend, offering an open-source, local-first Notion alternative based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern, gaining rapid traction.
uses: Knowledge workers who want AI to auto-organize notes and build a personal knowledge base while keeping data fully local and controllable.
Developers looking to build custom AI workflows with Claude Code and Agent Skills, or extend Obsidian's capabilities.
Researchers needing to extract, link, and cite information from large corpora into a traceable knowledge network.
Notion users seeking an open-source, local-first alternative to avoid cloud lock-in and privacy concerns.

zh.tag: 开源基础模型研发框架，覆盖数据到评估全流程
zh.what: Marin 是一个开源框架，用于研究和开发基础模型，特别是大型语言模型。它涵盖了数据整理、转换、过滤、分词、预训练、后训练和评估等完整流程。Marin 强调开放开发，记录所有过程、实验和决策，包括失败的实验。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架代码、实验配置、数据处理流水线（如 Nemotron-CC 等混合数据集的确定性复现）、以及 Delphi 缩放套件（从 3e18 到 1e23 FLOPs 的缩放配方、训练套件和缩放定律）。还提供了 Hugging Face 上的检查点。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Google TPU Research Cloud 进行大规模训练，并利用 Hugging Face 发布模型检查点。
zh.hot: 今日新增 214 stars，总 stars 达 1745，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（Python）第 13 名。其开放开发理念和前沿的 MoE 模型预训练吸引关注。
uses: 研究人员和工程师，用于训练和评估大型语言模型，特别是混合专家模型。
对开放开发感兴趣的人，希望了解基础模型构建的全过程知识。
需要可复现的数据处理流水线和缩放定律的团队，用于预测更大模型的性能。

en.tag: Open-source framework for foundation model R&D, from data to evaluation
en.what: Marin is an open-source framework for researching and developing foundation models, especially large language models. It covers the entire pipeline including data curation, transformation, filtering, tokenization, pretraining, posttraining, and evaluation. Marin emphasizes open development, documenting all processes, experiments, and decisions, including failed experiments.
en.content: The repository contains core framework code, experiment configurations, data processing pipelines (e.g., deterministic reproduction of mixtures from Nemotron-CC, StarCoderData, ProofPile 2), and the Delphi scaling suite (scaling recipe from 3e18 to 1e23 FLOPs, training suite, and scaling law). Checkpoints are available on Hugging Face.
en.stack: Primarily Python, relies on Google TPU Research Cloud for large-scale training, and uses Hugging Face for releasing model checkpoints.
en.hot: Gained 214 stars today, reaching 1745 total, ranking #13 on GitHub Trending (Python). Its open development philosophy and frontier MoE pretraining attract attention.
uses: Researchers and engineers training and evaluating large language models, especially mixture-of-experts models.
Those interested in open development, seeking full process knowledge of building foundation models.
Teams needing reproducible data pipelines and scaling laws to predict larger model performance.

zh.tag: 精选 1000+ 生产级 Claude Skills 与插件的资源大全
zh.what: 这是一个精心整理的仓库，收录了 1000 多个可直接用于生产的 Claude Skills 和插件，帮助用户自定义 Claude AI 工作流。它覆盖了 Claude.ai、Claude Code 以及 Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等编码代理，并提供 MCP 网关和连接应用插件，让 Claude 能执行真实操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含分类整理的 Skills 列表、快速上手教程、连接应用插件（connect-apps）以及指向 Composio MCP 网关的链接，方便用户集成 1000+ 应用。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python，依赖 Claude 生态和 Composio 的 MCP 网关，支持多种 CLI 工具和插件系统。
zh.hot: 凭借 73.6k 的 star 数和每日新增 130 星，它成为开发者寻找 Claude 扩展的首选资源，因为 Claude Skills 需求激增且该列表持续更新。
uses: 开发者想要快速为 Claude 添加实用技能，如文档处理、自动化任务等。
团队需要将 Claude 接入 Slack、Gmail 等 1000+ 应用，实现真实操作。
AI 爱好者探索 Claude Code 和编码代理的扩展生态，寻找灵感。

en.tag: A curated list of 1000+ production-ready Claude Skills and plugins
en.what: This repository is a meticulously curated collection of 1000+ production-ready Claude Skills and plugins for customizing Claude AI workflows. It covers Claude.ai, Claude Code, and coding agents like Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI, and offers an MCP gateway and app-connect plugins to enable real-world actions.
en.content: The repo includes a categorized list of skills, quickstart guides, a connect-apps plugin, and links to Composio's MCP Gateway for integrating 1000+ apps.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, leveraging the Claude ecosystem and Composio's MCP Gateway, compatible with various CLI tools and plugin systems.
en.hot: With 73.6k stars and 130 new stars daily, it's a go-to resource for developers seeking Claude extensions, driven by surging demand for Claude Skills and its active maintenance.
uses: Developers seeking to quickly add practical skills to Claude, such as document processing and automation.
Teams needing to connect Claude to 1000+ apps like Slack and Gmail for real actions.
AI enthusiasts exploring the extension ecosystem of Claude Code and coding agents for inspiration.

zh.tag: GitHub Actions 官方检出仓库动作，安全与性能持续升级
zh.what: 这是 GitHub Actions 官方的 checkout 动作，用于在 workflow 中将仓库代码检出到运行环境中。它支持自定义 fetch 深度、持久化认证凭据，并处理各种触发事件对应的提交。
zh.content: 仓库包含动作的源代码、测试、文档和版本标签，主要文件为 action.yml、src/ 目录及 README。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用 @actions/core、@actions/github 等官方包，并已迁移到 ESM 模块。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub Actions 最基础的动作之一，几乎每个 workflow 都会用到，star 数持续增长，今日新增 8 星。
uses: CI/CD 流水线中自动检出代码，适用于任何使用 GitHub Actions 的项目
需要安全处理 pull_request_target 或 workflow_run 触发器的开发者
希望控制检出深度或持久化凭据的自动化脚本编写者

en.tag: Official GitHub Action to checkout a repo, with security and performance upgrades
en.what: It is the official checkout action for GitHub Actions, used to check out repository code into the runner environment. It supports custom fetch depth, persists credentials, and handles the correct commit for various trigger events.
en.content: The repo contains the action's source code, tests, docs, and version tags, with key files like action.yml, src/, and README.
en.stack: Developed in TypeScript, using official packages like @actions/core and @actions/github, and migrated to ESM.
en.hot: As one of the most fundamental actions, it is used in nearly every workflow, with steady star growth, +8 today.
uses: Automatically check out code in CI/CD pipelines, for any project using GitHub Actions
Developers needing to safely handle pull_request_target or workflow_run triggers
Automation scripters who want to control fetch depth or persist credentials

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 多智能体 LLM 金融交易框架
zh.what: TradingAgents 是一个基于多智能体 LLM 的金融交易框架，模拟真实交易公司中的角色（如研究分析师、交易员、风控经理等）协作决策。它通过多阶段工作流（研究、辩论、交易、风控）生成交易建议，并支持多种数据源和模型提供商。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、示例配置、文档和测试，以及用于数据获取和模型调用的模块。还提供 Docker 支持、环境变量配置和多种数据供应商集成（如 FRED、Polymarket）。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 LangChain、OpenAI 等 LLM 库，支持多种模型提供商（如 OpenAI、Claude、NVIDIA、Groq 等），并集成数据 API（如 Alpha Vantage、FRED）。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上获得超过 10 万星标，今日新增 218 星，位列日榜第五。其创新的多智能体协作方式和对金融交易的实际应用吸引了大量关注，且持续更新（v0.3.1 刚发布）。
uses: 量化交易研究员：利用多智能体框架模拟交易团队，辅助策略研究和回测。
AI 开发者：学习如何构建复杂的多智能体 LLM 系统，并集成多种数据源和模型。
金融科技爱好者：探索 LLM 在金融决策中的应用，进行实验和二次开发。

en.tag: Multi-agent LLM framework for financial trading
en.what: TradingAgents is a multi-agent LLM framework for financial trading that simulates roles in a real trading firm (e.g., research analysts, traders, risk managers) to collaborate on decisions. It generates trading recommendations through a multi-stage workflow (research, debate, trading, risk management) and supports various data sources and model providers.
en.content: The repo contains full framework code, example configs, documentation, and tests, along with modules for data fetching and model calls. It also offers Docker support, environment variable configuration, and integrations with multiple data vendors (e.g., FRED, Polymarket).
en.stack: Built on Python, leveraging LangChain and OpenAI libraries, supporting multiple model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, NVIDIA, Groq) and integrating data APIs (e.g., Alpha Vantage, FRED).
en.hot: With over 100k stars and 218 new stars today, ranking #5 on the daily trending list, its innovative multi-agent collaboration and practical application in financial trading have attracted huge attention, plus continuous updates (v0.3.1 just released).
uses: Quant researchers: simulate a trading team to assist strategy research and backtesting.
AI developers: learn to build complex multi-agent LLM systems with multiple data sources and models.
Fintech enthusiasts: explore LLM applications in financial decision-making for experiments and further development.

zh.tag: 统一多AI提供商的轻量Python库，支持智能体开发
zh.what: aisuite 是一个轻量级 Python 库，为多个生成式 AI 提供商提供统一的聊天补全 API，并在此基础上提供智能体 API，支持工具调用和工具包。它旨在简化与不同 LLM 提供商的交互，让开发者可以轻松切换模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库代码，分为两层：统一的 Chat Completions API 和 Agents API（含工具、工具包和 MCP 支持）。此外，还包含一个名为 OpenWorker 的桌面 AI 助手的归档快照，其开发已移至独立仓库。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖各提供商 SDK（如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等），支持 Ollama 本地模型。代码风格遵循 Black 格式化。
zh.hot: 由 Andrew Ng 创建，star 数达 16k，因其简化多 AI 提供商集成的理念而广受关注。近期热度部分来自 OpenWorker 的发布，展示了其智能体能力。
uses: 开发者需要统一接口快速接入多个 LLM 提供商，减少集成成本。
构建智能体应用，需要工具调用、多轮对话和 MCP 支持的场景。
希望本地运行模型（如 Ollama）并与云端模型无缝切换的开发者。

en.tag: Lightweight Python library unifying multiple AI providers with agent support
en.what: aisuite is a lightweight Python library that provides a unified Chat Completions API across multiple generative AI providers, and an Agents API with tools and toolkits on top. It simplifies interactions with different LLM providers, allowing developers to switch models easily.
en.content: The repository contains the core library code, structured in two layers: a unified Chat Completions API and an Agents API with tools, toolkits, and MCP support. It also includes an archived snapshot of OpenWorker, a desktop AI coworker, whose development has moved to a separate repository.
en.stack: Built with Python, depends on provider SDKs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), supports local models via Ollama. Code style follows Black formatting.
en.hot: Created by Andrew Ng, with 16k stars, it gains attention for simplifying multi-provider AI integration. Recent popularity is partly due to the release of OpenWorker, showcasing its agent capabilities.
uses: Developers needing a unified interface to quickly integrate multiple LLM providers, reducing integration costs.
Building agent applications requiring tool calling, multi-turn conversations, and MCP support.
Developers who want to run local models (e.g., Ollama) and seamlessly switch with cloud models.

zh.tag: Claude 技能库：动态加载指令与资源，提升专业任务表现
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 官方仓库，包含 Claude 的 Agent Skills 实现。Skills 是文件夹形式的指令、脚本和资源，Claude 可动态加载以提升特定任务的表现，涵盖创意、技术、企业工作流等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 skills 示例（创意与设计、开发与技术、企业与沟通、文档技能）、Agent Skills 规范（spec）和技能模板（template），每个技能自带 SKILL.md 文件。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python，技能以文件夹形式组织，包含 SKILL.md 元数据，可集成到 Claude Code、Claude.ai 和 API。

zh.tag: NVIDIA 官方大规模 Transformer 训练库
zh.what: Megatron-LM 是 NVIDIA 开源的用于大规模训练 Transformer 模型的 GPU 优化库，包含 Megatron-LM 和 Megatron Core 两个组件。它提供高级并行策略（TP、PP、DP、EP、CP）和混合精度支持，是训练 GPT、BERT 等大模型的基础设施。

框架开发者利用 Megatron Core 构建自定义训练流水线，集成高级并行策略
需要将 Hugging Face 模型与 Megatron 互转的工程师，使用 Megatron Bridge

en.tag: NVIDIA's GPU-optimized library for training transformers at scale

en.content: The repo contains Megatron-LM (reference examples with pre-configured training scripts) and Megatron Core (a composable library with transformer building blocks, parallelism strategies, and mixed precision support). Megatron Bridge enables checkpoint conversion between Hugging Face and Megatron.
en.stack: Built on Python and PyTorch, requires CUDA and NVIDIA GPUs, supports FP16/BF16/FP8/FP4 mixed precision, installable via uv or pip.
en.hot: As NVIDIA's official large-model training library, Megatron-LM underpins many cutting-edge models (e.g., GPT, DeepSeek). Recent DeepSeek-V4 support keeps attracting researchers and engineers.
uses: Research teams quickly set up large-scale transformer training experiments using pre-configured scripts
Framework developers build custom training pipelines with Megatron Core's advanced parallelism strategies
Engineers needing bidirectional Hugging Face ↔ Megatron checkpoint conversion via Megatron Bridge

语言学习者：利用跨语言支持，生成不同语言的语音样本。
游戏与虚拟主播：为角色或虚拟形象提供独特声音。

en.tag: Few-shot voice cloning and TTS WebUI
en.what: GPT-SoVITS is a powerful few-shot voice conversion and text-to-speech (TTS) WebUI, supporting zero-shot and few-shot voice cloning. Users can perform zero-shot TTS with just a 5-second voice sample, or fine-tune with 1 minute of training data for improved similarity and realism.
en.content: The repository includes a full WebUI, training and inference scripts, model weights, and integrated tools like voice accompaniment separation, automatic training set segmentation, multilingual ASR, plus Colab notebooks and Docker images.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.10-3.12, uses PyTorch and integrates FunASR/SenseVoice for ASR, supporting multiple languages (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese).
en.hot: The project's ability to achieve high-quality voice cloning with minimal data (1 minute) has attracted a large user base, with over 61k stars and 24 new stars today, maintaining a high position on GitHub Trending.
uses: Content creators: quickly generate personalized voiceovers for videos, podcasts, etc.
Developers: integrate TTS into applications or conduct speech synthesis research.
Language learners: use cross-lingual support to generate speech samples in different languages.
Game and VTuber: provide unique voices for characters or avatars.

zh.tag: 深度学习框架，GPU加速张量计算与动态神经网络
zh.what: PyTorch 是一个开源的 Python 深度学习框架，提供类似 NumPy 的张量计算，并支持强大的 GPU 加速。它基于 tape-based 的自动微分系统，能够动态构建和训练神经网络，广泛应用于研究和生产环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 PyTorch 的完整源代码，包括核心库（torch）、自动微分模块（torch.autograd）、JIT 编译器（torch.jit）等，以及安装脚本、Dockerfile 和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 和 C++ 编写，依赖 CUDA、ROCm 等 GPU 加速库，支持多种硬件平台。
zh.hot: PyTorch 是深度学习领域最流行的框架之一，拥有超过 10 万 star，尽管今日新增不多，但持续保持高关注度，是 AI 研究和应用的基础工具。
uses: 研究人员和开发者用于构建和训练深度学习模型，如 CNN、RNN、Transformer 等。
适合需要动态计算图和快速原型验证的机器学习项目。
用于学术研究和工业部署，支持从实验到生产的无缝过渡。

en.tag: Deep learning framework with GPU-accelerated tensors and dynamic neural networks
en.what: PyTorch is an open-source deep learning framework that provides NumPy-like tensor computation with strong GPU acceleration. It features a tape-based autograd system for dynamic neural network construction and training, widely used in research and production.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of PyTorch, including core library (torch), autograd module (torch.autograd), JIT compiler (torch.jit), along with installation scripts, Dockerfiles, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python and C++, leveraging CUDA, ROCm, and other GPU acceleration libraries, supporting multiple hardware platforms.
en.hot: PyTorch is one of the most popular deep learning frameworks with over 100k stars. Despite modest daily additions, it maintains high relevance as a foundational tool in AI research and applications.
uses: Researchers and developers building and training deep learning models such as CNNs, RNNs, and Transformers.
Ideal for machine learning projects requiring dynamic computation graphs and rapid prototyping.
Used in academic research and industrial deployment, enabling seamless transition from experimentation to production.

zh.tag: 基于 Claude Code 的 AI 求职申请框架
zh.what: 这是一个运行在你机器上的 AI 求职框架，利用 Claude Code 自动评估职位、定制简历、撰写求职信并准备面试。用户只需 Fork 仓库并填写个人资料，即可让 AI 代理完成求职流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Claude Code 工作流（/setup、/scrape、/apply、/interview），以及针对丹麦求职市场的职位搜索技能（Jobindex、Jobnet 等），但设计为可替换为本地求职网站。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Python 和 Claude Code，利用 Anthropic 的 Claude 模型进行自然语言处理。
zh.hot: 作者用该框架成功获得 AI 工程师职位，69 份申请换来 20 次面试，真实案例引发共鸣。34k+ 星标，日增 434，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第三。
uses: 求职者：自动化繁琐的申请流程，节省时间并提高效率。
开发者：学习如何构建基于 Claude Code 的 AI 代理工作流。
非丹麦用户：可修改代码以适配本地求职网站，实现定制化求职。

en.tag: AI job application framework built on Claude Code
en.what: This is an AI-powered job application framework that runs on your machine, using Claude Code to evaluate job postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, and prepare for interviews. Fork it, fill in your profile, and let the AI agent handle the job search process.
en.content: The repo contains a full Claude Code workflow (/setup, /scrape, /apply, /interview) and job portal search skills for the Danish market (Jobindex, Jobnet, etc.), but the pattern is designed to be swapped for local job boards.
en.stack: Primarily based on Python and Claude Code, leveraging Anthropic's Claude models for natural language processing.
en.hot: The author used this framework to land an AI engineer job, with 69 applications leading to 20 interviews, a real success story that resonates. With 34k+ stars and 434 daily additions, it hit #3 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Job seekers: automate tedious application processes, saving time and increasing efficiency.
Developers: learn how to build AI agent workflows on Claude Code.
Non-Danish users: modify the code to adapt to local job boards for customized job hunting.

zh.tag: 让AI代理借用你的真实浏览器，不打断工作
zh.what: BrowserSkill 是一个连接 AI 代理（如 Cursor、Claude Code 等）到你已登录浏览器的工具，通过 CLI 和浏览器扩展实现。它允许代理显式借用你已打开的标签页，完成任务后归还，不影响你的其他浏览活动。
zh.content: 仓库包含 bsk CLI/守护进程和浏览器扩展两部分，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows，以及 Chrome 和 Edge 等浏览器。提供快速安装脚本和手动安装指南，并内置人工介入机制处理验证码等步骤。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，依赖浏览器扩展 API 和命令行工具，支持多种 AI 代理框架，无特定模型绑定。
zh.hot: 因为解决了 AI 代理使用真实登录态和避免中断用户工作的痛点，上线即登 GitHub Trending 日榜，Star 数迅速增长。
uses: 使用 Cursor、Claude Code 等 AI 编程助手的开发者，希望代理能操作已登录的网页。
需要自动化处理网页任务但不想维护测试账号或影响正常浏览的用户。
对 AI 代理工具链感兴趣，希望扩展代理能力的开发者。

en.tag: Let AI agents use your real browser without interrupting your work
en.what: BrowserSkill is a tool that connects AI agents (like Cursor, Claude Code) to your logged-in browser via CLI and browser extension. It lets agents explicitly borrow tabs you already have open, return them after task completion, and leave the rest of your browsing untouched.
en.content: The repository contains the bsk CLI/daemon and a browser extension, supporting macOS, Linux, Windows, and browsers like Chrome and Edge. It provides quick install scripts and manual guides, with built-in human-in-the-loop for captchas and confirmations.
en.stack: Developed primarily in TypeScript, leveraging browser extension APIs and CLI tools, compatible with various AI agent frameworks without model lock-in.
en.hot: It addresses the pain point of AI agents using real login state without interrupting users, quickly hitting GitHub Trending daily and gaining stars rapidly.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Cursor or Claude Code who want agents to operate logged-in web pages.
Users who need web automation without maintaining test accounts or disrupting their own browsing.
Developers interested in AI agent toolchains and extending agent capabilities.

zh.tag: 代码即架构图：从代码生成实时架构图的建模语言与工具
zh.what: LikeC4 是一种用于描述软件架构的建模语言，并附带从模型生成图的工具。它受 C4 模型和 Structurizr DSL 启发，但提供更多灵活性，允许自定义符号、元素类型和嵌套层级，使架构模型完全贴合你的需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 CLI（npx likec4 start 预览）、VS Code 扩展、模板仓库、文档和 playground，支持从代码生成实时更新的架构图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，提供 npm 包、VS Code 扩展和 MCP 服务器，依赖 C4 模型和 Structurizr DSL 概念。
zh.hot: 因将架构图与代码同步、实时更新而受到关注，今日新增 19 星，总星数 5554，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 4。
uses: 软件架构师和开发者，希望从代码自动生成并维护架构图，减少手工维护成本。
技术团队需要可视化系统间依赖关系，用于文档、评审或协作。
喜欢 C4 模型但需要更高自定义能力的用户，可定义自己的符号和层级。

en.tag: Modeling language and tools to generate live architecture diagrams from code
en.what: LikeC4 is a modeling language for describing software architecture, with tools to generate diagrams from the model. Inspired by C4 Model and Structurizr DSL, it offers flexibility to customize notation, element types, and nested levels, tailoring the architecture model to your needs.
en.content: The repo includes the core CLI (npx likec4 start to preview), a VS Code extension, a template repository, docs, and a playground, enabling live architecture diagrams from code.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, offering an npm package, VS Code extension, and MCP server, leveraging C4 Model and Structurizr DSL concepts.
en.hot: It's trending for keeping architecture diagrams in sync with code, gaining 19 stars today (total 5,554) and ranking #4 on the TypeScript daily trending list.
uses: Software architects and developers who want to auto-generate and maintain architecture diagrams from code, reducing manual upkeep.
Tech teams needing to visualize dependencies between systems for documentation, reviews, or collaboration.
Users who like the C4 model but need more customization, such as defining their own notation and levels.

zh.tag: 聚合34家免费LLM提供商的统一API网关
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 是一个开源项目，将数十家免费 LLM 提供商的免费额度聚合到一个 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 端点后面。它提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥管理，让开发者无需管理多个 API 密钥即可访问大量免费模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 TypeScript 编写的 API 网关，支持 Docker 自托管、桌面应用（macOS/Windows）和 Android 应用。它提供了一个仪表板，用于监控每月 token 预算，并包含一个自动更新的模型目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，支持 Docker 部署，并提供桌面和移动端应用。依赖 OpenAI 兼容 API 标准，集成多个 LLM 提供商。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得近 2 万星标，日增 174 星。它解决了开发者对免费 LLM 资源分散、难以管理的痛点，提供了一站式解决方案。
uses: 个人开发者：快速集成多个免费 LLM，无需单独注册和付费。
原型开发：在项目初期使用免费模型验证想法，降低开发成本。
学习与研究：探索不同 LLM 的能力，进行对比实验。
自动化工具：为聊天机器人、内容生成等应用提供统一 API 接口。

en.tag: Unified API gateway aggregating 34 free LLM providers
en.what: FreeLLMAPI is an open-source project that aggregates free tiers from dozens of LLM providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. It offers smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key management, allowing developers to access a vast array of free models without managing multiple API keys.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based API gateway with Docker self-hosting, desktop apps for macOS/Windows, and an Android app. It includes a dashboard for monitoring monthly token budgets and an auto-updating model catalog.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Docker deployment and desktop/mobile apps. Relies on OpenAI-compatible API standards and integrates multiple LLM providers.
en.hot: The project has gained nearly 20k stars with 174 new stars today, addressing the pain point of scattered free LLM resources by offering a one-stop solution.
uses: Individual developers: Quickly integrate multiple free LLMs without separate registrations and payments.
Prototyping: Validate ideas with free models in early stages, reducing development costs.
Learning and research: Explore capabilities of different LLMs and run comparative experiments.
Automation tools: Provide a unified API for chatbots, content generation, and more.

zh.tag: Garry Tan 的 Claude Code 配置：23 个工具组成虚拟工程团队
zh.what: gstack 是一套开源的 Claude Code 配置，将 AI 编码助手转变为虚拟工程团队，包含 CEO、设计师、工程经理、发布经理、文档工程师和 QA 等角色。它通过 23 个专业工具和 8 个强力工具，以斜杠命令的形式提供，全部基于 Markdown，免费且 MIT 许可。
zh.content: 仓库包含 23 个专业工具和 8 个强力工具，全部为斜杠命令，以 Markdown 文件形式组织。还包括文档（如 LOC 争议的说明）、图片（如贡献图）以及配置示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Claude Code（Anthropic 的 AI 编码助手），使用 TypeScript 作为主语言，工具以 Markdown 和斜杠命令形式实现，依赖 Claude Code 的扩展机制。
zh.hot: 由 YC 总裁 Garry Tan 亲自开源，展示 AI 代理如何将个人生产力提升数百倍，引发广泛讨论。130K 星标和日增 220 星，说明开发者对 AI 驱动开发工作流的高度关注。
uses: 独立开发者或小团队希望用 AI 代理实现全栈开发、设计、QA 等角色，提升交付速度。
对 Claude Code 感兴趣，想借鉴 Garry Tan 的配置来优化自己的 AI 编码工作流。
技术管理者想了解 AI 如何改变工程团队结构，探索虚拟团队模式。

en.tag: Garry Tan's Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools as a virtual engineering team
en.what: gstack is an open-source Claude Code configuration that turns the AI coding assistant into a virtual engineering team, including roles like CEO, designer, engineering manager, release manager, doc engineer, and QA. It provides 23 specialist tools and 8 power tools as slash commands, all in Markdown, free under MIT license.
en.content: The repo contains 23 specialist tools and 8 power tools, all as slash commands, organized as Markdown files. It also includes docs (e.g., ON_THE_LOC_CONTROVERSY.md), images (e.g., contribution graphs), and configuration examples.
en.stack: Built on Claude Code (Anthropic's AI coding assistant), with TypeScript as the primary language. Tools are implemented as Markdown and slash commands, leveraging Claude Code's extension mechanism.
en.hot: Open-sourced by YC President Garry Tan, demonstrating how AI agents can multiply individual productivity by hundreds of times, sparking wide discussion. With 130K stars and +220 daily, it shows developers' high interest in AI-driven development workflows.
uses: Solo developers or small teams wanting to leverage AI agents for full-stack dev, design, QA, etc., to accelerate delivery.
Those interested in Claude Code, seeking to adopt Garry Tan's configuration to optimize their own AI coding workflow.
Tech leaders exploring how AI transforms engineering team structures and virtual team models.

zh.tag: 开源免费AI网关，单端点聚合264家模型提供商并智能压缩省token
zh.what: OmniRoute 是一个开源的免费 AI 网关，通过单一 API 端点聚合了 264+ 家模型提供商（含 90+ 免费 tier），让你能把 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等主流编程工具无缝接入免费的 Claude、GPT 或 Gemini。它内置 RTK+Caveman 双层压缩算法，可自动减少 15%–95% 的 token 消耗，并支持智能故障自动回退、MCP/A2A 协议以及多模态接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含可直接部署的网关核心、Web 管理后台（Dashboard）、PWA 与桌面端应用，以及详细的路由策略配置、免费额度文档和 Provider 接入模板。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 全栈构建，网关层采用 Node.js 高并发架构，前端提供 React 驱动的 Dashboard 与 PWA，并支持 Desktop 端封装。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3,605 Star、总星数突破 1.8 万并登上 GitHub 周榜第 16 名，反映出开发者对「零成本调用多模型」的强烈需求——聚合 90+ 免费提供商与高达 95% 的 token 压缩能力，直接切中了 AI 应用落地时的成本焦虑。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小型团队 —— 想用 Claude/GPT/Gemini 但预算有限，通过免费 tier 聚合实现零成本调用。
AI 编程工具重度用户 —— 将 Cursor、Cline、Claude Code 等 IDE 插件的底层模型切换到免费提供商。
网关/中间件自建者 —— 需要统一端点管理多模型路由、自动容灾和 token 压缩的企业内部 AI 基础设施。

en.tag: Open-source AI gateway aggregating 264 providers with token compression and auto-fallback
en.what: OmniRoute is an open-source free AI gateway that aggregates 264+ providers—including 90+ free tiers—behind a single API endpoint, letting you plug Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and other tools into free Claude, GPT or Gemini instances. It features RTK+Caveman stacked compression to cut token usage by 15–95%, alongside smart auto-fallback, MCP/A2A support, and multimodal APIs.
en.content: The repo ships with a deployable gateway core, a web admin dashboard, PWA and desktop apps, plus routing strategy configs, free-tier documentation, and provider integration templates.
en.stack: Built entirely in TypeScript on a Node.js backend for high-concurrency gateway operations, with a React-based web dashboard and PWA, plus desktop packaging.
en.hot: It gained 3,605 stars this week, reaching 18.4k total and hitting #16 on GitHub Trending, as developers rush to cut AI costs—aggregating 90+ free providers and slashing token usage by up to 95% directly addresses the biggest barrier to shipping AI apps.
uses: Indie devs & small teams —— Access Claude/GPT/Gemini at zero cost by pooling 90+ free tiers instead of paid APIs.
Power users of AI coding tools —— Redirect Cursor, Cline, Claude Code and Copilot to free model backends via one endpoint.
Platform builders —— Those needing a unified gateway with auto-fallback, routing strategies, and token compression for internal AI infra.

zh.tag: 手作 Claude Code 技能集，提升 AI 代理结果质量
zh.what: 这是一个精心制作的上下文工程技巧和模式集合，旨在提升 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、OpenCode 等）的结果质量和可预测性。它通过最小化 token 占用，提供即插即用的技能和命令，帮助开发者更有效地利用 AI 编程助手。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个插件（如 Spec-Driven Development、Tech Stack 等），每个插件包含特定的 agents、commands 和 skills，遵循 agentskills.io 规范。还提供文档、快速入门指南和 GitHub Action 集成。
zh.stack: 主要基于 TypeScript，无外部依赖，技能格式遵循 agentskills.io 规范。部分插件基于 Arc42 等标准。
zh.hot: 凭借 1430 星和日增 17 星登上 TypeScript 日榜第 8，因其提供经过验证的上下文工程技术，能显著提升 AI 代理输出质量，且兼容多种主流工具，受到开发者社区青睐。
uses: 使用 Claude Code 或类似 AI 编程助手的开发者，希望提升代码生成质量和一致性
团队希望标准化 AI 辅助开发流程，通过插件化技能确保最佳实践
对上下文工程感兴趣的研究者或爱好者，想学习如何优化 AI 代理的提示词和上下文管理

en.tag: Hand-crafted Claude Code Skills to boost agent result quality
en.what: A hand-crafted collection of advanced context engineering techniques and patterns to improve the quality and predictability of AI agents like Claude Code, OpenCode, and more. It provides plug-and-play skills and commands with minimal token footprint, helping developers use AI coding assistants more effectively.
en.content: The repo contains multiple plugins (e.g., Spec-Driven Development, Tech Stack), each with specific agents, commands, and skills following the agentskills.io spec. It also includes docs, quick start guide, and GitHub Action integration.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, no external dependencies, skills follow agentskills.io spec. Some plugins are based on standards like Arc42.
en.hot: With 1430 stars and +17 today, ranking #8 on TypeScript daily trending, it's popular for providing proven context engineering techniques that significantly improve AI agent output quality, compatible with many mainstream tools.
uses: Developers using Claude Code or similar AI coding assistants who want to improve code generation quality and consistency
Teams looking to standardize AI-assisted development workflows with plugin-based skills to enforce best practices
Researchers or enthusiasts interested in context engineering, wanting to learn how to optimize prompts and context management for AI agents

zh.tag: 将任意 SQL 数据库变成无头 CMS 和可视化后台的灵活后端
zh.what: Directus 是一个开源后端即服务（BaaS），它包装任何 SQL 数据库，自动生成 REST 和 GraphQL API，并提供可视化管理界面。它让非技术团队成员和 AI 代理可以直接操作实时数据，无需编写样板代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Directus 核心源码、文档、示例和部署配置。核心功能包括 REST/GraphQL API、可视化 Studio、AI 助手、原生 MCP 服务器、基于策略的访问控制，以及可扩展的端点、钩子、界面和模块。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，支持多种 SQL 数据库（Postgres、MySQL、MariaDB、MS SQL、SQLite、OracleDB、CockroachDB 等）。前端使用 Vue.js，后端使用 Node.js，并集成 MCP 协议以支持 AI 工具连接。
zh.hot: 凭借 37,626 颗星和 4,500 万+下载量，Directus 因其灵活性和 AI 集成而广受欢迎。它提供免费开源许可，支持自托管或云部署，并原生支持 MCP，使 AI 代理能安全访问数据。
uses: 开发者想要快速为现有数据库构建 API 和管理后台，无需从头开发。
非技术团队成员需要直观地管理内容或数据，而无需编写代码。
AI 开发者希望将 Claude、Cursor 等工具连接到实时数据，进行内容生成或操作。

en.tag: Turn any SQL database into a headless CMS, admin panels, or apps with instant APIs and a visual Studio
en.what: Directus is an open-source backend-as-a-service that wraps any SQL database, auto-generating REST and GraphQL APIs and providing a visual management Studio. It enables non-technical teammates and AI agents to work directly with live data without boilerplate.
en.content: The repository contains Directus core source code, documentation, examples, and deployment configs. Key features include REST/GraphQL APIs, a visual Studio, an AI Assistant, a native MCP server, policy-based access control, and extensible endpoints, hooks, interfaces, and modules.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, supporting multiple SQL databases (Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, MS SQL, SQLite, OracleDB, CockroachDB, etc.). Frontend uses Vue.js, backend uses Node.js, and integrates MCP protocol for AI tool connectivity.
en.hot: With 37,626 stars and 45M+ downloads, Directus is popular for its flexibility and AI integration. It offers a free open-source license, supports self-hosting or cloud, and natively supports MCP, enabling AI agents to access data securely.
uses: Developers who want to quickly build APIs and admin panels for existing databases without boilerplate.
Non-technical team members who need an intuitive interface to manage content or data without coding.
AI developers who want to connect tools like Claude or Cursor to live data for content generation or actions.

zh.tag: 人与 AI 代理实时协作的共享工作空间
zh.what: Tutti 是一个开源平台，提供实时共享工作空间，让多个 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude Code）和人类在同一环境中协同工作。它连接上下文、文件、应用和任务，消除代理之间的信息传递瓶颈，使输出可直接流转。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（支持 macOS 和 Windows）、文档、贡献指南，以及即将推出的 Tutti · VM 的等待列表。核心是实时共享工作空间，集成图像生成、UI/UX 设计、文档和演示等应用生态。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，桌面应用可能基于 Electron 或类似框架，依赖现代前端技术栈。
zh.hot: 今日新增 52 星，总星数 3526，登上 TypeScript 日榜第 10。它解决了多 AI 代理协作中的上下文传递痛点，开源后迅速吸引关注。
uses: 同时使用多个 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude Code）的开发者，希望减少手动上下文传递。
需要 AI 辅助设计、文档和演示生成的团队，寻求统一工作流。
对 AI 代理协作和实时共享工作空间感兴趣的研究者或爱好者。

en.tag: A real-time shared workspace where people and AI agents collaborate seamlessly
en.what: Tutti is an open-source platform offering a real-time shared workspace where multiple AI agents (e.g., Codex, Claude Code) and humans collaborate in one environment. It connects context, files, apps, and tasks, eliminating the need for manual handoffs between agents, allowing outputs to flow directly.
en.content: The repository includes desktop apps (macOS and Windows), documentation, contributing guide, and a waitlist for the upcoming Tutti · VM. Core is a real-time shared workspace with an app ecosystem for image generation, UI/UX design, docs, and presentations.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, the desktop apps likely use Electron or similar frameworks, leveraging modern frontend technologies.
en.hot: Gained 52 stars today, total 3526, ranking #10 on TypeScript daily trending. It addresses the pain point of context handoff between multiple AI agents, attracting attention after open-sourcing.
uses: Developers using multiple AI agents (e.g., Codex, Claude Code) who want to reduce manual context switching.
Teams needing AI-assisted design, documentation, and presentation generation in a unified workflow.
Researchers or enthusiasts interested in AI agent collaboration and real-time shared workspaces.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理优化上下文窗口的沙盒与记忆层
zh.what: Context Mode 是 AI 编码代理的上下文优化层，通过沙盒化工具输出（平均减少 98% 的上下文占用）、持久化会话记忆，并在 17 个平台间强制路由，解决上下文窗口溢出问题。它作为 MCP 服务器和 CLI 工具运行，兼容 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的 MCP 服务器、CLI 工具、hooks 集成，以及用于统计和文档的资源。提供 npm 包和 VS Code 扩展，并附带详细的配置指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，依赖 MCP（Model Context Protocol）和 Claude Code hooks，支持 npm 分发与 VS Code 扩展。
zh.hot: 上线即登 Hacker News 榜首（570+ 分），20k+ stars 表明开发者对上下文管理痛点的高度关注。被 Microsoft、Google 等团队采用，验证了其解决实际问题的能力。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望减少上下文溢出和 token 消耗。
需要跨多个 AI 平台统一管理会话记忆和工具输出的团队。
构建自定义 AI 工作流，希望精细控制上下文窗口的进阶用户。

en.tag: Sandbox, memory, and routing layer that slashes context usage for AI coding agents
en.what: Context Mode is a context-optimization layer for AI coding agents. It sandboxes tool output (98% average reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP and hooks, tackling the context-window overflow problem. It runs as an MCP server and CLI, compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, and other agents.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript-based MCP server, CLI tool, hooks integration, plus stats and documentation. It ships as an npm package and VS Code extension with detailed setup guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, leveraging MCP (Model Context Protocol) and Claude Code hooks, distributed via npm and as a VS Code extension.
en.hot: Hit #1 on Hacker News with 570+ points at launch, and 20k+ stars reflect huge demand for context management. Adoption by teams at Microsoft, Google, etc. validates its real-world utility.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want to reduce context overflow and token usage.
Teams that need unified session memory and tool-output management across multiple AI platforms.
Advanced users building custom AI workflows who want fine-grained control over the context window.

zh.tag: 企业级 UI 设计语言与 React 组件库
zh.what: Ant Design 是一套面向企业级应用的设计语言和 React UI 组件库，提供丰富的可复用组件和设计规范，帮助开发者快速构建高质量的中后台产品。它强调一致性和可访问性，并支持主题定制。
zh.content: 仓库包含组件源码、设计规范文档、示例、测试、以及用于构建和发布的工具配置。主要目录包括 components（组件）、docs（文档）、examples（示例）等。
zh.stack: 基于 React 和 TypeScript，使用 Less 进行样式开发，支持 CSS-in-JS。依赖包括 @ant-design/icons、rc-* 系列基础组件库，并集成了 Jest 测试、ESLint 等工具。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 上最受欢迎的 React UI 库之一，拥有近 10 万 star，持续活跃更新，是前端开发者的首选组件库。
uses: 中后台管理系统开发者：快速搭建企业级后台界面，提升开发效率。
UI/UX 设计师：参考设计规范与组件模式，确保产品视觉一致性。
前端团队：基于 Ant Design 定制主题，构建符合品牌风格的应用。

en.tag: Enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library
en.what: Ant Design is an enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library that provides a rich set of reusable components and design guidelines, enabling developers to quickly build high-quality admin dashboards and enterprise applications. It emphasizes consistency, accessibility, and supports theme customization.
en.content: The repository contains component source code, design specification docs, examples, tests, and build/release tooling. Key directories include components, docs, and examples.
en.stack: Built on React and TypeScript, with styles in Less and support for CSS-in-JS. It depends on @ant-design/icons and rc-* base component libraries, and integrates Jest, ESLint, and other tooling.
en.hot: As one of the most popular React UI libraries on GitHub with nearly 100k stars, it remains actively maintained and is a go-to choice for frontend developers.
uses: Developers building admin dashboards and enterprise apps: speed up UI development with ready-made components.
UI/UX designers: use the design language and component patterns to ensure visual consistency.
Frontend teams: customize themes to match brand identity and build scalable applications.

zh.tag: 轻量级金融图表库，性能卓越
zh.what: TradingView 出品的轻量级金融图表库，基于 HTML5 Canvas 构建，提供快速、交互式的图表展示。它专为在网页上显示金融数据而设计，不影响页面加载速度和性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码、插件示例、文档和演示。核心库提供丰富的图表功能，并支持通过自定义插件扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 HTML5 Canvas，通过 npm 分发，支持 ES6 模块和 CDN 引入。
zh.hot: 拥有 17100 星，今日新增 17 星，位居 TypeScript 日榜第 13 名。作为 TradingView 官方库，性能优异且体积小，深受开发者喜爱。
uses: 金融网站或应用开发者，需要快速展示交互式K线图或走势图。
希望替换静态图片图表为交互式图表的网页开发者。
对图表性能有高要求，需要轻量级解决方案的开发者。

en.tag: Lightweight financial charts with high performance
en.what: A lightweight financial charting library by TradingView, built with HTML5 Canvas, offering fast and interactive charts. It's designed to display financial data on web pages without affecting loading speed and performance.
en.content: The repository contains the core library source, plugin examples, documentation, and demos. The core library provides rich charting capabilities and supports extension via custom plugins.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, uses HTML5 Canvas, distributed via npm, supports ES6 modules and CDN.
en.hot: With 17,100 stars and 17 new stars today, it ranks 13th on the TypeScript daily trending. As an official TradingView library, it's loved for its performance and small size.
uses: Developers of financial websites or apps needing fast interactive candlestick or line charts.
Web developers looking to replace static image charts with interactive ones.
Developers with high performance requirements needing a lightweight charting solution.

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的幻灯片框架，自然语言生成演示文稿
zh.what: open-slide 是一个专为 AI 代理设计的幻灯片框架。你只需用自然语言描述演示内容，编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor）就会自动编写 React 代码生成幻灯片。框架负责画布、缩放、导航、热重载和演示模式，让代理专注于内容创作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 脚手架、内置代理技能（/create-slide 和 /slide-authoring）、浏览器内检查器、资源管理器、演示模式和导出工具。所有幻灯片渲染为固定的 1920×1080 画布，页面是任意 React 组件。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 React 渲染幻灯片，支持热重载和静态导出。依赖 svgl 进行 logo 搜索，通过 CLI 工具 npx @open-slide/cli 初始化项目。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程代理盛行的当下，open-slide 填补了从聊天到精美演示文稿的空白，让代理直接生成幻灯片。7194 星和日增 142 星表明开发者对 AI 驱动内容创作工具的高度兴趣。
uses: 开发者希望用 AI 代理快速生成演示文稿，无需手动编写代码
团队需要从文本描述自动创建幻灯片，并支持迭代修改
演讲者需要专业演示模式，包括演讲者备注和计时器
设计师或内容创作者希望利用浏览器内检查器快速调整样式

en.tag: A slide framework built for agents, turning natural language into polished decks
en.what: open-slide is a slide framework designed for AI agents. You describe your deck in natural language, and a coding agent (like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) writes the React code. The framework handles canvas, scaling, navigation, hot reload, and present mode, letting the agent focus on content.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI scaffolder, built-in agent skills (/create-slide and /slide-authoring), an in-browser inspector, asset manager, present mode, and export tools. Slides render on a fixed 1920×1080 canvas, with pages as arbitrary React components.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses React for rendering slides, supports hot reload and static export. Integrates svgl for logo search, and is initialized via npx @open-slide/cli.
en.hot: Amid the rise of AI coding agents, open-slide fills the gap from chat to polished presentations, letting agents generate slides directly. With 7194 stars and +142 today, it shows strong interest in AI-driven content creation tools.
uses: Developers who want to generate presentations quickly with AI agents without writing code manually
Teams needing to create slides from text descriptions and iterate with comments
Speakers requiring professional present mode with notes and timer
Designers or content creators who want to tweak styles via the in-browser inspector

zh.tag: 让每次工程变更都更省力的 AI 技能插件
zh.what: Compound Engineering 是一个包含 33 个技能的插件，用于增强 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex）的工作流程。它围绕一个循环组织工作：头脑风暴、计划、构建、审查，然后捕获所学知识，以便下一次变更能够利用这些知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、指南（skills/guides）、安装文档（docs/install）以及用于市场分发的插件配置。技能以本地提示资产的形式存在，支持 14 种代理宿主。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 AI 代理的插件市场机制（如 Claude Code 的 /plugin 命令）。
zh.hot: 24.6k 星表明它解决了 AI 编程中知识复用和流程结构化的痛点，且支持多平台，今日新增 39 星，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 15。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 的开发者，希望通过插件提升 AI 编程效率。
团队希望将工程知识沉淀到 AI 工作流中，实现持续改进。
对 AI 代理技能市场感兴趣的开发者，想了解插件化开发模式。

en.tag: AI skills plugin that makes each engineering change easier than the last
en.what: Compound Engineering is a plugin of 33 skills for AI coding agents, structuring work around a loop: brainstorm, plan, build, review, then capture what you learned, so knowledge from each change is written down where the next change can read it.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, guides (skills/guides), installation docs (docs/install), and plugin configuration for marketplace distribution. Skills are local prompt assets supporting 14 agent hosts.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, leveraging AI agent plugin marketplace mechanisms (e.g., /plugin for Claude Code).
en.hot: 24.6k stars show it addresses pain points in knowledge reuse and workflow structuring for AI coding, with multi-platform support; +39 stars today, ranking #15 on TypeScript daily trending.
uses: Developers using Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex who want to boost AI coding efficiency with plugins.
Teams aiming to embed engineering knowledge into AI workflows for continuous improvement.
Developers interested in AI agent skill marketplaces and plugin-based development patterns.

zh.tag: AI 编码代理的持久记忆层，让代理记住一切
zh.what: agentmemory 是一个为 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor 等）提供持久记忆的库。它基于真实世界基准测试，让代理无需重复解释上下文，显著提升效率。该库实现了 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式，并扩展了置信度评分、生命周期管理、知识图谱和混合搜索。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 源码、文档（多语言 README）、测试、构建配置和资产（如 banner 和徽章）。核心是一个 npm 包，提供记忆存储、检索和集成接口，支持多种代理和 MCP 客户端。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 iii 引擎，支持 npm 分发。集成多种 AI 代理和 MCP 客户端，使用知识图谱和混合搜索技术。
zh.hot: 因其解决 AI 代理的持久记忆痛点而广受关注，star 数高达 27.5k，且设计文档在 GitHub Gist 上获得 1.6k 星。它宣称 95.2% 的检索召回率和减少 92% 的 token 消耗，吸引大量开发者。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等编码代理的开发者，希望代理记住项目上下文，减少重复解释。
构建自定义 AI 代理或 MCP 客户端的团队，需要集成持久记忆功能。
对 LLM 记忆机制、知识图谱和混合搜索感兴趣的研究者或爱好者。

en.tag: Persistent memory layer for AI coding agents, so they remember everything
en.what: agentmemory is a library providing persistent memory for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, etc. It is built on real-world benchmarks, enabling agents to avoid re-explaining context and significantly improving efficiency. It implements Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern with extensions for confidence scoring, lifecycle, knowledge graphs, and hybrid search.
en.content: The repository contains TypeScript source code, documentation (multi-language READMEs), tests, build configuration, and assets like banners and badges. The core is an npm package offering memory storage, retrieval, and integration interfaces for various agents and MCP clients.
en.stack: Developed in TypeScript, built on the iii engine, distributed via npm. Integrates with various AI agents and MCP clients, using knowledge graphs and hybrid search.
en.hot: It has gained attention for solving the persistent memory pain point for AI agents, with 27.5k stars and a design doc on GitHub Gist with 1.6k stars. It claims 95.2% retrieval recall and 92% fewer tokens, attracting many developers.
uses: Developers using coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, who want agents to remember project context and reduce re-explanation.
Teams building custom AI agents or MCP clients that need persistent memory integration.
Researchers or enthusiasts interested in LLM memory mechanisms, knowledge graphs, and hybrid search.

zh.tag: 八大网盘一键获取直链下载地址
zh.what: LinkSwift 是一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具，由【网盘直链下载助手】修改而来。它支持百度网盘、阿里云盘、中国移动云盘、天翼云盘、迅雷云盘、夸克网盘、UC网盘和123云盘八大网盘，帮助用户快速获取文件的直链下载地址。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个用户脚本（userscript），可通过 GreasyFork 或脚本猫等平台安装。脚本在网盘页面注入功能，一键提取直链，并附带安装说明和扩展脚本推荐。
zh.stack: 纯 JavaScript 用户脚本，依赖浏览器油猴扩展（如 Tampermonkey）或脚本猫运行，无后端依赖。
zh.hot: 近2万星标，今日新增83，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。网盘直链需求旺盛，脚本免费易用，且持续更新适配多网盘。
uses: 经常使用百度网盘等下载大文件，但受限于客户端速度或会员限制的用户
需要将网盘文件分享给他人，希望提供直链而非分享页面的用户
开发者或技术爱好者，希望了解或修改网盘直链提取逻辑

en.tag: One-click direct download links for 8 major cloud drives
en.what: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based tool for obtaining direct download links for cloud drive files, modified from the 'Cloud Drive Direct Link Download Assistant'. It supports eight major cloud drives including Baidu, Alibaba, China Mobile, Tianyi, Xunlei, Quark, UC, and 123 Pan, enabling users to quickly get direct download URLs.
en.content: The repository contains a userscript installable via GreasyFork or ScriptCat. It injects functionality into cloud drive pages to extract direct links with one click, along with installation instructions and recommended companion scripts.
en.stack: Pure JavaScript userscript, runs with browser extensions like Tampermonkey or ScriptCat, no backend dependencies.
en.hot: Nearly 20k stars, +83 today, trending on GitHub. High demand for direct cloud drive links, free and easy to use, with continuous updates for multiple drives.
uses: Users who frequently download large files from Baidu Pan etc., limited by client speed or membership restrictions
Users who need to share cloud drive files as direct links instead of share pages
Developers or tech enthusiasts interested in understanding or modifying direct link extraction logic

zh.tag: 在 Claude Code 中调用 Codex 进行代码审查与任务委派
zh.what: 这是一个插件，让 Claude Code 用户可以直接在现有工作流中调用 OpenAI 的 Codex 进行代码审查或委派任务。它提供多种斜杠命令，支持后台运行、状态查询和任务取消，实现两个 AI 工具的协同工作。

zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方发布的插件，它无缝集成两大 AI 工具，解决开发者多工具切换的痛点，上线即获得 3.2 万星标，今日新增 46 个，位列日榜第 6。
uses: Claude Code 用户希望利用 Codex 进行代码审查，无需切换工具。
开发者需要将任务委派给 Codex 处理，如后台运行审查或转移会话。
团队想要在现有工作流中增加对抗性审查，以挑战设计决策和风险。

en.tag: Use Codex from Claude Code for code reviews and task delegation
en.what: This plugin enables Claude Code users to invoke OpenAI's Codex for code reviews or task delegation directly within their existing workflow. It offers various slash commands, supports background execution, status tracking, and cancellation, enabling collaboration between two AI tools.
en.content: The repository contains plugin code, documentation, and a demo video, providing commands like /codex:review, /codex:adversarial-review, /codex:rescue, /codex:transfer, and a codex:codex-rescue subagent.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript and Node.js (18.18+), leveraging Claude Code's plugin system and OpenAI Codex CLI, installed via npm, requiring a ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key.
en.hot: As an official OpenAI plugin, it seamlessly integrates two major AI tools, addressing the pain point of switching between tools. It gained 32k stars quickly, with 46 new stars today, ranking #6 on the daily trending list.
uses: Claude Code users who want to leverage Codex for code reviews without switching tools.
Developers needing to delegate tasks to Codex, such as running background reviews or transferring sessions.
Teams looking to add adversarial reviews to challenge design decisions and risks in their existing workflow.

zh.tag: 印地语Web开发全栈课程源码，从零到精通

uses: 印地语初学者：希望用母语系统学习Web开发，从零开始构建技能。

Intermediate developers: seek to solidify and advance their front-end/back-end skills via full project code.

zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖网络捕获库（如 pcap）和 GUI 框架（如 egui 或类似），支持多平台编译。
zh.hot: 因其易用性和美观的界面受到欢迎，在 GitHub 上获得 40k+ 星标，今日新增 147 星，成为 Rust 语言趋势榜第一。
uses: 网络管理员和爱好者：实时监控网络流量，排查异常连接。
普通用户：直观了解网络活动，保护隐私安全。
开发者：学习 Rust 网络编程和 GUI 应用开发。

en.tag: Cross-platform network traffic monitoring tool
en.what: Sniffnet is an intuitive, reliable, and cross-platform application for monitoring network traffic in real-time. It offers an overview page, packet inspection, notifications, and custom themes, helping users easily understand and manage their network activity.
en.content: The repository contains a complete desktop application written in Rust, featuring a graphical interface, network packet capture and analysis, traffic statistics, notification system, and multi-language support.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, leveraging network capture libraries (e.g., pcap) and GUI frameworks (e.g., egui or similar), with cross-platform compilation support.
en.hot: Popular for its ease of use and beautiful UI, it has gained 40k+ stars on GitHub, with 147 new stars today, ranking first in the Rust trending list.
uses: Network administrators and enthusiasts: monitor traffic in real-time to troubleshoot anomalies.
General users: intuitively understand network activity and protect privacy.
Developers: learn Rust network programming and GUI application development.

zh.tag: 一站式下载器：课程、视频、音乐、电子书，免命令行
zh.what: OmniGet 是一款免费开源的桌面应用，支持从 Udemy、Hotmart、YouTube 等 1800+ 网站下载课程、视频、音乐和电子书。内置播放器、PDF/EPUB 阅读器和音乐库，所有文件保存在本地，无需命令行或 Python。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的桌面应用源码，使用 Tauri 框架，提供图形界面；内置下载引擎（基于 yt-dlp）、媒体播放器、阅读器和音乐库，并支持多语言（含中文）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 和 Tauri 构建桌面应用，下载功能基于 yt-dlp，前端可能涉及 Svelte（根据 README 提及）。
zh.hot: 凭借 9153 星和日增 48 星登上 Rust 日榜第二，因为它是少数支持 1800+ 站点且无需命令行的免费下载器，尤其受在线课程学习者欢迎。
uses: 在线课程学习者：下载 Udemy、Hotmart 等平台课程，离线观看
视频/音乐爱好者：从 YouTube、TikTok 等站点批量下载媒体
电子书读者：下载并阅读 PDF/EPUB 格式书籍
追求隐私的用户：所有文件保存在本地，无需上传云端

en.tag: All-in-one downloader for courses, videos, music & books, no terminal
en.what: OmniGet is a free, open-source desktop app that downloads courses, videos, music, and books from 1,800+ sites like Udemy, Hotmart, and YouTube. It includes a built-in player, PDF/EPUB reader, and music library, keeping files local with no terminal or Python required.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust-based desktop app source, built with Tauri, providing a GUI; it integrates a download engine (powered by yt-dlp), media player, reader, and music library, with multi-language support including Chinese.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Tauri for the desktop app, download functionality powered by yt-dlp, frontend possibly using Svelte (as mentioned in README).
en.hot: With 9,153 stars and +48 today, it ranks #2 on Rust daily trending, as it's one of the few free downloaders supporting 1,800+ sites without a terminal, especially popular among online course learners.
uses: Online course learners: download Udemy, Hotmart courses for offline viewing
Video/music fans: batch download media from YouTube, TikTok, and more
E-book readers: download and read PDF/EPUB books
Privacy-conscious users: all files stay local, no cloud upload

zh.tag: 本地模型网关，让 Cursor 接入任意 API
zh.what: cursor-byok 是 Cursor 后端的本地实现，作为一个开源模型网关运行在你的机器上。它允许你将 Cursor 连接到自定义的模型 API，并保留工具调用、Skills 和 MCP 等 Agent 能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的服务端、跨平台桌面应用（macOS/Windows/Linux）、模型管理界面、连接基准测试工具和会话指标面板。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 构建，支持 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容 API，以及自定义端点。
zh.hot: 凭借 2512 颗星和日增 23 颗的热度，它满足了用户对 Cursor 模型提供商灵活性的需求，成为热门 Rust 项目。
uses: 希望使用自有或第三方模型 API 的 Cursor 用户，避免平台锁定。
需要精细控制模型端点、密钥和请求参数的高级开发者。
关注 token 用量和成本，想要监控会话指标的技术团队。

en.tag: Local model gateway connecting Cursor to any API
en.what: cursor-byok is a local implementation of Cursor's backend, acting as an open-source model gateway on your machine. It lets you connect Cursor to custom model APIs while preserving Agent capabilities like tool calling, Skills, and MCP.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust-based server, cross-platform desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux), model management UI, connection benchmark tools, and session metrics dashboard.
en.stack: Built primarily with Rust, supporting OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, as well as custom endpoints.
en.hot: With 2512 stars and 23 new stars today, it addresses the demand for model provider flexibility in Cursor, making it a trending Rust project.
uses: Cursor users who want to use their own or third-party model APIs to avoid vendor lock-in.
Advanced developers needing fine-grained control over endpoints, keys, and request parameters.
Teams monitoring token usage and costs with session metrics.

zh.tag: 一个 CLI 统一管理 Google Workspace，支持 AI 代理技能
zh.what: gws 是一个命令行工具，用于访问和管理 Google Workspace 的各种服务，如 Drive、Gmail、Calendar 等。它通过 Google Discovery Service 动态生成命令，无需静态命令列表。该工具专为人类和 AI 代理设计，提供结构化 JSON 输出和 40+ 内置代理技能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源代码、安装脚本（npm、cargo、Nix）、文档（README）以及 GitHub Releases 中的预编译二进制文件。核心是一个动态命令生成器，能够自动适配 Google API 的更新。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，通过 npm 分发（@googleworkspace/cli），支持 cargo 和 Nix 安装。依赖 Google Discovery Service 和 OAuth 认证。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方（非正式支持）的 CLI，它简化了 Workspace API 的使用，并集成了 AI 代理技能，吸引了大量开发者。30k+ stars 表明其受欢迎程度，尽管今日新增较少，但仍在 Rust 趋势榜上。
uses: 开发者需要快速通过命令行操作 Google Workspace 数据（如批量上传文件、读取邮件）
AI 代理开发者希望为代理提供访问 Google 服务的工具，利用内置技能
自动化脚本编写者需要以 JSON 格式获取结构化数据，用于集成或报告

en.tag: One CLI for all Google Workspace APIs, with AI agent skills built-in
en.what: gws is a command-line tool for accessing and managing Google Workspace services like Drive, Gmail, Calendar, and more. It dynamically builds its command surface from Google's Discovery Service, eliminating static command lists. Designed for both humans and AI agents, it offers structured JSON output and 40+ built-in agent skills.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, installation scripts (npm, cargo, Nix), documentation (README), and pre-built binaries in GitHub Releases. The core is a dynamic command generator that automatically adapts to Google API updates.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, distributed via npm (@googleworkspace/cli), with cargo and Nix installation options. Relies on Google Discovery Service and OAuth authentication.
en.hot: As an official (though not formally supported) Google CLI, it simplifies Workspace API usage and integrates AI agent skills, attracting many developers. 30k+ stars indicate popularity, and despite modest daily growth, it remains on the Rust trending list.
uses: Developers who need to quickly manipulate Google Workspace data via CLI (e.g., batch upload files, read emails)
AI agent developers looking to give agents access to Google services using built-in skills
Automation script writers needing structured JSON data for integration or reporting

zh.tag: 本地优先的个人 AI 超级智能，记忆+编排+深度研究
zh.what: OpenHuman 是一个开源的个人 AI 超级智能，旨在构建你生活的本地优先记忆，并作为智能体舰队和工作流的出色编排器，同时提供深度研究能力。它强调本地优先、简单和强大，让用户拥有自己的 AI 大脑。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的核心引擎、文档（gitbooks）、演示图片、社区链接（Discussions、Discord、Reddit、X）以及 Product Hunt 徽章。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 GitBook 文档框架，并集成 Product Hunt 和 Trendshift 徽章。
zh.hot: 凭借 36.5k 星标和每日新增 51 星，OpenHuman 在 GitHub 趋势榜上排名第 9，其本地优先的 AI 超级智能概念和强大的编排能力吸引了大量关注。
uses: 个人知识管理：构建本地优先的生活记忆，用于个人助理和知识库。
智能体编排：管理和协调多个 AI 智能体执行复杂工作流。
深度研究：利用 AI 进行深入的信息检索和分析。
开发者与 AI 爱好者：探索开源 AI 工具链和本地优先架构。

en.tag: Local-first personal AI superintelligence: memory, orchestration, deep research
en.what: OpenHuman is an open-source personal AI superintelligence that builds a local-first memory of your life, acts as an orchestrator for agent fleets and workflows, and offers deep research capabilities.
