It emphasizes local-first, simplicity, and power, giving users ownership of their AI brain.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based core engine, documentation (gitbooks), demo images, community links (Discussions, Discord, Reddit, X), and Product Hunt badges.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, uses GitBook for documentation, and integrates Product Hunt and Trendshift badges.
en.hot: With 36.5k stars and 51 new stars daily, OpenHuman ranks #9 on GitHub Trending, attracting attention for its local-first AI superintelligence concept and powerful orchestration capabilities.
uses: Personal knowledge management: build local-first memory for personal assistants and knowledge bases.
Agent orchestration: manage and coordinate multiple AI agents for complex workflows.
Deep research: leverage AI for in-depth information retrieval and analysis.
Developers and AI enthusiasts: explore open-source AI toolchains and local-first architecture.

zh.tag: 为并行 AI 代理工作流打造的 Git worktree 管理 CLI
zh.what: Worktrunk 是一个用 Rust 编写的命令行工具，专注于简化 Git worktree 的管理。它专为并行 AI 代理工作流设计，使多个代理可以在隔离的工作树中同时工作，而不会相互干扰。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档（位于 docs/ 目录）、CI 配置（GitHub Actions）以及徽章等。主要提供 worktrunk 命令，用于创建、列出、切换和清理 worktree。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态，支持 MIT 或 Apache-2.0 双许可证。
zh.hot: 自年初发布以来迅速成为最流行的 Git worktree 管理器，目前已有 6667 星，今日新增 44 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜第二。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要并行运行多个 AI 代理进行代码生成或审查，隔离工作树避免冲突。
多任务开发者：同时处理多个功能分支或修复，需要高效管理多个工作树。
CI/CD 工程师：在自动化流水线中并行执行任务，需要隔离的 Git 工作目录。

en.tag: A CLI for Git worktree management, built for parallel AI agent workflows
en.what: Worktrunk is a Rust-based CLI tool that simplifies Git worktree management. It is designed for parallel AI agent workflows, allowing multiple agents to work in isolated worktrees simultaneously without interference.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation (in docs/), CI configuration (GitHub Actions), and badges. It provides the worktrunk command for creating, listing, switching, and cleaning worktrees.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem, dual-licensed under MIT or Apache-2.0.
en.hot: Since its release at the start of the year, it has quickly become the most popular Git worktree manager, now with 6,667 stars and 44 new stars today, ranking #2 on the Rust trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: need to run multiple AI agents in parallel for code generation or review, isolating worktrees to avoid conflicts.
Multi-tasking developers: handle multiple feature branches or fixes simultaneously, requiring efficient management of multiple worktrees.
CI/CD engineers: execute tasks in parallel in automated pipelines, needing isolated Git working directories.

zh.tag: 统一数据访问层，一个 API 访问所有存储
zh.what: Apache OpenDAL 是一个开源数据访问层，旨在通过统一的 API 访问对象存储、文件系统、云 SaaS、数据库、协议和键值存储等多种存储服务。它基于 Rust 构建，提供零成本抽象，并支持多种语言绑定。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库、多种语言绑定（如 C、C++、Python 等）、可组合的层（如重试、超时、日志、监控）以及服务实现。还包含文档、网站源码和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust，依赖异步运行时（如 tokio），并支持通过绑定集成其他语言。
zh.hot: 作为 Apache 顶级项目，OpenDAL 提供统一存储访问，解决多云和异构存储痛点，在 Rust 社区和数据处理领域广受关注，star 数持续增长。
uses: 数据工程师：统一访问多种存储后端，简化数据管道开发。
云原生应用开发者：通过单一 API 集成对象存储、数据库等，降低耦合。
存储系统开发者：利用可扩展架构添加新服务或层，构建定制化存储方案。

en.tag: Unified data access layer: one API for all storage backends
en.what: Apache OpenDAL is an open-source data access layer that provides a unified API to access object storage, file systems, cloud SaaS, databases, protocols, and key-value stores. Built in Rust, it offers zero-cost abstractions and supports multiple language bindings.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust core library, language bindings (e.g., C, C++, Python), composable layers (retry, timeout, logging, tracing, metrics), and service implementations. It also includes documentation, website source, and examples.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, leveraging async runtimes like tokio, with bindings for other languages.
en.hot: As an Apache top-level project, OpenDAL addresses pain points of multi-cloud and heterogeneous storage with unified access, gaining traction in Rust and data processing communities, with steady star growth.
uses: Data engineers: unify access to multiple storage backends, simplifying data pipeline development.
Cloud-native developers: integrate object storage, databases, etc., via a single API, reducing coupling.
Storage system developers: leverage extensible architecture to add new services or layers for custom storage solutions.

zh.tag: AI 编码代理的指挥控制中心
zh.what: Luvus 是一个为 AI 编码代理设计的终端工作台，提供持久化工作区、分屏终端、Git 仪表盘和代理感知功能。它让你在一个界面中管理多个 AI 代理（如 Claude、Grok、Codex 等），监控其状态、令牌消耗和成本，并协调它们的工作。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 源码、文档、示例配置和模块系统，支持通过 TUI、CLI 和鼠标操作。提供可扩展的模块接口（UHP 协议）和主题定制，支持跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和 Git 集成，通过 UHP 协议与代理通信。
zh.hot: 今日新增 97 星，登上 Rust 日榜第 4，因其填补了 AI 代理管理工具的空缺，提供类似 IDE 的体验但更轻量，受到开发者社区的关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要同时监控和协调多个编码代理的会话、成本和上下文。
终端爱好者：喜欢在终端中完成所有操作，希望获得类似 IDE 的 Git 和文件管理功能。
团队协作：通过 SSH 远程连接，多个客户端共享同一工作区，适合远程团队协作。
自动化工作流：利用 UHP 协议构建自定义的代理编排和自动化管道。

en.tag: Mission control for your AI coding agents
en.what: Luvus is a terminal workspace designed for AI coding agents, offering persistent workspaces, split-pane terminals, a Git dashboard, and agent awareness. It lets you manage multiple AI agents (like Claude, Grok, Codex) in one interface, monitor their status, token usage, and cost, and orchestrate their work.
en.content: The repository contains full Rust source code, documentation, example configs, and a module system, operable via TUI, CLI, and mouse. It offers an extensible module interface (UHP protocol) and theme customization, with cross-platform support (macOS/Linux/Windows).
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and Git integration, communicating with agents via the UHP protocol.
en.hot: Gained 97 stars today, ranking #4 on the Rust daily trending list, as it fills a gap in AI agent management tools, offering an IDE-like experience but lighter, attracting developer attention.
uses: AI agent developers: need to monitor and coordinate multiple coding agents' sessions, costs, and context simultaneously.
Terminal enthusiasts: prefer doing everything in the terminal, wanting IDE-like Git and file management features.
Team collaboration: attach over SSH, multiple clients share the same workspace, suitable for remote teams.
Automation workflows: build custom agent orchestration and automation pipelines using the UHP protocol.

zh.tag: 更智能的 cd 命令，支持所有主流 shell
zh.what: zoxide 是一个更智能的 cd 命令，灵感来自 z 和 autojump。它会记住你最常使用的目录，让你只需几个按键就能跳转到这些目录。
zh.content: 仓库包含 zoxide 的 Rust 源代码、安装脚本、配置指南以及第三方集成说明。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，支持所有主流 shell，如 bash、zsh、fish 等。
zh.hot: 拥有近 3.9 万 star，今日新增 50，因其能显著提升命令行效率而广受欢迎。
uses: 适合频繁在多个目录间切换的命令行用户，减少重复输入路径。
适合希望提高终端操作效率的开发者，快速跳转到常用项目目录。
适合喜欢使用 z 或 autojump 但需要更现代、更快速工具的用户。

en.tag: A smarter cd command that supports all major shells
en.what: zoxide is a smarter cd command, inspired by z and autojump. It remembers which directories you use most frequently, so you can jump to them in just a few keystrokes.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for zoxide, installation scripts, configuration guides, and third-party integration instructions.
en.stack: Written in Rust, supports all major shells including bash, zsh, fish, etc.
en.hot: With nearly 39k stars and 50 new stars today, it's popular for significantly boosting command-line efficiency.
uses: Ideal for command-line users who frequently switch between directories, reducing repetitive path typing.
Great for developers who want to boost terminal productivity by quickly jumping to frequently used project folders.
Perfect for users of z or autojump who need a more modern and faster alternative.

zh.tag: 数据中心级分布式推理服务编排层
zh.what: Dynamo 是一个开源的数据中心级推理服务框架，作为推理引擎（如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM、vLLM）之上的编排层，将它们整合为协调的多节点推理系统。它通过分离式服务、智能路由、多级 KV 缓存和自动扩展，最大化吞吐量并最小化延迟，适用于 LLM、推理、多模态和视频生成等负载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心、Python 扩展、文档、示例、recipes 和容器镜像，并提供设计提案和社区贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 实现高性能，Python 提供可扩展性；依赖推理引擎如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM 和 vLLM。
zh.hot: 本月新增 285 星，总星数 7813，登上 GitHub Trending（Rust）月榜第 20 名。作为 NVIDIA 支持的开源项目，它填补了推理引擎之上的编排层空白，吸引大量关注。
uses: AI 基础设施团队：构建大规模多节点推理服务，优化 GPU 利用率和成本。
模型部署工程师：需要为 LLM、多模态或视频生成模型设计高吞吐、低延迟的服务架构。
平台开发者：希望扩展或定制推理编排逻辑，利用 Rust 和 Python 的混合开发。
研究与实验：在数据中心规模下测试分离式推理、KV 缓存等先进技术。

en.tag: Datacenter-scale distributed inference serving orchestration layer
en.what: Dynamo is an open-source, datacenter-scale inference serving framework that acts as an orchestration layer above inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM, turning them into a coordinated multi-node inference system. It uses disaggregated serving, intelligent routing, multi-tier KV caching, and automatic scaling to maximize throughput and minimize latency for LLM, reasoning, multimodal, and video generation workloads.
en.content: The repository includes a Rust core, Python extensions, documentation, examples, recipes, and container images, along with design proposals and community contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Built in Rust for performance and Python for extensibility; relies on inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM.
en.hot: With 285 stars added this month and 7,813 total, it ranks #20 on GitHub Trending (Rust) monthly. As an NVIDIA-backed open-source project, it fills the orchestration gap above inference engines, drawing significant attention.
uses: AI infrastructure teams: building large-scale multi-node inference services to optimize GPU utilization and cost.
Model deployment engineers: designing high-throughput, low-latency serving architectures for LLMs, multimodal, or video generation models.
Platform developers: extending or customizing inference orchestration logic with Rust and Python.
Research and experimentation: testing advanced techniques like disaggregated serving and KV caching at datacenter scale.

zh.tag: JavaScript/TypeScript 安全默认的现代运行时
zh.what: Deno 是一个基于 V8、Rust 和 Tokio 构建的 JavaScript、TypeScript 和 WebAssembly 运行时，提供安全默认和出色的开发者体验。它内置 TypeScript 支持、标准库和去中心化包管理，适合构建 Web 服务器等应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Deno 运行时的完整源代码，包括 CLI、核心运行时、标准库、文档和贡献指南。项目结构包括 src、cli、runtime 等目录，以及用于构建和测试的配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，基于 V8 引擎和 Tokio 异步运行时，支持 JavaScript、TypeScript 和 WebAssembly。依赖包括 crates.io 上的多个 Rust 库，以及用于包管理的 JSR 注册表。
zh.hot: Deno 作为 Node.js 的现代替代品，持续获得开发者关注，拥有超过 10.8 万星标。其安全默认、内置 TypeScript 支持和现代化工具链使其在 GitHub 趋势榜上保持热度。
uses: 构建高性能 Web 服务器和 API，利用 Deno.serve 快速启动。
开发命令行工具和脚本，享受安全权限模型和内置 TypeScript。
学习现代 JavaScript/TypeScript 运行时和 Rust 系统编程。
部署到 Deno Deploy 或自托管，实现边缘计算和无服务器应用。

en.tag: A modern runtime for JavaScript and TypeScript with secure defaults
en.what: Deno is a JavaScript, TypeScript, and WebAssembly runtime built on V8, Rust, and Tokio, offering secure defaults and a great developer experience. It includes built-in TypeScript support, a standard library, and decentralized package management, ideal for building web servers and more.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the Deno runtime, including the CLI, core runtime, standard library, documentation, and contribution guidelines. The project structure includes directories like src, cli, runtime, and build/test configurations.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the V8 engine and Tokio async runtime, supporting JavaScript, TypeScript, and WebAssembly. Dependencies include various Rust crates and the JSR registry for package management.
en.hot: As a modern alternative to Node.js, Deno continues to gain developer attention with over 108k stars. Its secure defaults, built-in TypeScript support, and modern toolchain keep it trending on GitHub.
uses: Build high-performance web servers and APIs using Deno.serve for quick startup.
Develop CLI tools and scripts with a secure permission model and built-in TypeScript.
Learn modern JavaScript/TypeScript runtimes and Rust system programming.
Deploy to Deno Deploy or self-host for edge computing and serverless applications.

zh.tag: 用公钥拨号，让网络连接更简单
zh.what: iroh 是一个 Rust 库，为应用添加 QUIC 和 NAT 穿透能力。它允许你通过公钥（而非 IP 地址）连接端点，自动寻找并维持最快路径，支持打洞和公共中继回退。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 iroh 库，以及基于它构建的协议模块：iroh-blobs（内容寻址的 blob 传输）、iroh-gossip（发布-订阅覆盖网络）和 iroh-docs（最终一致性的键值存储）。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，基于 QUIC 协议（通过 noq 实现），依赖 BLAKE3 哈希，支持异步编程（tokio）。
zh.hot: 解决了网络编程中的痛点（NAT 穿透和连接维护），API 简洁，star 数稳定增长，今日新增 60，位居 Rust 趋势榜第 12。
uses: 需要点对点连接的应用开发者，如文件同步、远程桌面等，可避免复杂的中继服务器配置。
构建去中心化应用或分布式系统的团队，利用 iroh-gossip 和 iroh-docs 快速搭建网络层。
希望学习 QUIC 和 NAT 穿透实现细节的 Rust 开发者，可作为参考实现。

en.tag: Dial by public key, making network connections simpler
en.what: iroh is a Rust library that adds QUIC and NAT traversal to your apps. It lets you connect to endpoints by public key (instead of IP), automatically finding and maintaining the fastest path, with hole-punching and fallback to public relays.
en.content: The repo contains the core iroh library and protocol modules built on it: iroh-blobs for content-addressed blob transfer, iroh-gossip for pub-sub overlay networks, and iroh-docs for an eventually-consistent key-value store.
en.stack: Written in Rust, built on QUIC via noq, uses BLAKE3 hashing, and supports async programming with tokio.
en.hot: It solves a pain point in network programming (NAT traversal and connection maintenance) with a clean API, and its star count is steadily growing, with 60 new stars today, ranking #12 on the Rust trending list.
uses: Developers building peer-to-peer apps like file sync or remote desktop, avoiding complex relay server setup.
Teams creating decentralized apps or distributed systems, using iroh-gossip and iroh-docs to quickly build the network layer.
Rust developers interested in learning QUIC and NAT traversal implementation details, as a reference.

zh.tag: 跨 50+ 编码工具的 AI Agent 技能统一管理桌面应用
zh.what: Skills Manager 是一个轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等）的技能。它提供集中式技能库、市场浏览、预设分组以及多设备备份同步功能，帮助开发者高效管理跨工具的技能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的桌面应用源码，提供技能库、市场、预设、全局/代理/项目工作区、备份与多设备同步等模块，并附有演示截图和视频介绍。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，依赖 Tauri 框架（推测）构建跨平台桌面应用，支持 Git、本地文件夹、压缩包等技能来源。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码工具激增，开发者需要统一管理技能，该应用填补了这一需求。今日新增 60 星，总星数达 4060，登上 GitHub 趋势榜（Rust 日榜第 9），说明社区关注度高。
uses: 使用多个 AI 编码工具（如 Claude Code、Cursor）的开发者，希望统一管理技能库。
需要跨设备同步技能配置的团队或个人，确保工作环境一致。
喜欢从市场发现和安装新技能，并希望按项目或代理分组管理的进阶用户。

en.tag: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools
en.what: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more. It offers a unified skill library, marketplace browsing, preset grouping, and multi-device backup sync to help developers manage skills efficiently across tools.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-based desktop app source code, featuring modules for skill library, marketplace, presets, global/agent/project workspaces, backup and multi-device sync, along with demo screenshots and video introductions.
en.stack: Built primarily with Rust, likely using the Tauri framework for a cross-platform desktop app, supporting skill sources from Git repos, local folders, and archives.
en.hot: With the proliferation of AI coding tools, developers need unified skill management, and this app fills that gap. Gaining 60 stars today to reach 4060 total, it hit #9 on GitHub Trending (Rust daily), showing strong community interest.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor who want a unified skill library.
Teams or individuals needing to sync skill configurations across devices for consistent environments.
Advanced users who enjoy discovering and installing new skills from a marketplace and organizing them by project or agent.

zh.tag: Rust 编写的开源 2D/3D CAD 应用，支持 DWG/DXF
zh.what: Open CAD Studio 是一个用 Rust 构建的跨平台 CAD 应用，用于技术绘图、布局和实体建模。它原生读写 DWG 和 DXF 文件，无需转换服务，并提供桌面版和网页版。
zh.content: 仓库包含应用源码、多语言 README、网站资源（如 workspace 截图）和文档。核心功能包括精确 2D 绘图（线条、多段线、样条线、填充、对象捕捉等）和 3D 建模。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，利用 GPU 加速渲染，支持桌面和 Web 平台。依赖包括图形库和 CAD 文件格式处理库。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 生态中少有的 CAD 应用，它填补了开源 CAD 工具的空缺，且原生支持 DWG/DXF，吸引了大量关注。今日新增 13 星，总星数达 930，登上 Rust 趋势榜。
uses: 工程师和设计师需要免费、开源的 CAD 工具进行 2D 绘图和 3D 建模
开发者希望扩展或定制 CAD 功能，利用 Rust 的性能和安全性
教育机构用于教学 CAD 概念，无需商业软件许可

en.tag: Open-source 2D/3D CAD app in Rust with DWG/DXF support
en.what: Open CAD Studio is a cross-platform CAD application built with Rust for technical drawing, layout, and solid modeling. It natively reads and writes DWG and DXF files without conversion services, available on desktop and web.
en.content: The repository includes application source code, multilingual READMEs, website assets (like workspace screenshot), and docs. Core features include precise 2D drafting (lines, polylines, splines, hatches, object snaps, etc.) and 3D modeling.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging GPU-accelerated rendering, supporting desktop and web platforms. Dependencies include graphics libraries and CAD file format handling libraries.
en.hot: As a rare CAD application in the Rust ecosystem, it fills a gap in open-source CAD tools with native DWG/DXF support, attracting significant attention. With 13 new stars today and 930 total, it hit the Rust trending list.
uses: Engineers and designers needing a free, open-source CAD tool for 2D drafting and 3D modeling
Developers looking to extend or customize CAD functionality, leveraging Rust's performance and safety
Educational institutions teaching CAD concepts without commercial software licenses

zh.tag: 跨平台实时3D重建引擎，基于高斯泼溅
zh.what: Brush 是一个使用高斯泼溅技术的 3D 重建引擎，支持在 macOS、Windows、Linux、Android 及浏览器上运行。它利用 WebGPU 和 Burn 机器学习框架，实现无需依赖的二进制文件，并支持实时交互训练与查看。
zh.content: 仓库包含训练器、查看器、CLI 工具，支持 COLMAP 和 Nerfstudio 格式数据，可加载 .ply 和 .compressed.ply 文件，并支持 URL 流式加载和 4D 动画。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 WebGPU 和 Burn 机器学习框架，支持跨平台（包括移动端和浏览器）。
zh.hot: Brush 因打破传统 ML 工具在实时渲染中的限制而受到关注，提供无需 CUDA 依赖的轻量级解决方案，在 GitHub 上获得近 5000 星，并登上 Rust 趋势榜。
uses: 3D 重建爱好者和研究者，希望快速在本地或浏览器中训练和查看高斯泼溅模型。
需要跨平台部署 3D 应用的开发者，避免 CUDA 依赖和复杂环境配置。
对实时渲染和机器学习结合感兴趣的图形程序员，可探索交互式训练和可视化。

en.tag: Cross-platform real-time 3D reconstruction engine using Gaussian splatting
en.what: Brush is a 3D reconstruction engine using Gaussian splatting, running on macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, and in the browser. It leverages WebGPU and the Burn ML framework to produce dependency-free binaries and supports real-time interactive training and viewing.
en.content: The repository includes a trainer, viewer, and CLI tool, supporting COLMAP and Nerfstudio formats, loading .ply and .compressed.ply files, with URL streaming and 4D animation support.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging WebGPU and the Burn ML framework, with cross-platform support including mobile and browser.
en.hot: Brush gains attention for overcoming ML tool limitations in real-time rendering, offering a lightweight CUDA-free solution, with nearly 5k stars and trending on GitHub's Rust list.
uses: 3D reconstruction enthusiasts and researchers who want to quickly train and view Gaussian splatting models locally or in the browser.
Developers needing cross-platform 3D apps without CUDA dependencies and complex setup.
Graphics programmers interested in combining ML with real-time rendering for interactive training and visualization.

zh.tag: 基于 Nix 的快速声明式开发环境工具
zh.what: devenv 是一个基于 Nix 的开发环境管理工具，提供快速、声明式、可复现且可组合的开发环境。它通过 Nix 语言定义环境，支持 50+ 语言、10 万+ 包和 40+ 服务，并带有终端 UI、原生 shell 重载和即时环境等特性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 devenv 的 Rust 实现、CLI 工具、终端 UI、LSP 支持（devenv.nix 的自动补全和悬停文档）、进程管理器，以及丰富的文档和示例配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Nix 和 Nixpkgs，支持 Linux、macOS、x64、ARM64（含 WSL2）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 42 星，总星数 7409，位列 Rust 日榜第 12。其即时环境（缓存后 <100ms）和终端 UI 等特性吸引了大量开发者，成为 Nix 生态中备受欢迎的开发环境工具。
uses: 希望用声明式配置统一团队开发环境的开发者，可复现且易分享。
需要快速切换多种语言或服务（如 PostgreSQL、Redis）的开发者，devenv 提供一键集成。
对 Nix 感兴趣但希望降低学习曲线的用户，devenv 提供更友好的 CLI 和 LSP 支持。

en.tag: Fast, declarative, reproducible dev environments powered by Nix
en.what: devenv is a Nix-based developer environment manager that provides fast, declarative, reproducible, and composable environments. It defines environments in Nix, supports 50+ languages, 100,000+ packages, and 40+ services, with features like terminal UI, native shell reloading, and instant environments.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust implementation of devenv, CLI tool, terminal UI, LSP support for devenv.nix (autocomplete, hover docs), a process manager, and extensive documentation and example configs.
en.stack: Written in Rust, relies on Nix and Nixpkgs, supports Linux, macOS, x64, ARM64 (including WSL2).
en.hot: Gained 42 stars today, total 7409, ranked #12 on Rust daily trending. Its instant environments (<100ms after caching) and terminal UI attract many developers, making it a popular dev environment tool in the Nix ecosystem.
uses: Developers who want to unify team dev environments with declarative configs, reproducible and shareable.
Developers needing to quickly switch between languages or services (e.g., PostgreSQL, Redis) with one-command integration.
Users interested in Nix but wanting a gentler learning curve, thanks to devenv's friendly CLI and LSP support.

zh.tag: AI 代理与 MCP 服务器的下一代代理网关
zh.what: Agentgateway 是一个开源的代理网关，基于 MCP 和 A2A 协议，为 AI 代理提供安全的连接、可观测性和治理能力。它支持代理与 LLM、工具以及代理之间的通信，兼容各种框架和环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心代理服务、LLM 网关、MCP 网关、A2A 网关、推理路由等模块，以及架构图、视频介绍和完整的文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 MCP 和 A2A 协议，支持 OpenAI 兼容 API、多种传输方式（stdio/HTTP/SSE/Streamable HTTP）和 OAuth 认证。
zh.hot: 作为首个完整的 Agentic AI 连接解决方案，它填补了代理安全与治理的空白，在 Rust 社区迅速走红，今日新增 25 星，总星数达 4564。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要统一管理 LLM 调用、工具集成和代理间通信的团队。
企业平台团队：希望为代理通信添加安全、可观测性和治理能力的基础设施工程师。
MCP 服务器维护者：需要将 MCP 工具安全暴露给多个代理的场景。

en.tag: Next-gen proxy gateway for AI agents and MCP servers
en.what: Agentgateway is an open-source proxy built on MCP and A2A protocols, providing drop-in security, observability, and governance for agent-to-LLM, agent-to-tool, and agent-to-agent communication across any framework and environment.
en.content: The repository includes core proxy services, LLM gateway, MCP gateway, A2A gateway, inference routing modules, along with architecture diagrams, intro video, and comprehensive documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging MCP and A2A protocols, supporting OpenAI-compatible API, multiple transports (stdio/HTTP/SSE/Streamable HTTP), and OAuth authentication.
en.hot: As the first complete connectivity solution for Agentic AI, it fills the gap in agent security and governance, rapidly gaining popularity in the Rust community with 25 stars today and 4564 total.
uses: AI agent developers: teams needing unified management of LLM calls, tool integration, and agent-to-agent communication.
Enterprise platform teams: infrastructure engineers looking to add security, observability, and governance to agent communications.
MCP server maintainers: scenarios requiring secure exposure of MCP tools to multiple agents.

zh.tag: 自建私有搜索引擎，索引浏览记录与本地文件
zh.what: Hister 是一个注重隐私的搜索引擎，可以索引你访问过的网页和本地文件的内容，支持全文搜索。它提供 Web 界面、终端界面和 MCP 接口，方便你随时找回信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web UI（基于 Svelte）、浏览器扩展（Firefox/Chrome）以及终端客户端。支持多用户、语义搜索、爬虫和浏览器历史导入。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 CGO（需要 C 编译器），Web 前端使用 npm 和 Svelte。
zh.hot: 今日新增 142 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 4。在隐私担忧加剧的背景下，自托管搜索引擎需求上升，Hister 提供完整功能且易于部署。
uses: 注重隐私的个人用户，希望本地搜索自己的浏览历史和文件。
团队或组织，需要内部文档和网页的私有搜索解决方案。
开发者，希望集成 MCP 到 AI 助手，实现个性化信息检索。

en.tag: Self-hosted private search engine for your browsing history and local files
en.what: Hister is a privacy-focused search engine that indexes the full content of pages you visit and files you keep, enabling full-text search. It offers web, terminal, and MCP interfaces for easy information retrieval.
en.content: The repository includes a Go backend, a web UI (Svelte-based), browser extensions for Firefox/Chrome, and a terminal client. It supports multi-user, semantic search, crawler, and browser history import.
en.stack: Primarily Go, with CGO dependencies (requires C compiler), and npm/Svelte for the web frontend.
en.hot: Gained 142 stars today, ranking #4 on Go trending. Amid growing privacy concerns, self-hosted search engines are in demand, and Hister offers full features with easy deployment.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want to search their browsing history and files locally.
Teams or organizations needing a private search solution for internal documents and web pages.
Developers who want to integrate MCP into AI assistants for personalized information retrieval.

zh.tag: 可编程的异构LLM推理路由层，构建混合模型系统
zh.what: vLLM Semantic Router 是一个可编程的路由层，用于在异构 LLM 基础设施上构建 Mixture-of-Models 系统。它评估请求信号、用户偏好和应用策略，为每个请求选择或组合合适的模型路径，从而在不硬编码路由逻辑的情况下优化质量、成本、延迟、隐私和安全性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的路由器核心、安装脚本、文档站点（website/）、以及示例和配置。提供在线 Playground 和 Hugging Face 集成，支持 v0.3 Themis 等版本发布。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 vLLM 生态，可能集成 Hugging Face 模型和云/边缘计算资源。
zh.hot: 随着 LLM 应用多样化，对混合模型路由的需求增长，该仓库提供可编程路由方案，今日新增 28 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 3 名。
uses: 需要优化 LLM 推理成本与延迟的工程团队，通过路由策略动态选择模型。
构建多模型系统（MoM）的开发者，希望根据请求内容智能组合模型输出。
关注数据隐私的企业，利用路由将敏感数据保留在本地或私有云。
研究人员探索信号驱动的路由算法，可基于此进行实验和扩展。

en.tag: Programmable routing layer for heterogeneous LLM inference to build Mixture-of-Models systems
en.what: vLLM Semantic Router is a programmable routing layer for building Mixture-of-Models systems across heterogeneous LLM infrastructure. It evaluates request signals, user preferences, and application policies to select or compose the right model path for each request, improving quality, cost, latency, privacy, and safety without hard-coding routing logic.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based router core, installation scripts, documentation site (website/), examples, and configurations. It offers an online Playground and Hugging Face integration, with releases like v0.3 Themis.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the vLLM ecosystem, with potential integrations with Hugging Face models and cloud/edge compute resources.
en.hot: As LLM applications diversify, the need for Mixture-of-Models routing grows; this repo offers a programmable solution, gaining 28 stars today and ranking #3 on Go trending.
uses: Engineering teams optimizing LLM inference cost and latency by dynamically routing requests to appropriate models.
Developers building Mixture-of-Models systems who want to intelligently compose model outputs based on request content.
Enterprises concerned with data privacy, using routing to keep sensitive data within local or private cloud boundaries.
Researchers exploring signal-driven routing algorithms, can experiment and extend based on this project.

zh.tag: 用 Go 和 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用
zh.what: Wails 是一个用 Go 和 Web 技术构建桌面应用的框架。它允许开发者将 Go 后端和 Web 前端打包成单个二进制文件，无需内置 Web 服务器。它简化了项目创建、编译和打包流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架源码、文档、示例、CLI 工具，以及多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，前端支持任意 Web 技术（如 React、Vue、Svelte），依赖系统 WebView。
zh.hot: Wails 提供了一种轻量级替代 Electron 的方案，用 Go 编写后端，性能好且打包体积小，因此受到 Go 开发者欢迎。
uses: Go 开发者希望用熟悉语言构建桌面应用
需要轻量级、高性能桌面应用的项目
希望复用 Web 前端技能但避免 Electron 臃肿的团队

en.tag: Build cross-platform desktop apps with Go and web tech
en.what: Wails is a framework for building desktop applications using Go and web technologies. It allows developers to bundle a Go backend and a web frontend into a single binary, eliminating the need for a built-in web server. It simplifies project creation, compilation, and bundling.
en.content: The repository contains framework source code, documentation, examples, CLI tools, and multi-language READMEs.
en.stack: Primarily Go, frontend supports any web technology (React, Vue, Svelte), relies on system WebView.
en.hot: Wails offers a lightweight alternative to Electron with a Go backend, better performance and smaller binaries, making it popular among Go developers.
uses: Go developers who want to build desktop apps in their familiar language
Projects needing lightweight, high-performance desktop applications
Teams wanting to reuse web frontend skills without Electron's bloat

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供持久化结构化记忆的分布式图式问题追踪器
zh.what: Beads 是一个为 AI 编码代理设计的分布式图式问题追踪器，提供持久化、结构化的记忆。它用依赖感知的图取代混乱的 Markdown 计划，帮助代理处理长周期任务而不丢失上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Beads CLI 工具源码、安装脚本、文档以及多种代理集成（如 Codex CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等）。用户通过 `bd` 命令初始化项目、创建/关闭问题、同步远程代理。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 开发，底层依赖 Dolt（分布式版本化数据库）实现图存储和同步。支持通过 npm 和 PyPI 安装 MCP 相关包。
zh.hot: GitHub 日增 95 星，总星数 25601，位列 Go 语言日榜第 11。AI 编码代理的持久记忆需求旺盛，Beads 以轻量 CLI 和分布式图方案解决痛点。
uses: AI 编码代理开发者 —— 为代理提供持久化记忆和任务管理
使用 Codex CLI、Claude Code 等工具的开发者 —— 集成 Beads 以提升长周期任务处理能力
团队协作场景 —— 多代理通过 Dolt 同步工作状态和依赖图

en.tag: A distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents with persistent structured memory
en.what: Beads is a distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents, providing persistent structured memory. It replaces messy markdown plans with a dependency-aware graph, helping agents handle long-horizon tasks without losing context.
en.content: The repo contains the Beads CLI tool source code, installation scripts, documentation, and integrations for various agents (Codex CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Users interact via `bd` commands to init projects, create/close issues, and sync with remote agents.
en.stack: Built with Go, leveraging Dolt (distributed versioned database) for graph storage and sync. Also provides npm and PyPI packages for MCP integration.
en.hot: Gaining 95 stars daily, total 25601, ranking #11 on Go daily trending. The demand for persistent memory in AI coding agents is high, and Beads addresses it with a lightweight CLI and distributed graph approach.
uses: AI coding agent developers — provide persistent memory and task management for agents
Developers using Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc. — integrate Beads to improve long-horizon task handling
Team collaboration — multiple agents sync work status and dependency graph via Dolt

zh.tag: Docker 官方 AI 代理构建器，YAML 声明式多代理编排
zh.what: docker-agent 是 Docker 推出的 CLI 插件，允许用户通过简单的 YAML 配置创建和运行 AI 代理，无需编写代码。它支持多代理协作、丰富的工具生态（包括 MCP 服务器）以及多种 AI 提供商，并能将代理打包分享到 OCI 注册表。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 插件源码、示例配置（examples/）、文档（docs/）以及演示 GIF。核心是解析 YAML 配置并调度代理执行，内置工具集和 MCP 集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Docker CLI 插件机制、MCP（Model Context Protocol）客户端、OCI 分发规范，以及多个 AI 提供商 SDK（OpenAI、Anthropic 等）。
zh.hot: Docker 官方出品，与 Docker Desktop 深度集成，零门槛上手；star 数 3293 且登上 Go 趋势榜，说明开发者对 AI 代理工具链兴趣浓厚。
uses: 开发者快速搭建自动化任务代理，如网页搜索、信息整理等
团队通过 YAML 共享和版本化代理配置，实现协作与复用
希望本地运行 AI 代理（配合 Docker Model Runner）的用户
需要多代理分工解决复杂问题的场景，如研究、报告生成

en.tag: Docker's official AI agent builder: declarative YAML, multi-agent orchestration
en.what: docker-agent is a Docker CLI plugin that lets users create and run AI agents via simple YAML configs, no coding required. It supports multi-agent collaboration, a rich tool ecosystem (including MCP servers), and multiple AI providers, and can package and share agents to OCI registries.
en.content: The repo contains Go source for the CLI plugin, example configs (examples/), docs (docs/), and a demo GIF. It parses YAML configs and orchestrates agents, with built-in tools and MCP integration.
en.stack: Primarily Go, leveraging Docker CLI plugin mechanism, MCP client, OCI distribution spec, and multiple AI provider SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
en.hot: Official Docker product, deeply integrated with Docker Desktop, zero learning curve; 3.3k stars and trending in Go, showing strong developer interest in AI agent tooling.
uses: Developers quickly building automated task agents, e.g., web search, info aggregation
Teams sharing and versioning agent configs in YAML for collaboration and reuse
Users wanting to run AI agents locally with Docker Model Runner
Scenarios needing multi-agent division of labor for complex tasks like research and report generation

zh.tag: Kubernetes 上的 AI 代理沙箱编排器
zh.what: agent-sandbox 是一个 Kubernetes 控制器，通过自定义资源定义（CRD）管理隔离的、有状态的、单例工作负载。它特别适合 AI 代理运行时和强化学习等场景，提供稳定的身份和持久化存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心的 Sandbox CRD 和控制器，以及扩展模块，如 SandboxTemplate、SandboxClaim 和 SandboxWarmPool，用于模板化、声明和预热沙箱池。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言，使用 Kubernetes 的 controller-runtime 和 client-go 构建，支持通过 RuntimeClass 集成 gVisor 或 Kata Containers 等安全沙箱运行时。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理的兴起，对隔离、有状态运行时的需求激增。该项目由 Kubernetes SIG 官方维护，提供标准化 API，star 数已达 3623，并登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为每个代理提供隔离的、有状态的运行环境，支持持久化和稳定网络身份。
强化学习研究：管理需要长时间运行、状态保持的仿真环境或训练任务。
平台工程师：在 Kubernetes 上提供轻量级、单容器 VM 体验，简化工作负载管理。

en.tag: Kubernetes-native sandbox orchestrator for AI agents
en.what: agent-sandbox is a Kubernetes controller that manages isolated, stateful, singleton workloads via a custom resource definition (CRD). It is ideal for AI agent runtimes and reinforcement learning, providing stable identity and persistent storage.
en.content: The repository contains the core Sandbox CRD and controller, plus extensions like SandboxTemplate, SandboxClaim, and SandboxWarmPool for templating, claiming, and pre-warming sandbox pools.
en.stack: Built with Go, using Kubernetes controller-runtime and client-go, with support for secure sandbox runtimes like gVisor or Kata Containers via RuntimeClass.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents, demand for isolated, stateful runtimes has surged. Officially maintained by Kubernetes SIG, it offers a standardized API, reaching 3623 stars and trending on GitHub.
uses: AI agent developers: provide isolated, stateful runtime for each agent with persistence and stable network identity.
Reinforcement learning researchers: manage long-running, stateful simulation environments or training tasks.
Platform engineers: offer a lightweight, single-container VM experience on Kubernetes, simplifying workload management.

zh.tag: 全能安全扫描器，覆盖容器、K8s、代码与云
zh.what: Trivy 是一个综合性的安全扫描器，能够检测容器镜像、文件系统、Git 仓库、虚拟机镜像和 Kubernetes 集群中的安全漏洞、错误配置、密钥、SBOM 和软件许可证。它支持多种编程语言、操作系统和平台，是 DevSecOps 中广泛使用的工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Trivy 的源代码、文档、示例和集成配置，如 GitHub Actions、Kubernetes Operator 和 VS Code 插件。还提供 canary 构建版本，用于测试最新功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种开源库，支持通过 Docker、Homebrew 和二进制文件分发。
zh.hot: Trivy 拥有 37k+ 星标，因其全面的扫描能力和易用性而广受欢迎。今日新增 21 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 17 名，持续获得开发者关注。
uses: DevSecOps 工程师：在 CI/CD 流水线中集成 Trivy，自动扫描容器镜像和代码仓库，确保部署安全。
Kubernetes 管理员：使用 trivy k8s 命令扫描集群，发现配置错误和漏洞，提升集群安全性。
安全团队：利用 Trivy 进行漏洞管理和合规检查，生成 SBOM 和许可证报告，满足审计要求。

en.tag: All-in-one security scanner for containers, K8s, code, and cloud
en.what: Trivy is a comprehensive security scanner that detects vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, secrets, SBOM, and software licenses across container images, filesystems, Git repositories, VM images, and Kubernetes clusters. It supports a wide range of programming languages, OSes, and platforms, making it a staple in DevSecOps.
en.content: The repository contains Trivy's source code, documentation, examples, and integration configurations like GitHub Actions, Kubernetes Operator, and VS Code plugin. It also provides canary builds for testing the latest features.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging various open-source libraries, and distributed via Docker, Homebrew, and binaries.
en.hot: With 37k+ stars, Trivy is popular for its comprehensive scanning capabilities and ease of use. Gaining 21 stars today, it ranks #17 on the Go trending list, showing sustained developer interest.
uses: DevSecOps engineers: Integrate Trivy into CI/CD pipelines to automatically scan container images and code repos, ensuring deployment security.
Kubernetes administrators: Use 'trivy k8s' to scan clusters for misconfigurations and vulnerabilities, enhancing cluster security.
Security teams: Leverage Trivy for vulnerability management and compliance checks, generating SBOM and license reports for audits.

zh.tag: Kubernetes 声明式 GitOps 持续交付工具
zh.what: Argo CD 是一个基于 GitOps 理念的 Kubernetes 持续交付工具，通过 Git 仓库作为应用定义、配置和环境的唯一事实来源，实现声明式部署和生命周期管理。它自动化应用部署流程，确保集群状态与 Git 中期望状态一致，并提供审计和可视化界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Argo CD 的完整源代码，包括 API server、控制器、CLI、UI 组件，以及文档、示例和 Helm chart。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes API、gRPC、Redis 等，支持 Helm、Kustomize 等配置管理工具。
zh.hot: Argo CD 是 GitOps 领域的标杆项目，拥有 24k+ stars，被众多企业和组织采用，社区活跃，持续更新。
uses: 平台工程团队：通过 GitOps 实践简化 Kubernetes 应用交付和合规审计。
DevOps 工程师：自动化部署流程，实现多环境一致性和快速回滚。
需要多集群管理的组织：集中管理多个 Kubernetes 集群的应用状态。

en.tag: Declarative GitOps continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes
en.what: Argo CD is a declarative GitOps continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes, using Git repositories as the single source of truth for application definitions, configurations, and environments. It automates application deployment and lifecycle management, ensuring cluster state matches the desired state in Git, with auditing and a UI.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Argo CD, including API server, controller, CLI, UI components, along with documentation, examples, and Helm charts.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging Kubernetes API, gRPC, Redis, and supporting configuration management tools like Helm and Kustomize.
en.hot: Argo CD is a benchmark in GitOps, with 24k+ stars, adopted by many enterprises and organizations, active community, and continuous updates.
uses: Platform engineering teams: simplify Kubernetes application delivery and compliance auditing via GitOps practices.
DevOps engineers: automate deployment processes, achieve multi-environment consistency and fast rollbacks.
Organizations needing multi-cluster management: centrally manage application state across multiple Kubernetes clusters.

zh.tag: 云原生 AI 原生 API 网关，支持 MCP 托管与多模型代理
zh.what: Higress 是一个基于 Istio 和 Envoy 的云原生 API 网关，专为 AI 场景设计。它支持通过 Go/Rust/JS 编写 Wasm 插件进行扩展，并提供开箱即用的控制台。其 AI 网关能力支持国内外主流模型提供商，并可通过插件机制托管 MCP 服务器，使 AI 代理能够轻松调用各种工具和服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Higress 的源代码、文档、示例和插件市场。核心组件包括基于 Envoy 的网关引擎、Wasm 插件运行时、控制台界面以及丰富的预置插件（如 AI 代理、限流、认证等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 Istio 和 Envoy 构建，支持 Wasm 插件（Go/Rust/JS）。依赖 Kubernetes 生态，提供 Helm 部署方式。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF Sandbox 项目，Higress 在 AI 网关领域迅速走红，凭借对 MCP 的原生支持和多模型代理能力，吸引了大量开发者。目前 Star 数已达 9220，今日新增 22，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 10 名。
uses: AI 应用开发者：需要统一接入多个大模型提供商，简化 API 管理和成本控制。
平台工程师：希望为微服务和 AI 服务提供高性能、可扩展的 API 网关，并支持 Wasm 插件定制。
MCP 服务提供者：需要快速将工具或服务暴露为 MCP 服务器，供 AI 代理调用。

en.tag: Cloud-native AI-native API gateway with MCP hosting and multi-provider AI proxy
en.what: Higress is a cloud-native API gateway based on Istio and Envoy, designed for AI scenarios. It can be extended with Wasm plugins written in Go/Rust/JS and provides an out-of-the-box console. Its AI gateway capabilities support all mainstream model providers, and it can host MCP servers via plugins, enabling AI agents to easily call various tools and services.
en.content: The repository contains Higress source code, documentation, examples, and a plugin hub. Core components include the Envoy-based gateway engine, Wasm plugin runtime, console UI, and dozens of ready-to-use plugins (e.g., AI proxy, rate limiting, authentication).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, built on Istio and Envoy, with Wasm plugin support (Go/Rust/JS). It leverages the Kubernetes ecosystem and offers Helm deployment.
en.hot: As a CNCF Sandbox project, Higress has gained rapid popularity in the AI gateway space, thanks to its native MCP support and multi-provider AI proxy capabilities. With 9,220 stars and 22 added today, it ranks #10 on the Go trending list.
uses: AI application developers: need to unify access to multiple LLM providers, simplifying API management and cost control.
Platform engineers: want a high-performance, scalable API gateway for microservices and AI services, with Wasm plugin customization.
MCP service providers: need to quickly expose tools or services as MCP servers for AI agents to call.

zh.tag: GitHub 官方 MCP 服务器，让 AI 直接操作仓库与工作流
zh.what: GitHub MCP Server 是 GitHub 官方推出的模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，让 AI 代理、助手和聊天机器人能够通过自然语言直接访问 GitHub 平台。它支持读取仓库和代码文件、管理 issue 和 PR、分析代码以及自动化工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 MCP 服务器实现，提供远程托管版本和本地运行版本，支持 VS Code、Claude Desktop、Cursor 等客户端。文档涵盖安装、配置、策略治理以及多种用例（如仓库管理、issue/PR 自动化、CI/CD 洞察、代码分析、团队协作）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 GitHub REST API 和 MCP SDK。支持远程 HTTP 端点（api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/）和本地二进制运行。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 官方项目，star 数已超 3.2 万，今日新增 36，登上 Go 语言趋势榜。它填补了 AI 工具与 GitHub 深度集成的空白，是开发者将 AI 接入开发工作流的关键桥梁。
uses: 开发者希望让 AI 助手直接操作 GitHub 仓库、issue 和 PR，提升日常开发效率。
团队利用 AI 自动化代码审查、CI/CD 监控和依赖安全告警分析。
AI 工具开发者需要将 GitHub 上下文集成到自定义代理或聊天机器人中。

en.tag: GitHub's official MCP server connecting AI tools to repositories, issues, PRs, and workflows
en.what: The GitHub MCP Server is GitHub's official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI agents, assistants, and chatbots to interact with GitHub directly via natural language. It allows reading repositories and code files, managing issues and PRs, analyzing code, and automating workflows.
en.content: The repository contains a Go implementation of the MCP server, offering both a remotely hosted version and a local version, compatible with clients like VS Code, Claude Desktop, and Cursor. Documentation covers installation, configuration, policies and governance, and various use cases such as repository management, issue/PR automation, CI/CD insights, code analysis, and team collaboration.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging the GitHub REST API and MCP SDK. Supports both a remote HTTP endpoint (api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/) and a local binary.
en.hot: As an official GitHub project, it has amassed over 32.5k stars with 36 new stars today, ranking 11th on the Go trending list. It fills the gap for deep AI-GitHub integration, serving as a critical bridge for developers to connect AI to their development workflows.
uses: Developers who want AI assistants to directly interact with GitHub repositories, issues, and PRs to boost daily productivity.
Teams leveraging AI to automate code review, CI/CD monitoring, and dependency security alert analysis.
AI tool builders needing to integrate GitHub context into custom agents or chatbots.

zh.tag: MySQL 水平扩展的云原生数据库集群系统
zh.what: Vitess 是一个围绕 MySQL 构建的云原生、可水平扩展的分布式数据库系统。它通过通用分片实现无限扩展，使应用代码和数据库查询无需感知数据在多个数据库服务器上的分布。Vitess 支持按需拆分和合并分片，原子切换只需几秒。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Vitess 的核心源码、文档、示例和工具，涵盖 vttablet、vtgate 等组件，以及 Kubernetes 部署配置和客户端库。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 gRPC、Kubernetes 等云原生技术，支持 MySQL 协议。
zh.hot: Vitess 源自 YouTube，支撑其数万个 MySQL 节点，并被 Slack、Square、京东等大厂采用，是 MySQL 水平扩展的成熟解决方案，今日新增 9 星，稳居趋势榜。
uses: 大规模 MySQL 集群需要水平扩展的数据库管理员和架构师
在 Kubernetes 上运行云原生数据库的 DevOps 和平台工程师
需要将单体 MySQL 拆分为分片架构的应用开发团队

en.tag: Cloud-native database clustering system for horizontal scaling of MySQL
en.what: Vitess is a cloud-native, horizontally scalable distributed database system built around MySQL. It achieves unlimited scaling through generalized sharding, keeping application code and queries agnostic to data distribution. It allows splitting and merging shards with atomic cutover in seconds.
en.content: The repository contains core source code, docs, examples, and tools, including components like vttablet and vtgate, along with Kubernetes deployment configs and client libraries.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging gRPC and Kubernetes, with MySQL protocol support.
en.hot: Originating from YouTube and powering tens of thousands of MySQL nodes, Vitess is adopted by Slack, Square, JD.com, etc. It's a mature solution for MySQL scaling, with 9 stars today, trending steadily.
uses: DBAs and architects needing horizontal scaling for large MySQL deployments
DevOps and platform engineers running cloud-native databases on Kubernetes
Application teams looking to shard monolithic MySQL into distributed architecture

zh.tag: Kubernetes 与多云成本监控的开源工具
zh.what: OpenCost 是一个开源的成本监控工具，帮助团队实时查看 Kubernetes 工作负载和多云环境的历史与当前支出及资源分配情况。它基于一个规范说明和 Go 语言实现，提供成本透明性，支持多应用、多团队、多部门等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的核心服务、规范说明文档、用于演示的 UI 组件（实际 UI 在单独仓库），以及 Helm 图表用于安装。支持通过 /metrics 端点导出数据到 Prometheus，并集成 AWS、Azure、GCP 的计费 API 进行动态定价。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes API、云提供商计费 API（AWS、Azure、GCP），支持 Prometheus 集成，并提供 Helm 图表进行部署。
zh.hot: 随着云成本管理日益重要，OpenCost 作为开源解决方案受到关注，当前拥有 6708 星，今日新增 5 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 13 名。其功能包括 AI 推理成本追踪等新特性，吸引了大量用户。
uses: Kubernetes 平台团队：用于监控集群资源成本，优化资源分配和预算管理。
财务或运维人员：需要跨云（AWS、Azure、GCP）统一查看云支出，进行成本分析和报告。
使用 vLLM 部署 AI 模型的企业：追踪推理成本，包括每百万 token 的费用和共享基础设施分摊。
对成本透明性有要求的组织：支持多团队、多部门成本分摊，便于内部计费和治理。

en.tag: Open-source cost monitoring for Kubernetes and multi-cloud
en.what: OpenCost is an open-source cost monitoring tool that gives teams visibility into current and historical Kubernetes and cloud spend and resource allocation. It combines a specification with a Go implementation, providing cost transparency for environments supporting multiple applications, teams, and departments.
en.content: The repository contains the Go implementation of the core service, specification docs, UI components for demonstration (actual UI in separate repo), and Helm charts for installation. It supports exporting data to Prometheus via /metrics endpoint and integrates with AWS, Azure, and GCP billing APIs for dynamic pricing.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it depends on Kubernetes APIs, cloud provider billing APIs (AWS, Azure, GCP), supports Prometheus integration, and provides Helm charts for deployment.
en.hot: As cloud cost management becomes crucial, OpenCost gains attention as an open-source solution, currently with 6708 stars and 5 new stars today, ranking 13th on the Go trending list. Its features like AI inference cost tracking attract many users.
uses: Kubernetes platform teams: monitor cluster resource costs, optimize allocation and budget management.
Finance or operations staff: need unified view of cloud spend across AWS, Azure, GCP for cost analysis and reporting.
Enterprises deploying AI models with vLLM: track inference costs, including per-million-token fees and shared infrastructure attribution.
Organizations requiring cost transparency: support multi-team, multi-department cost allocation for internal billing and governance.

zh.tag: Docker 官方命令行工具，容器操作的核心入口
zh.what: docker/cli 是 Docker 的命令行客户端，用于构建、运行和管理容器镜像与容器。它提供了丰富的子命令，如 build、run、push、pull 等，是开发者与 Docker 引擎交互的主要方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 的完整源代码、文档、构建脚本（如 buildx bake）以及测试套件。目录结构清晰，分为 cli、cmd、vendor 等，支持跨平台构建和多种构建模式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Docker Engine API 和 Cobra 命令行框架。构建工具采用 Docker Buildx，支持多平台交叉编译。
zh.hot: 作为 Docker 官方 CLI，拥有稳定的用户基础和持续更新，今日新增 5 星，总星数 6029，在 Go 趋势榜上位列第 14，热度源于其核心地位和日常高频使用。
uses: 开发者和运维人员日常管理容器、镜像、网络和卷。
CI/CD 流水线中自动化构建、推送和部署容器化应用。
学习 Docker 和容器技术的入门工具，官方文档和示例丰富。

en.tag: Official Docker CLI, the core entry for container operations
en.what: docker/cli is the command-line client for Docker, used to build, run, and manage container images and containers. It provides a rich set of subcommands like build, run, push, pull, etc., serving as the primary way developers interact with the Docker engine.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the CLI, documentation, build scripts (e.g., buildx bake), and test suites. The directory structure is clear, with cli, cmd, vendor, etc., supporting cross-platform builds and multiple build modes.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on Docker Engine API and the Cobra command-line framework. Build tooling uses Docker Buildx, supporting multi-platform cross-compilation.
en.hot: As the official Docker CLI, it has a stable user base and continuous updates, with 5 new stars today and a total of 6029 stars, ranking 14th on the Go trending list. Its popularity stems from its core role and high-frequency daily usage.
uses: Developers and ops engineers manage containers, images, networks, and volumes daily.
Automate building, pushing, and deploying containerized apps in CI/CD pipelines.
A learning tool for Docker and container technology, with rich official docs and examples.

zh.tag: 官方飞书 CLI，为人类和 AI 代理打造，覆盖 200+ 命令
zh.what: 这是飞书官方推出的命令行工具，旨在让用户和 AI 代理都能通过终端高效操作飞书。它覆盖消息、文档、多维表格、日历、邮件等 18 个业务领域，提供 200 多个命令和 26 个 AI 代理技能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 主程序、26 个 AI 代理技能（skills/ 目录）、扩展包（extension/）以及详细的文档和安装指南。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 1.23+ 开发，同时提供 npm 包（@larksuite/cli）方便安装。依赖飞书开放平台 API，支持多种认证方式。
zh.hot: 凭借官方身份、AI 原生设计和 200+ 命令的全面覆盖，在 GitHub 上获得 16777 星，今日新增 31 星，登上 Go 语言趋势榜。
uses: 个人开发者：在终端中快速管理飞书消息、文档和日程，提升日常工作效率。
AI 代理开发者：利用内置的 26 个技能，让代理无需额外配置即可操作飞书。
企业 IT/ISV：通过 extension/ 包将 lark-cli 嵌入自有代理或平台，实现集中凭证管理和审计。

en.tag: Official Lark/Feishu CLI for humans and AI agents, 200+ commands
en.what: This is the official command-line tool for Lark/Feishu, designed to let both humans and AI agents operate Lark efficiently from the terminal. It covers 18 business domains including Messenger, Docs, Base, Calendar, Mail, and more, with 200+ commands and 26 AI agent skills.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based CLI main program, 26 AI agent skills (in skills/), extension packages (in extension/), and detailed documentation and installation guides.
en.stack: Built with Go 1.23+, also distributed as an npm package (@larksuite/cli). It relies on the Lark Open Platform API and supports multiple authentication methods.
en.hot: With its official status, agent-native design, and comprehensive coverage of 200+ commands, it has gained 16,777 stars on GitHub, with 31 new stars today, ranking on the Go trending list.
uses: Individual developers: quickly manage Lark messages, docs, and calendar from the terminal to boost daily productivity.
AI agent developers: leverage the 26 built-in skills to enable agents to operate Lark with zero extra setup.
Enterprise IT/ISV: embed lark-cli into their own agents or platforms via extension/ packages for centralized credential management and auditing.

zh.tag: Go 语言终极 LLM/AI 应用开发框架
zh.what: Eino 是一个基于 Go 的 LLM 应用开发框架，借鉴了 LangChain 和 Google ADK 等，遵循 Go 惯例。它提供组件、代理开发工具包（ADK）和组合能力，用于构建 AI 代理和复杂工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架代码，提供组件（如 ChatModel、Tool、Retriever）、ADK（支持工具调用、多代理协调、上下文管理、中断/恢复等），以及图和工作流组合能力。还包含示例和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言，依赖 OpenAI、Ollama 等模型提供商的官方实现，以及 eino-ext 和 eino-examples 等扩展仓库。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 生态中少有的 LLM 应用开发框架，Eino 填补了空白，star 数已达 1.28 万，今日新增 18，登上 Go 趋势榜。
uses: Go 开发者想要构建 LLM 应用或 AI 代理，但不想用 Python 框架。
需要高性能、可组合的 AI 工作流，并希望深度集成 Go 生态。
研究 LangChain 或 ADK 但偏好 Go 语言惯例的开发者。

en.tag: The ultimate LLM/AI application development framework in Go
en.what: Eino is a Go-based LLM application development framework, drawing from LangChain and Google ADK, designed to follow Go conventions. It provides components, an Agent Development Kit (ADK), and composition capabilities for building AI agents and complex workflows.
en.content: The repository contains the core framework code, offering components (like ChatModel, Tool, Retriever), ADK (with tool use, multi-agent coordination, context management, interrupt/resume), and graph/workflow composition. It also includes examples and documentation.
en.stack: Built on Go, with official implementations for model providers like OpenAI and Ollama, and relies on extension repos like eino-ext and eino-examples.
en.hot: As a rare LLM application development framework in the Go ecosystem, Eino fills a gap, with 12.8k stars and 18 new today, trending on Go.
uses: Go developers who want to build LLM apps or AI agents without using Python frameworks.
Those needing high-performance, composable AI workflows with deep Go integration.
Developers familiar with LangChain or ADK but preferring Go conventions.

zh.tag: 无守护进程的容器与 Pod 管理工具
zh.what: Podman 是一个用于管理 OCI 容器、镜像、卷和 Pod 的工具，基于 libpod 库实现容器生命周期管理。它支持 Linux，并可通过虚拟机在 Mac 和 Windows 上使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Podman CLI、libpod 库以及相关文档和 CI 配置。提供容器、Pod、镜像和卷的管理功能，支持 rootless 模式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 OCI 标准、conmon、runc 等底层组件，支持 systemd 集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Docker 的无守护进程替代方案，Podman 在云原生和容器安全领域备受关注，本月新增 396 星，总星数达 32704。
uses: 开发者和运维人员需要无守护进程、更安全的容器管理工具时
在 Kubernetes 环境中使用 Pod 概念管理容器组的场景
需要 rootless 容器运行以避免权限提升风险的场景

en.tag: Daemonless container and pod management tool
en.what: Podman is a tool for managing OCI containers, images, volumes, and pods, built on the libpod library for container lifecycle management. It runs on Linux and can be used on Mac and Windows via a Podman-managed VM.
en.content: The repository contains the Podman CLI, the libpod library, documentation, and CI configurations. It provides management for containers, pods, images, and volumes, with rootless support.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on OCI standards, conmon, runc, and other low-level components, with systemd integration.
en.hot: As a daemonless alternative to Docker, Podman gains attention in cloud-native and container security; it added 396 stars this month, reaching 32,704 total.
uses: For developers and operators needing a daemonless, more secure container management tool
For scenarios using Pod concepts to manage container groups in Kubernetes environments
For rootless container running to avoid privilege escalation risks

zh.tag: 高性能云原生向量数据库，支撑 AI 非结构化数据检索
zh.what: Milvus 是一个专为大规模向量相似性搜索设计的高性能向量数据库。它能够高效组织和检索文本、图像等多模态非结构化数据，为 AI 应用提供底层数据支撑。支持分布式部署与实时流式更新，可处理数十亿向量和数万级 QPS。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Milvus 的完整源代码，采用 Go 和 C++ 编写，提供 Standalone 单机模式和分布式集群模式，并包含 Milvus Lite 轻量版（可通过 pip 安装）以及云服务 Zilliz Cloud 的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 和 C++，利用 CPU/GPU 硬件加速实现高性能向量搜索，架构完全分布式且原生支持 Kubernetes，便于水平扩展。
zh.hot: Milvus 是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的向量数据库之一，拥有 45.8k 星标，今日新增 22 星并登上 Go 语言趋势榜。随着 AI 应用对向量检索需求的爆发，其高性能和云原生特性吸引了大量开发者。
uses: AI 应用开发者：构建 RAG、语义搜索、推荐系统等需要向量检索的功能。
数据工程师：管理大规模非结构化数据，实现实时流式更新和高效查询。
云原生架构师：在 Kubernetes 集群中部署可水平扩展的向量数据库服务。
机器学习工程师：利用 Milvus Lite 快速原型验证，或通过 Zilliz Cloud 免运维使用。

en.tag: High-performance cloud-native vector database for scalable AI search
en.what: Milvus is a high-performance vector database built for large-scale vector similarity search. It efficiently organizes and retrieves unstructured data like text, images, and multi-modal information, powering AI applications. It supports distributed deployment and real-time streaming updates, handling billions of vectors and tens of thousands of queries per second.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Milvus, written in Go and C++, offering Standalone mode for single-machine deployment and distributed cluster mode, along with Milvus Lite (pip installable) and integration with Zilliz Cloud managed service.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go and C++, leveraging CPU/GPU hardware acceleration for high-performance vector search. The architecture is fully distributed and K8s-native, enabling horizontal scaling.
en.hot: Milvus is one of the most popular vector databases on GitHub with 45.8k stars, gaining 22 stars today and trending in the Go category. The surge in AI applications requiring vector search has made its high performance and cloud-native features highly attractive.
uses: AI developers building RAG, semantic search, recommendation systems, and other vector-based features.
Data engineers managing large-scale unstructured data with real-time streaming updates and efficient queries.
Cloud-native architects deploying horizontally scalable vector databases on Kubernetes.
ML engineers prototyping quickly with Milvus Lite or using Zilliz Cloud for zero-ops managed service.

zh.tag: 行业标准容器运行时，强调简单、稳健与可移植性
zh.what: containerd 是一个行业标准的容器运行时，专注于简单性、健壮性和可移植性。它以守护进程形式运行于 Linux 和 Windows，管理宿主机上容器的完整生命周期，包括镜像传输与存储、容器执行与监督、底层存储与网络挂载等。它被设计为嵌入到更大的系统中，而不是直接供开发者或最终用户使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 containerd 的源代码、构建配置、文档（包括架构设计文档）以及 CI/CD 工作流。项目采用 Go 语言编写，并遵循 CNCF 的治理模型，包含多个子项目。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Linux/Windows 系统调用，并集成 CNCF 生态工具。构建系统支持 Makefile 和 GitHub Actions。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，containerd 是 Kubernetes 等主流平台的默认运行时，拥有 21168 颗星，持续获得社区关注。其稳定性与广泛采用使其成为容器基础设施的核心组件。
uses: 平台工程师：集成 containerd 以构建容器平台或 Kubernetes 节点，管理容器生命周期。
容器运行时开发者：基于 containerd 扩展或定制运行时功能，满足特定需求。
DevOps 团队：利用 containerd 的高效镜像管理和稳定运行，优化 CI/CD 流水线。
安全研究人员：审查和贡献安全补丁，参与 CNCF 安全顾问团队。

en.tag: Industry-standard container runtime emphasizing simplicity, robustness, and portability
en.what: containerd is an industry-standard container runtime with an emphasis on simplicity, robustness, and portability. It is available as a daemon for Linux and Windows, managing the complete container lifecycle of its host system: image transfer and storage, container execution and supervision, low-level storage and network attachments, etc. It is designed to be embedded into a larger system, rather than being used directly by developers or end-users.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build configuration, documentation (including architecture design docs), and CI/CD workflows for containerd. The project is written in Go and follows CNCF governance, with multiple subprojects.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on Linux/Windows system calls and integrating with CNCF ecosystem tools. Build system supports Makefile and GitHub Actions.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, containerd is the default runtime for mainstream platforms like Kubernetes, with 21,168 stars and ongoing community attention. Its stability and widespread adoption make it a core component of container infrastructure.
uses: Platform engineers: Integrate containerd to build container platforms or Kubernetes nodes, managing container lifecycles.
Container runtime developers: Extend or customize runtime features based on containerd to meet specific needs.
DevOps teams: Leverage containerd's efficient image management and stable operation to optimize CI/CD pipelines.
Security researchers: Review and contribute security patches, participate in CNCF security advisor team.

zh.tag: 开源 RAG 引擎，融合 Agent 能力，为 LLM 构建上下文层
zh.what: RAGFlow 是一个领先的开源检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，将前沿的 RAG 技术与 Agent 能力相结合，为大型语言模型（LLM）提供高质量的上下文层。它支持深度文档理解、基于模板的文本切片、可配置的 Agent 工作流，以及基于引用的可追溯回答，确保输出的准确性和可验证性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 RAGFlow 系统，包括后端服务（Go 编写）、前端 Web 界面、Agent 工作流编排、文档解析与索引模块，以及 Docker 部署配置。提供多语言 README、云服务入口和详细文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发后端，前端基于 Web 技术；依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，集成多种 LLM 和向量数据库，支持深度文档理解与 RAG 流程。
zh.hot: RAGFlow 凭借其将 RAG 与 Agent 结合的创新理念，以及强大的文档处理能力和可追溯回答，在 GitHub 上获得 87k+ 星标，今日新增 85 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 20 名，持续受到开发者社区的高度关注。
uses: 企业知识库构建：利用 RAGFlow 搭建内部文档问答系统，提升信息检索效率。
AI 应用开发者：集成 RAGFlow 作为 LLM 应用的上下文层，增强回答准确性和可追溯性。
研究机构：用于学术文献的深度解析和知识抽取，辅助研究分析。
开源爱好者：学习 RAG 与 Agent 结合的架构设计，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: Open-source RAG engine fusing RAG with Agent capabilities for LLM context layer
en.what: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs. It supports deep document understanding, template-based chunking, configurable Agent workflows, and citation-based traceable answers, ensuring accuracy and verifiability.
en.content: The repository contains the full RAGFlow system, including backend services (written in Go), frontend web UI, Agent workflow orchestration, document parsing and indexing modules, and Docker deployment configurations. It provides multi-language READMEs, cloud service entry, and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Backend primarily developed in Go, frontend based on web technologies; relies on Docker for containerized deployment, integrates multiple LLMs and vector databases, supporting deep document understanding and RAG pipelines.
en.hot: RAGFlow has gained 87k+ stars on GitHub due to its innovative fusion of RAG with Agent capabilities, powerful document processing, and traceable answers. With 85 new stars today, it ranks #20 on the Go trending list, maintaining high attention from the developer community.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Build internal document Q&A systems to improve information retrieval efficiency.
AI app developers: Integrate RAGFlow as a context layer for LLM applications, enhancing answer accuracy and traceability.
Research institutions: Use for deep parsing and knowledge extraction of academic literature to aid research analysis.
Open-source enthusiasts: Learn the architecture of combining RAG with Agent and contribute to the community.

zh.tag: Go 语言实现的 WhatsApp Web 多设备 API 库
zh.what: whatsmeow 是一个用 Go 编写的库，用于与 WhatsApp Web 的多设备 API 进行交互。它允许开发者以编程方式发送和接收消息、管理群组、处理通知等，类似于非官方的 WhatsApp 客户端。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 库源码、详细的 godoc 文档、一个简单的使用示例，以及用于讨论的 Matrix 房间和 GitHub Discussions 板块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 WhatsApp Web 的多设备协议，可能涉及 WebSocket 和 protobuf 等。
zh.hot: 作为少数成熟的 Go 语言 WhatsApp API 库，它填补了生态空白，且功能丰富，持续维护，因此受到开发者关注，star 数稳步增长。
uses: 开发者构建自定义 WhatsApp 机器人或自动化工具，如消息提醒、自动回复等。
需要集成 WhatsApp 消息功能到现有 Go 服务或应用中的场景。
对 WhatsApp 协议感兴趣，希望学习多设备 API 实现的研究者。

en.tag: Go library for the WhatsApp Web multidevice API
en.what: whatsmeow is a Go library for interacting with the WhatsApp Web multidevice API. It enables developers to programmatically send and receive messages, manage groups, handle notifications, and more, acting as an unofficial WhatsApp client.
en.content: The repository contains the full Go library source code, comprehensive godoc documentation, a simple usage example, and a Matrix room plus GitHub Discussions for community support.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it relies on the WhatsApp Web multidevice protocol, likely involving WebSocket and protobuf.
en.hot: As one of the few mature Go libraries for the WhatsApp API, it fills a gap in the ecosystem, offers rich features, and is actively maintained, gaining steady star growth.
uses: Developers building custom WhatsApp bots or automation tools, such as message alerts or auto-replies.
Integrating WhatsApp messaging into existing Go services or applications.
Researchers interested in the WhatsApp protocol and learning the multidevice API implementation.

zh.tag: 轻量便携的命令行 YAML/JSON/XML 处理器
zh.what: yq 是一个用 Go 编写的命令行工具，用于处理 YAML、JSON、XML、CSV、TOML 等多种格式。它采用类似 jq 的语法，支持读取、更新、合并和转换文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 yq 的源代码、文档、安装脚本和示例。提供预编译二进制、包管理器安装方式以及 Docker/Podman 镜像。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 jq 语法，支持多种数据格式解析。
zh.hot: yq 是处理 YAML 等格式的必备工具，star 数近 1.6 万，今日新增 7，持续受到开发者欢迎。
uses: 开发者日常处理 YAML/JSON 配置文件，快速读取或修改值。
在 CI/CD 脚本中转换或合并配置文件，实现自动化部署。
需要跨平台处理多种数据格式（如 XML、CSV）的场景。

en.tag: Lightweight and portable command-line YAML/JSON/XML processor
en.what: yq is a Go-based command-line tool for processing YAML, JSON, XML, CSV, TOML and more. It uses jq-like syntax and supports reading, updating, merging, and converting files.
en.content: The repository contains yq's source code, documentation, installation scripts, and examples. Pre-compiled binaries, package manager installs, and Docker/Podman images are provided.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, uses jq-like syntax, supports parsing multiple data formats.
en.hot: yq is a must-have tool for handling YAML and other formats, with nearly 16k stars and 7 new today, continuously popular among developers.
uses: Developers quickly read or modify values in YAML/JSON config files.
Convert or merge config files in CI/CD scripts for automated deployment.
Scenarios requiring cross-platform handling of multiple data formats like XML, CSV.

zh.tag: 分布式系统核心数据的可靠键值存储
zh.what: etcd 是一个分布式可靠的键值存储，专为分布式系统中最关键的数据设计。它提供简单、安全、快速且可靠的存储服务，使用 Raft 共识算法保证高可用性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 etcd 的完整源代码、etcdctl 命令行客户端、测试套件（包括健壮性测试）、文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言编写，依赖 Raft 共识算法，支持 gRPC API，自动 TLS 加密。
zh.hot: etcd 是 Kubernetes 等关键系统的基石，拥有超过 5.2 万 star，今日新增 13 个，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 作为 Kubernetes 集群的存储后端，保存所有集群状态。
用于服务发现和配置共享，在微服务架构中实现分布式协调。
需要高可用、强一致性的键值存储场景，如分布式锁、领导者选举。

en.tag: Distributed reliable key-value store for critical system data
en.what: etcd is a distributed reliable key-value store for the most critical data of a distributed system. It is simple, secure, fast, and reliable, using the Raft consensus algorithm to manage a highly-available replicated log.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of etcd, the etcdctl command-line client, test suites (including robustness tests), documentation, and examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, uses the Raft consensus algorithm, supports gRPC API, and automatic TLS encryption.
en.hot: etcd is the backbone of critical systems like Kubernetes, with over 52k stars and 13 new stars today, continuing to attract developer attention.
uses: Serves as the storage backend for Kubernetes clusters, holding all cluster state.
Used for service discovery and configuration sharing, enabling distributed coordination in microservices.
Ideal for scenarios requiring highly available, strongly consistent key-value storage, such as distributed locks and leader election.

zh.tag: 进程内分析型 SQL 数据库，极速查询 CSV/Parquet
zh.what: DuckDB 是一个高性能的分析型数据库系统，设计为快速、可靠、可移植且易于使用。它支持丰富的 SQL 方言，包括复杂子查询、窗口函数、复杂类型等，并可直接查询 CSV 和 Parquet 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DuckDB 的完整源代码、文档、扩展机制以及多种客户端（Python、R、Java、Wasm 等）的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持 Python 3 等开发环境。
zh.hot: 作为进程内分析数据库的标杆，DuckDB 凭借其极简部署和高性能查询，在数据科学领域迅速走红，star 数已突破 4 万，今日新增 69 个。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师，希望在 Python 或 R 环境中快速分析大型数据集，无需单独部署数据库服务器。
数据工程师，需要将 CSV/Parquet 文件直接作为 SQL 查询源，简化数据管道。
应用开发者，希望嵌入分析能力到现有应用中，提供轻量级 OLAP 功能。

en.tag: In-process analytical SQL database, blazing fast queries on CSV/Parquet
en.what: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect including complex subqueries, window functions, complex types, and can directly query CSV and Parquet files.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, extension mechanisms, and integrations for multiple clients (Python, R, Java, Wasm, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++17, built with CMake, and supports Python 3 for development.
en.hot: As a benchmark for in-process analytical databases, DuckDB has gained rapid popularity in data science due to its minimal deployment and high-performance queries, with over 40k stars and 69 new today.
uses: Data scientists and analysts who want to quickly analyze large datasets in Python or R without deploying a separate database server.
Data engineers who need to query CSV/Parquet files directly as SQL sources to simplify data pipelines.
Application developers who want to embed analytical capabilities into existing applications for lightweight OLAP functionality.

zh.tag: AI视频超分辨率与补帧工具
zh.what: Video2X 是一个基于机器学习的视频超分辨率和帧插值框架，能够提升视频分辨率和帧率。它支持多种算法，如 Anime4K、Real-ESRGAN 等，并提供图形界面和命令行工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C/C++ 重写的核心库、Windows 安装程序、Linux 支持、GUI 界面以及文档。
zh.stack: 基于 C/C++，利用 ncnn 和 Vulkan 加速，支持 Anime4K、Real-ESRGAN、Real-CUGAN 和 RIFE 模型。
zh.hot: 6.0 版本完全重写，性能大幅提升，跨平台支持，且今日新增 174 星，登上 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: 动漫爱好者提升老番画质，享受高清视觉体验。
视频创作者对素材进行超分和补帧，提升作品质量。
研究人员测试不同超分算法效果，进行对比实验。

en.tag: AI-powered video upscaling and frame interpolation tool
en.what: Video2X is a machine learning-based framework for video super-resolution and frame interpolation, enhancing video resolution and frame rate. It supports algorithms like Anime4K and Real-ESRGAN, with both GUI and CLI.
en.content: The repository includes a C/C++ rewritten core library, Windows installer, Linux support, GUI, and documentation.
en.stack: Built with C/C++, accelerated via ncnn and Vulkan, supporting Anime4K, Real-ESRGAN, Real-CUGAN, and RIFE models.
en.hot: Version 6.0 is a complete rewrite with significant performance gains and cross-platform support, gaining 174 stars today and trending in C++.
uses: Anime fans upscale old shows for a high-definition viewing experience.
Video creators enhance footage with super-resolution and frame interpolation to improve quality.
Researchers test and compare different super-resolution algorithms for experiments.

zh.tag: 跨平台实时物理渲染引擎，轻量高效
zh.what: Filament 是 Google 开发的实时物理渲染引擎，支持 Android、iOS、Linux、macOS、Windows 和 WebGL2。它专为 Android 优化，力求体积最小、效率最高，同时提供跨平台一致的渲染质量。
zh.content: 仓库包含渲染引擎的核心源码、构建脚本、示例应用，以及用于生成资产的主机端工具（如材质编译器 matc）。提供 Maven 依赖和预编译发布包，方便集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持 Vulkan、OpenGL 和 Metal 后端。提供 Java/Kotlin (Android)、JavaScript (Web) 等语言的绑定，依赖 CMake 构建系统。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方维护的高性能渲染引擎，Filament 在跨平台移动端和桌面端都有广泛应用，star 数已超 2 万，今日新增 6 星，稳居 C++ 趋势榜前列。
uses: 移动应用开发者：在 Android/iOS 上实现高质量 3D 渲染，如地图、游戏或 AR 应用。
桌面与 Web 开发者：利用同一套代码在 Windows、Linux、macOS 及浏览器中渲染 3D 场景。
图形学研究者：学习实时物理渲染的实现，或基于 Filament 扩展自定义渲染特性。
产品可视化：为电商、建筑或工业设计构建逼真的产品预览和交互展示。

en.tag: Cross-platform real-time PBR rendering engine, lightweight and efficient
en.what: Filament is a real-time physically based rendering engine developed by Google, supporting Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, Windows, and WebGL2. It is optimized for Android, aiming to be as small and efficient as possible while delivering consistent rendering quality across platforms.
en.content: The repository contains the core rendering engine source code, build scripts, sample apps, and host-side tools for asset generation (e.g., material compiler matc). It offers Maven dependencies and prebuilt release archives for easy integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with support for Vulkan, OpenGL, and Metal backends. Provides bindings for Java/Kotlin (Android) and JavaScript (Web), and uses CMake as the build system.
en.hot: As an officially maintained high-performance rendering engine by Google, Filament is widely used across mobile and desktop platforms. With over 20k stars and 6 new stars today, it consistently ranks high on the C++ trending list.
uses: Mobile app developers: Achieve high-quality 3D rendering on Android/iOS for maps, games, or AR apps.
Desktop and web developers: Render 3D scenes on Windows, Linux, macOS, and browsers with a single codebase.
Graphics researchers: Study real-time PBR implementation or extend Filament with custom rendering features.
Product visualization: Build realistic product previews and interactive showcases for e-commerce, architecture, or industrial design.

zh.tag: CUDA 高性能线性代数模板库与 Python DSL
zh.what: CUTLASS 是 NVIDIA 开源的 CUDA 抽象集合，用于实现高性能矩阵乘法（GEMM）及相关计算，覆盖从底层硬件到上层应用的所有层级。它提供分层分解和数据移动策略，将复杂内核拆解为可复用的模块化组件，并支持多种数据类型和架构。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 模板库、CuTe DSL（Python 领域特定语言）、示例代码（如 GEMM 分解图）以及针对 Volta 到 Blackwell 架构的优化内核。
zh.stack: 基于 CUDA C++ 模板，支持 FP64/FP32/TF32/FP16/BF16/FP8/块缩放/窄整数/二进制等数据类型，并集成 Python DSL（CuTe DSL）以简化开发。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方高性能计算库，CUTLASS 是 GPU 内核开发的基石，star 数超 1 万，今日新增 7 星，排名 C++ 日榜第五，持续受到性能工程师和 AI 研究者的关注。
uses: GPU 性能工程师：用于优化深度学习推理和训练中的矩阵运算，提升效率。
AI 研究人员：借助 CuTe DSL 快速原型设计新内核，无需深入 C++ 细节。
学生与教育者：学习 CUDA 编程和 GPU 架构的绝佳资源，降低入门门槛。
框架开发者：集成到 PyTorch 等框架中，无需编写胶水代码即可获得高性能内核。

en.tag: CUDA templates & Python DSLs for high-performance linear algebra
en.what: CUTLASS is NVIDIA's open-source collection of CUDA abstractions for high-performance matrix multiplication (GEMM) and related computations across all levels and scales. It decomposes complex kernels into reusable modular components with hierarchical decomposition and data movement strategies, supporting diverse data types and architectures.
en.content: The repo contains C++ template library, CuTe DSL (Python domain-specific language), examples (e.g., GEMM decomposition diagram), and optimized kernels for Volta to Blackwell architectures.
en.stack: Built on CUDA C++ templates, supporting FP64/FP32/TF32/FP16/BF16/FP8/block-scaled/narrow-int/binary data types, with Python DSL (CuTe DSL) for simplified development.
en.hot: As NVIDIA's official high-performance computing library, CUTLASS is a cornerstone for GPU kernel development, with 10k+ stars and 7 new today, ranking #5 on C++ daily trending, consistently attracting performance engineers and AI researchers.
uses: GPU performance engineers: optimize matrix operations in deep learning inference and training for higher efficiency.
AI researchers: leverage CuTe DSL for rapid prototyping of new kernels without deep C++ expertise.
Students and educators: an excellent resource for learning CUDA programming and GPU architecture, lowering the entry barrier.
Framework developers: integrate into frameworks like PyTorch to obtain high-performance kernels without glue code.

zh.tag: 用手机指纹/人脸解锁电脑的桌面端应用
zh.what: PC Bio Unlock 是一款桌面应用，让你用 Android 手机上的指纹或人脸识别来解锁电脑，替代在登录界面、锁屏或权限提示时输入密码。它通过 Wi-Fi、局域网或蓝牙工作，无需账户和互联网连接。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端应用，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS（实验性），提供自动发现、二维码配对、多手机/多账户支持，以及 Wake-on-LAN 唤醒功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，涉及系统级集成（如 PAM、polkit、UAC）和网络通信（UDP/TCP/蓝牙）。
zh.hot: 虽然今日新增 0 星，但总星数 433 且进入 C++ 日榜第 6，说明其解决密码输入痛点、提升便利性的实用价值受到关注。
uses: 厌倦每次登录都输密码的 Windows/Linux 用户，希望用手机生物识别快速解锁。
需要频繁输入 sudo 或 UAC 密码的开发者或管理员，可减少打断。
追求无密码体验、注重隐私（密码不出 PC）的安全爱好者。

en.tag: Desktop app to unlock your PC with your phone's fingerprint or face
en.what: PC Bio Unlock is a desktop app that lets you unlock your PC using your Android phone's fingerprint or face, replacing password entry at login, lock screen, or permission prompts. It works over Wi-Fi, LAN, or Bluetooth, requiring no account or internet connection.
en.content: The repository contains the desktop app, supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS (experimental), with auto-discovery, QR code pairing, multiple phones/accounts, and Wake-on-LAN.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, involving system-level integration (e.g., PAM, polkit, UAC) and network communication (UDP/TCP/Bluetooth).
en.hot: Despite 0 stars today, the total 433 stars and #6 on the C++ daily trending list show its practical value in solving password entry pain points and enhancing convenience.
uses: Windows/Linux users tired of typing passwords every login, wanting quick biometric unlock via phone.
Developers or admins who frequently enter sudo or UAC passwords, reducing interruptions.
Security enthusiasts seeking passwordless experience with privacy (password never leaves PC).

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 原生测试框架，支持单元测试、TDD 和 BDD
zh.what: Catch2 是一个用于 C++ 的单元测试框架，同时提供微基准测试和简单的 BDD 宏。它的主要优势是使用简单自然，测试名称无需是有效标识符，断言看起来像普通的 C++ 布尔表达式，sections 提供了在测试中共享 setup 和 teardown 代码的简洁局部方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Catch2 的完整源代码、文档、示例和构建配置。v3 版本不再是单头文件库，而是作为普通库，包含多个头文件和单独编译的源文件。
zh.stack: C++14/17 及更高版本（v2.x 分支支持 C++11，Catch1.x 支持 C++03）。依赖 CMake 构建，支持多种编译器和平台。
zh.hot: Catch2 是 C++ 社区广泛使用的测试框架，拥有超过 2.1 万 star，因其简单性和自然语法而备受青睐。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但长期积累的高人气使其持续出现在趋势榜上。
uses: C++ 开发者编写单元测试、TDD 和 BDD 测试，提高代码质量。
需要微基准测试功能的项目，用于性能敏感代码的快速评估。
教学或学习 C++ 测试框架的入门选择，因其语法直观易懂。

en.tag: A modern, C++-native test framework for unit tests, TDD and BDD
en.what: Catch2 is a unit testing framework for C++, also providing basic micro-benchmarking features and simple BDD macros. Its main advantage is that using it is both simple and natural: test names don't have to be valid identifiers, assertions look like normal C++ boolean expressions, and sections provide a nice and local way to share set-up and tear-down code in tests.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and build configuration for Catch2. The v3 version is no longer a single-header library; it now behaves as a normal library with multiple headers and separately compiled sources.
en.stack: C++14/17 and later (v2.x branch supports C++11, Catch1.x supports C++03). Uses CMake for building, supports multiple compilers and platforms.
en.hot: Catch2 is a widely-used testing framework in the C++ community with over 21k stars, favored for its simplicity and natural syntax. Although today's star increase is modest, its long-standing popularity keeps it on the trending list.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests, TDD and BDD tests to improve code quality.
Projects needing micro-benchmarking features for quick performance evaluation of critical code.
Beginners learning C++ testing frameworks due to its intuitive and easy-to-understand syntax.

zh.tag: 1-bit 大模型官方推理框架，CPU/GPU 高效部署
zh.what: BitNet 是微软推出的 1-bit 大语言模型（LLM）官方推理框架，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行 BitNet b1.58 等极低比特模型。它通过优化的内核和量化技术，显著降低内存占用和计算成本，使大模型能在普通硬件上快速推理。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理引擎（C++ 实现）、CPU 和 GPU 优化内核、模型转换工具、示例代码及文档，并提供了 Hugging Face 模型集合和在线演示。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 BLAS、OpenMP 等，支持 x86 (AVX2) 和 ARM (NEON) 架构，GPU 内核基于 CUDA。
zh.hot: BitNet 突破了传统 LLM 的内存瓶颈，以 1-bit 量化实现接近全精度的性能，在 GitHub 上获得 4 万+ star，成为低比特推理的标杆项目。
uses: 在边缘设备或 CPU 上部署大语言模型，如智能终端、嵌入式系统
需要低成本、低功耗推理的 AI 应用，如实时语音识别（ASR）
研究低比特量化技术或进行模型压缩的学者与开发者
构建隐私敏感或离线场景下的本地 AI 助手

en.tag: Official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, efficient on CPU/GPU
en.what: BitNet is Microsoft's official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, enabling efficient deployment of ultra-low-bit models like BitNet b1.58 on both CPU and GPU. It leverages optimized kernels and quantization to drastically reduce memory footprint and compute cost, making large models run fast on commodity hardware.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference engine (C++), optimized CPU/GPU kernels, model conversion tools, examples, and documentation, along with Hugging Face model collections and an online demo.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies on BLAS, OpenMP, etc., supporting x86 (AVX2) and ARM (NEON), and GPU kernels based on CUDA.
en.hot: BitNet breaks the memory bottleneck of traditional LLMs, achieving near-full-precision performance with 1-bit quantization, amassing 40k+ stars on GitHub as a benchmark for low-bit inference.
uses: Deploying LLMs on edge devices or CPUs, such as smart terminals and embedded systems
AI applications requiring low-cost, low-power inference, like real-time speech recognition (ASR)
Researchers and developers studying low-bit quantization or model compression
Building local AI assistants for privacy-sensitive or offline scenarios

zh.tag: 开源重制经典过山车大亨2，情怀与创新并存
zh.what: OpenRCT2 是《过山车大亨2》的开源重制版，旨在完全兼容原版游戏并扩展新功能。它允许玩家在保留原版体验的同时，享受跨平台支持、多人联机、改进的界面和更多自定义选项。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的游戏引擎、资源管理工具、构建脚本和文档。代码结构清晰，分为核心引擎、游戏逻辑、UI 和网络模块，支持从源码构建或直接下载预编译版本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SDL2、OpenGL 等图形库，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。构建系统采用 CMake，并集成了多种第三方库。
zh.hot: 凭借经典 IP 的情怀和持续更新的活跃社区，OpenRCT2 长期保持高关注度。今日新增 7 星，总星数达 16152，位列 C++ 日榜第 9，展现了玩家对重制经典的热情。
uses: 怀旧玩家：重温童年经典，体验原汁原味的过山车大亨2，并享受改进的画质和操作。
模组开发者：基于开源代码进行二次开发，创建自定义过山车、地图和游戏机制。
游戏研究者：学习经典模拟经营游戏的架构设计，研究 C++ 大型项目实践。

en.tag: Open-source re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, blending nostalgia with innovation
en.what: OpenRCT2 is an open-source re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, aiming for full compatibility with the original while adding new features. It offers cross-platform support, multiplayer, improved UI, and more customization, preserving the classic experience.
en.content: The repository contains the full game engine, asset management tools, build scripts, and documentation. The code is well-organized into core engine, game logic, UI, and network modules, with options to build from source or download pre-built binaries.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it relies on SDL2, OpenGL, and other graphics libraries, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. The build system uses CMake with integration of various third-party libraries.
en.hot: Leveraging nostalgia for a classic IP and an active community with continuous updates, OpenRCT2 maintains high attention. With 7 new stars today and 16152 total, it ranks 9th on the C++ daily trending, reflecting players' passion for remastering classics.
uses: Nostalgic gamers: Relive the classic RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 with improved graphics and controls.
Mod developers: Build upon the open-source code to create custom rides, scenarios, and gameplay mechanics.
Game researchers: Study the architecture of a classic simulation game and learn C++ project practices.

zh.tag: 生产级系统追踪、性能剖析与可视化分析套件
zh.what: Perfetto 是一套开源的生产级追踪与性能分析工具，用于捕获、记录和分析客户端及嵌入式系统的行为。它提供高性能追踪守护进程、低开销 SDK、系统级探针、基于浏览器的可视化 UI 以及 SQL 分析引擎，帮助开发者定位功能与性能问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心组件源码：追踪守护进程、C++17 SDK、系统探针（如 ftrace、CPU 频率）、基于 Web 的 UI（可打开多 GB 的 trace 文件）、SQL 分析库，以及丰富的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SQLite 进行 trace 存储与查询，前端 UI 基于 Web 技术（如 WebAssembly、TypeScript），支持 Android、Linux、macOS、Windows 等平台。
zh.hot: 作为 Android 和 Chromium 的默认追踪系统，Perfetto 在开发者中拥有广泛基础。当前 6404 stars，今日新增 9，位列 C++ 日榜第 10，持续受到性能工程和系统开发者的关注。
uses: Android 应用开发者：用于调试启动慢、掉帧、ANR 等性能问题，并分析 Java/Kotlin 和原生内存使用。
C/C++ 开发者（Linux/macOS/Windows）：通过 Tracing SDK 自定义埋点，分析执行流程和性能瓶颈。
Linux 内核与系统开发者：利用 ftrace 集成，可视化调度、系统调用、中断等内核行为。
性能工程师与 SRE：使用 SQL 接口分析多种 trace 格式（如 perf、Instruments、Chrome JSON），实现自动化分析。

en.tag: Production-grade tracing, profiling, and analysis suite for complex systems
en.what: Perfetto is an open-source, production-grade tracing and profiling suite for capturing, recording, and analyzing the behavior of client and embedded systems. It provides high-performance tracing daemons, a low-overhead SDK, OS-level probes, a browser-based visualization UI, and a SQL analysis engine to help developers root-cause functional and performance issues.
en.content: The repository contains source code for core components: tracing daemons, C++17 SDK, OS probes (e.g., ftrace, CPU frequency), a web-based UI (capable of opening multi-GB trace files), a SQL analysis library, along with extensive documentation and examples.
