en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on SQLite for trace storage and querying, frontend UI is web-based (e.g., WebAssembly, TypeScript), supports Android, Linux, macOS, Windows, and more.
en.hot: As the default tracing system for Android and Chromium, Perfetto has a broad developer base. With 6404 stars and 9 new today, ranking #10 on the C++ daily trending, it continues to attract performance engineers and system developers.
uses: Android app developers: debug issues like slow startup, jank, ANRs, and profile Java/Kotlin and native memory usage.
C/C++ developers on Linux/macOS/Windows: use the Tracing SDK to instrument custom trace points and analyze execution flow and bottlenecks.
Linux kernel and system developers: leverage ftrace integration to visualize scheduling, syscalls, interrupts, and more.
Performance engineers and SREs: use the SQL interface to analyze various trace formats (e.g., perf, Instruments, Chrome JSON) for automated analysis.

zh.tag: 开源自动驾驶仪，支持多类无人系统
zh.what: ArduPilot 是一个功能丰富的开源自动驾驶仪系统，支持固定翼、多旋翼、直升机、地面车辆、水下航行器等。它提供飞行控制、导航和任务规划功能，被广泛用于无人机研究和实际应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ArduPlane、ArduCopter、ArduRover、ArduSub 等固件源码，以及库、工具和测试套件。代码结构清晰，支持多种硬件平台和仿真环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 ChibiOS/RTOS 和 Linux 等底层系统，支持 MAVLink 协议。构建系统基于 Make 和 Waf，并集成大量 CI 测试。
zh.hot: 作为无人机开源领域的标杆项目，ArduPilot 拥有庞大用户群和活跃社区。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但长期积累的 15k+ star 和持续更新使其保持热度。
uses: 无人机开发者：基于 ArduPilot 进行飞控固件定制和二次开发。
科研机构：用于无人机算法验证和自主飞行研究。
教育领域：作为学习无人机原理和嵌入式系统的教学平台。
行业应用：农业、测绘、巡检等领域的无人机解决方案。

en.tag: Open-source autopilot for drones, rovers, subs, and more
en.what: ArduPilot is a feature-rich open-source autopilot system supporting fixed-wing aircraft, multirotors, helicopters, ground vehicles, and underwater vehicles. It provides flight control, navigation, and mission planning, widely used in drone research and real-world applications.
en.content: The repository contains firmware source for ArduPlane, ArduCopter, ArduRover, ArduSub, along with libraries, tools, and test suites. The code is well-structured, supporting various hardware platforms and simulation environments.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on ChibiOS/RTOS and Linux as underlying systems, supporting MAVLink protocol. Build system based on Make and Waf, with extensive CI testing.
en.hot: As a benchmark in the open-source drone community, ArduPilot has a large user base and active community. Despite modest daily star gains, its long-term accumulation of 15k+ stars and continuous updates keep it popular.
uses: Drone developers: Customize and extend the autopilot firmware based on ArduPilot.
Research institutions: Use for algorithm validation and autonomous flight research.
Education: A teaching platform for learning drone principles and embedded systems.
Industry applications: Drone solutions for agriculture, surveying, inspection, etc.

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台
zh.what: TensorFlow 是 Google 开发的端到端开源机器学习平台，提供从研究到生产部署的完整工具链与库生态。它让研究者能够推进机器学习前沿，也让开发者轻松构建和部署 AI 驱动的应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 运行时、Python 与 C++ API、Keras 高级接口，以及 TensorFlow Lite、TensorFlow.js 等跨平台推理部署工具和丰富的官方示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 构建高性能计算后端，通过 Python 提供主要前端接口；支持 CUDA GPU 加速、Bazel 构建系统及 Docker 部署，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最具影响力的基础框架之一，TensorFlow 凭借 196,329 星（本周新增 365 颗）和工业级稳定性，持续获得学术界与工业界的广泛采用。
uses: 机器学习研究者 —— 需要灵活底层接口进行模型创新与算法实验
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望借助 Keras 和 TF Lite 快速训练并部署到端侧或服务器
工程团队 —— 寻求从训练到推理的规模化、可移植生产流水线
高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open-source ML framework and ecosystem
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production. It enables researchers to push the state-of-the-art in ML while allowing developers to easily build and deploy AI-powered applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ runtime, Python and C++ APIs, the Keras high-level interface, plus cross-platform deployment tools like TensorFlow Lite and TensorFlow.js along with extensive official examples.
en.stack: Built on C++ for a high-performance compute backend with Python as the primary frontend; it supports CUDA GPU acceleration, Bazel builds, Docker deployment, and multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most influential foundational deep-learning frameworks, TensorFlow maintains strong momentum with 196,329 stars and 365 new stars this week, reflecting broad academic and industrial adoption for its production-grade stability.
uses: ML researchers —— who need flexible low-level APIs for model innovation and algorithmic experiments
AI application developers —— looking to quickly train and deploy models to mobile, edge, or server via Keras and TF Lite
Engineering teams —— seeking scalable, portable production pipelines from training to inference
Students and educators —— using it as a primary framework to learn deep-learning concepts and engineering practices

zh.tag: 让 Linux GUI 应用原生运行在 Windows 上的集成方案
zh.what: WSLg 是微软推出的 Windows Subsystem for Linux GUI 项目，旨在让 Linux 图形界面应用（X11 和 Wayland）在 Windows 上以完全集成的桌面体验运行。它提供了更统一、用户友好的替代方案，使 Linux 应用感觉像 Windows 原生应用一样自然。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WSLg 的源代码、文档和集成桌面截图，以及安装说明和系统要求。主要组件包括 Wayland 和 XServer 的支持，以及与 Windows 桌面的集成（如开始菜单、任务栏、Alt-Tab、剪贴板共享等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 WSL 2 和 Windows 10/11 的图形驱动，支持 GPU 加速。
zh.hot: WSLg 解决了开发者长期以来的痛点，无需虚拟机即可在 Windows 上无缝运行 Linux GUI 应用。今日新增 18 星，总星数达 11886，在 C++ 趋势榜上排名第 14，持续受到关注。
uses: 适合需要在 Windows 上运行 Linux 图形工具的开发者，如使用 Linux 版 IDE 或设计软件。
适合科学家和研究人员，他们依赖 Linux 环境中的专业应用，但日常工作在 Windows 上。
适合希望简化开发环境、避免双系统或虚拟机配置的爱好者。

en.tag: Run Linux GUI apps natively on Windows with full desktop integration
en.what: WSLg is Microsoft's project for Windows Subsystem for Linux GUI, enabling Linux GUI applications (X11 and Wayland) to run on Windows with a fully integrated desktop experience. It offers a more integrated, user-friendly alternative, making Linux apps feel native on Windows.
en.content: The repository contains WSLg source code, documentation, integrated desktop screenshots, and installation instructions with system requirements. Key components include Wayland and XServer support, and integration with Windows desktop (Start Menu, taskbar, Alt-Tab, clipboard sharing, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relies on WSL 2 and Windows 10/11 graphics drivers, supports GPU acceleration.
en.hot: WSLg addresses a long-standing pain point for developers, allowing seamless Linux GUI apps on Windows without VMs. With 18 stars today and 11,886 total, it ranks #14 on the C++ trending list, maintaining steady interest.
uses: For developers who need to run Linux GUI tools on Windows, such as Linux IDEs or design software.
For scientists and researchers relying on specialized Linux apps while working on Windows daily.
For enthusiasts who want to simplify their dev environment, avoiding dual-boot or VM setups.

zh.tag: 开源全功能2D动画制作软件，源自吉卜力工作室定制版
zh.what: OpenToonz 是一款开源的2D动画制作软件，由 DWANGO 发布，基于 Digital Video 开发的 Toonz Studio Ghibli 版本，并经过吉卜力工作室多年的生产定制。它提供完整的2D动画制作功能，包括绘图、扫描、着色、合成等。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、构建脚本（支持 Windows/macOS/Linux/BSD）、文档（如开发清单、构建指南）以及多语言翻译（通过 Weblate）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Qt 等库，支持跨平台构建，并集成 CI（AppVeyor、GitHub Actions）和翻译平台 Weblate。
zh.hot: 作为吉卜力工作室使用的专业级动画软件的开源版本，拥有稳定的用户基础，今日新增 35 星，登上 C++ 日榜第 15 名，持续吸引动画爱好者和开发者。
uses: 2D动画师和工作室：用于制作专业级动画，尤其适合传统手绘风格。
动画专业学生和教育者：学习动画制作流程和开源软件实践。
开源贡献者：参与代码开发、测试、翻译或文档改进。

en.tag: Open-source full-featured 2D animation software, based on Studio Ghibli's customized version
en.what: OpenToonz is an open-source 2D animation software published by DWANGO, based on the Toonz Studio Ghibli Version developed by Digital Video and customized by Studio Ghibli over years of production. It offers full-featured 2D animation creation capabilities including drawing, scanning, coloring, and compositing.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, build scripts (for Windows/macOS/Linux/BSD), documentation (e.g., development checklists, build guides), and multi-language translations via Weblate.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on Qt and other libraries, supports cross-platform builds, and integrates CI (AppVeyor, GitHub Actions) and translation platform Weblate.
en.hot: As the open-source version of the professional animation software used by Studio Ghibli, it has a solid user base, gaining 35 stars today and ranking #15 on the C++ daily trending list, continuing to attract animators and developers.
uses: 2D animators and studios: for producing professional-grade animations, especially traditional hand-drawn styles.
Animation students and educators: to learn animation workflows and open-source software practices.
Open-source contributors: to participate in code development, testing, translation, or documentation improvements.

zh.tag: 跨平台C++音频应用与插件开发框架
zh.what: JUCE 是一个开源的跨平台 C++ 应用框架，用于开发桌面和移动应用，以及 VST、VST3、AU、AUv3、LV2 和 AAX 等音频插件。它提供了丰富的 UI 组件和音频处理功能，并支持通过 CMake 或 Projucer 进行项目构建。
zh.content: 仓库包含 JUCE 框架的完整源码、模块（如 juce_audio_processors、juce_gui_basics 等）、示例项目、Projucer 工具源码以及 CMake 构建支持。
zh.stack: 基于 C++17（启用 Windows MIDI 服务时需 C++20），支持 CMake 3.22+ 和 Projucer，可导出 Xcode、Visual Studio、Android Studio 等平台项目。
zh.hot: JUCE 是音频开发领域的经典框架，拥有庞大的用户基础和生态，尽管今日新增 star 不多，但持续保持高关注度，在 C++ 日榜中排名第 14。
uses: 音频插件开发者：创建 VST、AU、AAX 等格式的音频插件
跨平台桌面应用开发者：使用 C++ 构建 Windows、macOS、Linux 应用
音乐软件公司：快速原型和商业级音频产品开发

en.tag: Cross-platform C++ framework for audio apps and plugins
en.what: JUCE is an open-source cross-platform C++ application framework for creating desktop and mobile applications, including VST, VST3, AU, AUv3, AAX and LV2 audio plug-ins and plug-in hosts. It offers a rich set of UI components and audio processing capabilities, and supports project building via CMake or the Projucer.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the JUCE framework, modules (such as juce_audio_processors, juce_gui_basics), example projects, the Projucer tool source, and CMake build support.
en.stack: Built on C++17 (C++20 when JUCE_USE_WINDOWS_MIDI_SERVICES is enabled), supports CMake 3.22+ and Projucer, and can export projects for Xcode, Visual Studio, Android Studio, and Linux Makefiles.
en.hot: JUCE is a classic framework in audio development with a large user base and ecosystem. Despite modest daily star growth, it maintains high visibility, ranking 14th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Audio plugin developers: create VST, AU, AAX and other format plugins
Cross-platform desktop app developers: build Windows, macOS, Linux apps with C++
Music software companies: rapid prototyping and commercial-grade audio product development

zh.tag: 高性能内存数据存储，兼容 Redis 与 Memcached
zh.what: Dragonfly 是一个现代化的内存数据存储，专为现代应用负载设计。它完全兼容 Redis 和 Memcached API，无需修改代码即可迁移。相比传统内存存储，吞吐量提升 25 倍，资源消耗降低 80%。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Dragonfly 的完整源代码、文档、基准测试脚本、构建指南以及多语言 README。核心是用 C++ 实现的高性能单线程事件驱动架构。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Linux 系统调用和 io_uring 等异步 I/O 机制。支持 Docker 部署，并提供 Helm chart 用于 Kubernetes。
zh.hot: 作为 Redis 和 Memcached 的现代替代品，Dragonfly 凭借其惊人的性能提升和兼容性吸引了大量关注，目前已有 31k+ stars。
uses: 需要高吞吐、低延迟缓存服务的后端开发者，可无缝替换 Redis。
希望降低内存资源消耗、节省成本的基础设施团队。
对 Redis 兼容性有严格要求，但追求更高性能的微服务架构。

en.tag: High-performance in-memory data store, drop-in compatible with Redis and Memcached
en.what: Dragonfly is a modern in-memory data store built for modern application workloads. It is fully compatible with Redis and Memcached APIs, requiring no code changes to adopt. It delivers 25x more throughput and uses up to 80% less resources compared to legacy in-memory datastores.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, benchmarks, build guides, and multi-language READMEs. The core is a high-performance single-threaded event-driven architecture implemented in C++.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging Linux system calls and asynchronous I/O mechanisms like io_uring. Supports Docker deployment and provides a Helm chart for Kubernetes.
en.hot: As a modern replacement for Redis and Memcached, Dragonfly has gained significant attention for its impressive performance gains and compatibility, amassing over 31k stars.
uses: Backend developers needing high-throughput, low-latency caching services, can seamlessly replace Redis.
Infrastructure teams looking to reduce memory resource consumption and save costs.
Microservices architectures that require strict Redis compatibility but demand higher performance.

zh.tag: 极速 C++ 日志库，头文件或编译可选
zh.what: spdlog 是一个极速的 C++ 日志库，提供丰富的格式化功能，支持同步和异步日志记录。它支持多种输出目标，如控制台、文件、syslog 等，并允许运行时和编译时过滤日志级别。
zh.content: 仓库包含头文件库（include/spdlog）、示例代码（example/）、基准测试（benchmarks）以及 CMake 构建配置。支持多种平台和包管理器安装。
zh.stack: 基于 C++11 编写，依赖 fmt 库进行格式化。支持 CMake 构建，提供头文件版和编译版两种使用方式。
zh.hot: 拥有近 3 万星标，因其高性能和易用性成为 C++ 日志库的事实标准。今日新增 9 星，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: C++ 项目开发者，需要快速集成高性能日志功能。
需要异步日志记录或自定义日志输出的应用场景。
希望使用跨平台日志库的桌面或嵌入式开发者。

en.tag: Fast C++ logging library with header-only or compiled mode
en.what: spdlog is a fast C++ logging library with rich formatting, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous logging. It supports various sinks like console, files, syslog, and allows runtime and compile-time log level filtering.
en.content: The repository contains the header-only library (include/spdlog), examples (example/), benchmarks, and CMake build configuration. It supports multiple platforms and package managers.
en.stack: Written in C++11, depends on the fmt library for formatting. Supports CMake build, offering both header-only and compiled versions.
en.hot: With nearly 30k stars, it's the de facto standard for C++ logging due to its high performance and ease of use. Gaining 9 stars today, it remains popular among developers.
uses: C++ developers needing fast, easy-to-integrate logging.
Applications requiring asynchronous logging or custom sinks.
Developers seeking a cross-platform logging library for desktop or embedded systems.

zh.tag: 基于MCP的AI语音聊天机器人，支持多终端控制
zh.what: 小智AI聊天机器人是一个基于MCP协议的语音交互入口，利用Qwen/DeepSeek等大模型的AI能力，通过MCP协议实现多终端控制。它支持离线语音唤醒、全双工语音对话、摄像头视觉输入等功能，并兼容多种ESP32芯片平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的固件源码、文档（如ESP-IDF 6.0迁移指南）、硬件接线教程，以及可定制的资源生成器（自定义唤醒词、字体、表情等）。支持Wi-Fi、4G、以太网等多种联网方式，并集成了ESP-SR语音识别和3D-Speaker说话人识别。
zh.stack: 基于C++和ESP-IDF框架，依赖ESP-SR、MCP协议、WebSocket/MQTT+UDP通信，支持Opus音频流和多种大模型API。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub上获得29k+星标，因其将AI聊天机器人落地到低成本ESP32硬件，结合MCP协议实现智能家居控制等场景，吸引了大量DIY爱好者和AI应用开发者。
uses: 适合硬件爱好者，想DIY一个能语音对话的AI机器人，并接入智能家居控制。
适合AI应用开发者，探索MCP协议在边缘设备上的应用，扩展大模型能力。
适合教育场景，用于嵌入式AI教学和语音交互原型开发。

en.tag: An MCP-based AI voice chatbot with multi-terminal control
en.what: XiaoZhi AI chatbot is a voice interaction entry leveraging large models like Qwen/DeepSeek, enabling multi-terminal control via MCP protocol. It supports offline voice wake-up, full-duplex voice conversation, camera vision input, and runs on various ESP32 chip platforms.
en.content: The repo contains complete firmware source code, documentation (like ESP-IDF 6.0 migration guide), hardware wiring tutorials, and a customizable asset generator (wake words, fonts, emojis). It supports Wi-Fi, 4G, Ethernet connectivity, and integrates ESP-SR speech recognition and 3D-Speaker speaker recognition.
en.stack: Built with C++ and ESP-IDF framework, depends on ESP-SR, MCP protocol, WebSocket/MQTT+UDP communication, supports Opus audio streaming and various LLM APIs.
en.hot: With 29k+ stars, this project is popular for bringing AI chatbots to low-cost ESP32 hardware, integrating MCP for smart home control, attracting DIY enthusiasts and AI app developers.
uses: For hardware enthusiasts who want to DIY an AI voice chatbot with smart home control.
For AI developers exploring MCP protocol on edge devices to extend LLM capabilities.
For educational purposes, teaching embedded AI and voice interaction prototyping.

zh.tag: 开源像素动画与精灵图编辑器，游戏美术必备工具
zh.what: Aseprite 是一款专注于像素艺术和动画精灵图创作的专业桌面软件，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。它通过图层与帧分离的动画时间轴、洋葱皮预览和丰富的像素画笔工具，帮助用户制作游戏素材和复古风格动画。软件同时提供 Lua 脚本扩展、命令行接口和多种格式导入导出，满足从个人创作到工业化流程的多样化需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面端源码，基于自研 UI 框架构建，涵盖绘画引擎、动画时间轴、颜色管理、文件读写及脚本系统等核心模块。除主程序代码外，还提供了依赖库（如 Skia 图形后端）的集成配置和跨平台构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主体采用 C++ 开发，图形渲染基于 Skia 库，并依赖 Google 的 depot_tools 进行依赖管理；构建系统支持 CMake，覆盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 三端编译。
zh.hot: 凭借 38.1k+ Star 的社区认可度，Aseprite 是像素艺术领域的事实标准工具；其开源属性与专业级动画功能（如洋葱皮、Lua 脚本）持续吸引独立游戏开发者和艺术创作者，本周再获 211 Star 登上 C++ 周榜前 20。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速绘制角色、场景与 UI 的像素风游戏素材
像素艺术家与动画师 —— 制作复古风插画、表情包和逐帧动画
游戏美术教育者 —— 作为低门槛、可扩展的像素画教学工具
工具链集成工程师 —— 利用 CLI 与 Lua 脚本实现自动化资产导出流水线

en.tag: Open-source pixel art & animated sprite editor for game developers and artists
en.what: Aseprite is a dedicated desktop application for creating pixel art and animated sprites across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a timeline that separates layers and frames, onion skinning for smooth animation workflows, and pixel-perfect drawing tools tailored for game asset creation. The tool also supports Lua scripting, CLI automation, and extensive import/export formats to fit both hobbyist and production pipelines.
en.content: The repository houses the full C++ desktop application source, built on a custom UI framework, covering the rendering engine, animation timeline, color management, file I/O, and scripting subsystems. It also includes dependency integrations (such as the Skia graphics backend) and cross-platform build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ with Skia handling the graphics backend and Google depot_tools managing dependencies; the project uses CMake and supports compilation on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: With over 38.1k stars, Aseprite is the de facto standard for pixel art; its open-source model combined with professional animation features—such as onion skinning and Lua scripting—keeps attracting indie game developers and artists, earning another 211 stars this week and landing in the top 20 of GitHub’s C++ Trending.
uses: Indie game developers — rapidly creating pixel-art characters, environments, and UI assets
Pixel artists and animators — producing retro-style illustrations, emoticons, and frame-by-frame animations
Game-art educators — teaching pixel fundamentals with a low-barrier, highly extensible tool
Pipeline engineers — automating asset export via CLI and Lua scripting in production workflows

zh.tag: 国产工业级深度学习框架，覆盖训练到部署全流程
zh.what: PaddlePaddle（飞桨）是中国首个自主研发的深度学习平台，提供核心框架、模型库、开发套件和服务平台。它支持动态图和静态图统一、自动并行、大模型训推一体，以及科学计算高阶微分。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架源码（C++为主）、Python API、文档（中英日）、安装脚本和示例。目录结构涵盖 paddle（核心）、doc（文档）、python（API绑定）、test（测试）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现底层，提供 Python API，支持 CUDA/ROCm 等加速，依赖 CMake 构建，支持多种操作系统和硬件。
zh.hot: 作为中国领先的深度学习框架，拥有 2.4 万 star，服务超 2333 万开发者，工业应用广泛。近期发布 3.2 版本，强调自动并行和训推一体，持续吸引关注。
uses: 工业界开发者：用于制造、农业、企业服务等场景的 AI 模型开发与部署
研究人员：利用自动并行和高阶微分进行大规模模型训练和科学计算
教育者与学生：通过丰富文档和模型库学习深度学习

en.tag: China's industrial-grade DL framework covering full pipeline from training to deployment
en.what: PaddlePaddle is China's first self-developed deep learning platform, offering core frameworks, model libraries, development kits, and service platforms. It supports unified dynamic/static graphs, automatic parallelism, integrated training/inference for large models, and high-order differentiation for scientific computing.
en.content: The repository contains core framework source code (mostly C++), Python APIs, documentation (in Chinese, English, Japanese), installation scripts, and examples. Directory structure includes paddle (core), doc (docs), python (API bindings), test (tests), etc.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++ with Python APIs, supports CUDA/ROCm acceleration, built with CMake, and compatible with multiple OSes and hardware.
en.hot: As a leading DL framework in China, it has 24k stars, serving over 23.33 million developers with broad industrial adoption. Recent 3.2 release highlights automatic parallelism and integrated training/inference, sustaining attention.
uses: Industrial developers: for AI model development and deployment in manufacturing, agriculture, enterprise services, etc.
Researchers: leveraging automatic parallelism and high-order differentiation for large-scale model training and scientific computing.
Educators and students: learning deep learning via extensive docs and model libraries.

zh.tag: 华为昇腾上的 vLLM 硬件插件
zh.what: vllm-ascend 是 vLLM 官方社区维护的插件，让 vLLM 推理引擎能在华为昇腾（Ascend）AI 加速器上运行。它提供与昇腾硬件适配的算子、图模式和运行时支持，使用户可以无缝使用 vLLM 的高性能推理能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含插件源码、昇腾支持矩阵、官方文档、示例和发布版本。主要目录包括 vllm_ascend 核心实现、docs 文档、examples 示例等。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 和 Python，依赖 vLLM 和华为 CANN（昇腾计算架构）。使用 PyTorch 和自定义算子实现昇腾加速。
zh.hot: 随着昇腾芯片在国产 AI 基础设施中广泛应用，vLLM 用户对昇腾支持的需求激增。该项目作为官方插件，star 数已达 2703，今日新增 11，登上 C++ 趋势榜，反映出社区对国产硬件生态的强烈关注。
uses: 在华为昇腾服务器上部署 vLLM 推理服务的开发者
需要国产化 AI 硬件替代方案的云服务商和企业
研究昇腾性能优化和算子适配的 AI 工程师

en.tag: Hardware plugin for vLLM on Huawei Ascend
en.what: vllm-ascend is a community-maintained plugin that enables vLLM inference engine to run on Huawei Ascend AI accelerators. It provides Ascend-specific operators, graph modes, and runtime support, allowing users to leverage vLLM's high-performance inference capabilities seamlessly.
en.content: The repository contains plugin source code, Ascend support matrix, official documentation, examples, and release versions. Key directories include vllm_ascend core implementation, docs, and examples.
en.stack: Built with C++ and Python, depends on vLLM and Huawei CANN (Ascend Computing Architecture). Uses PyTorch and custom operators for Ascend acceleration.
en.hot: As Ascend chips gain traction in domestic AI infrastructure, vLLM users demand Ascend support. This official plugin has 2.7k stars with 11 new today, trending in C++ list, reflecting strong community interest in domestic hardware ecosystem.
uses: Developers deploying vLLM inference on Huawei Ascend servers
Cloud providers and enterprises seeking domestic AI hardware alternatives
AI engineers researching Ascend performance optimization and operator adaptation

zh.tag: ARM64 Linux 上运行 x86 应用的高性能模拟器
zh.what: FEX 是一个快速的用户态模拟器，允许在 ARM64 Linux 设备上运行 x86 和 x86-64 应用程序。它兼容 32 位和 64 位二进制，可与 Wine/Proton 结合运行 Windows 游戏，并支持将 API 调用转发到宿主系统库以减少模拟开销。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心源码、FEXConfig 图形配置工具、FEXRootFSFetcher 根文件系统下载工具，以及详细的文档和 Wiki 链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 ARMv8.0+ 硬件，支持多种 Linux 发行版，并利用 OpenGL/Vulkan 等宿主库进行 API 转发。
zh.hot: 随着 ARM 设备（如树莓派、ARM 服务器）的普及，用户对在 ARM 上运行 x86 应用的需求增加。FEX 提供了高性能解决方案，本月新增 172 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 23 名。
uses: ARM64 Linux 用户希望在 ARM 设备上运行 x86 专属软件或游戏
开发者测试 x86 应用在 ARM 环境下的兼容性
游戏玩家通过 Wine/Proton 在 ARM 设备上玩 Windows 游戏

en.tag: High-performance x86/x86-64 emulator for ARM64 Linux
en.what: FEX is a fast usermode emulator that allows running x86 and x86-64 applications on ARM64 Linux devices. It supports both 32-bit and 64-bit binaries, can be used with Wine/Proton to play Windows games, and forwards API calls to host libraries to reduce overhead.
en.content: The repository contains the emulator core source, FEXConfig GUI tool, FEXRootFSFetcher for downloading RootFS, and extensive documentation with wiki links.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, requires ARMv8.0+ hardware, supports multiple Linux distributions, and leverages host libraries like OpenGL/Vulkan for API forwarding.
en.hot: With the rise of ARM devices (e.g., Raspberry Pi, ARM servers), there's growing demand to run x86 apps on ARM. FEX offers a high-performance solution, gaining 172 stars this month and ranking #23 on the C++ trending list.
uses: ARM64 Linux users wanting to run x86-only software or games on ARM devices
Developers testing x86 app compatibility on ARM environments
Gamers playing Windows games on ARM devices via Wine/Proton

zh.tag: Claude 社区插件市场，只读镜像，每日同步
zh.what: 这是 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 的社区插件市场仓库，包含可安装的插件列表。它由 Anthropic 内部审核流程同步，所有插件都经过安全扫描和批准。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含一个 marketplace.json 文件，列出了所有社区插件及其元数据。此外还有 README 说明如何使用和提交插件。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Python，但仓库本身是静态 JSON 数据，由自动化流程同步。
zh.hot: 今日新增 190 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因为 Claude 插件生态正在快速增长，开发者需要官方认可的插件来源。
uses: Claude Code 用户：通过命令行快速安装社区插件，扩展功能。
插件开发者：提交插件到官方市场，获得分发和曝光。
企业团队：在受控环境中使用经过安全审核的插件。

en.tag: Read-only mirror of Claude community plugin marketplace, synced nightly
en.what: This is the community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code, containing a list of installable plugins. It is synced from Anthropic's internal review pipeline, and all plugins have passed security scanning and approval.
en.content: The repository mainly contains a marketplace.json file listing all community plugins with their metadata, plus a README explaining how to use and submit plugins.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, but the repo itself is static JSON data synced by automated processes.
en.hot: Gained 190 stars today and hit the trending list, as the Claude plugin ecosystem is rapidly growing and developers need an official source for plugins.
uses: Claude Code users: quickly install community plugins via CLI to extend functionality.
Plugin developers: submit plugins to the official marketplace for distribution and visibility.
Enterprise teams: use security-reviewed plugins in controlled environments.

zh.tag: DHH 出品的精美现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是由 DHH 打造的一款注重美观与现代感的 Linux 发行版，内置大量精选工具和配置，提供开箱即用的体验。它强调“有主见”的设计，通过详尽的官方手册指导用户完成从安装到日常使用的全过程。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含一个详尽的官方手册（manual/ 目录），涵盖入门、导航、主题、快捷键、应用（终端、Neovim、AI 等）、配置（dotfiles、字体、监控等）以及故障排除等内容。此外还有相关网站和文档的链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本，基于 Linux 发行版（如 Fedora 或类似系统），依赖常见的桌面环境组件和工具（如终端、Neovim、窗口管理器等）。
zh.hot: 作为知名开发者 DHH 的新项目，Omarchy 凭借其独特的美学和“有主见”的设计理念迅速吸引了大量关注，GitHub 星标数已接近 2.6 万，本周新增超 1400 星，位列趋势榜第 10。
uses: 喜欢折腾 Linux 桌面、追求美观和高效配置的开发者
希望快速上手一套完整、现代化 Linux 环境的用户
对 DHH 个人开发风格和理念感兴趣的粉丝
需要一份详尽 Linux 配置指南的学习者

en.tag: A beautiful, modern & opinionated Linux distro by DHH
en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution crafted by DHH, focusing on beauty and modernity, with a curated set of tools and configurations for an out-of-the-box experience. It emphasizes an opinionated design, guiding users through everything from installation to daily use with an extensive official manual.
en.content: The repository primarily contains an extensive official manual (in the manual/ directory), covering getting started, navigation, themes, hotkeys, applications (terminal, Neovim, AI, etc.), configuration (dotfiles, fonts, monitors, etc.), and troubleshooting. It also includes links to related websites and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily Shell scripts, built on a Linux distribution (likely Fedora or similar), with dependencies on common desktop environment components and tools (terminal, Neovim, window manager, etc.).
en.hot: As a new project by renowned developer DHH, Omarchy quickly gained attention for its unique aesthetics and opinionated design philosophy, amassing nearly 26k stars on GitHub, with over 1,400 stars added this week, ranking #10 on the trending list.
uses: Developers who enjoy tinkering with Linux desktops and seek beautiful, efficient configurations
Users who want to quickly adopt a complete, modern Linux environment
Fans interested in DHH's personal development style and philosophy
Learners who need a comprehensive Linux configuration guide

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: 终端里的轻量 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的本地运行编码代理，能在终端中直接执行代码任务。它支持与 ChatGPT 计划集成，也可通过 API 密钥使用，提供命令行交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、二进制发布包及文档，支持 npm、Homebrew 等安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 OpenAI API 或 ChatGPT 认证，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方开源项目，今日新增 2729 星，总星数突破 11 万，登顶 GitHub 日榜，开发者期待在终端中直接使用 AI 编程。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速执行 AI 辅助编码任务，无需离开命令行环境。
使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 等计划的用户，可无缝集成现有订阅进行编程。
需要轻量级、可脚本化的代码生成与修改工具的技术团队。

en.tag: Lightweight AI coding agent that runs in your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. It executes coding tasks directly in the terminal, integrates with ChatGPT plans, and can also be used with an API key.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, installation scripts, binary release assets, and documentation, with support for npm and Homebrew installation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it relies on OpenAI API or ChatGPT authentication, and supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).
en.hot: As an official OpenAI open-source project, it gained 2,729 stars today, surpassing 110k total stars and topping the daily GitHub trending list. Developers are eager to use AI coding directly in the terminal.
uses: Developers who want to perform AI-assisted coding tasks quickly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，日志即运行时
zh.what: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，用于实际工作而非仅仅回答问题。它通过受控权限检查项目、执行工具、生成工件，并将模型消息和工具调用记录为可恢复的执行事实。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron + React）、终端 TUI 和 CLI（maka, maka run）、评估工具（maka eval run），以及核心的 Runtime Host 和 Runtime Event Log 实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，桌面端基于 Electron 和 React，支持多种模型连接（云 API、本地模型或兼容网关），并包含本地工具如 Read、Write、Edit、Bash、Glob 和 Grep。
zh.hot: 今日新增 460 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 7，因其本地优先、日志即运行时的创新架构，以及 Apache 孵化项目的背书，吸引了关注 AI 代理可靠性和可恢复性的开发者。
uses: 日常 AI 辅助开发：在本地项目中安全地让代理读写文件、执行命令。
需要可审计、可恢复的 AI 代理工作流的团队，用于记录和回溯每次工具调用。
AI 代理评估：使用 maka eval 进行可复现的基准测试。
偏好本地优先、数据不出机器的隐私敏感用户。

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace with log-as-runtime architecture
en.what: Apache Maka is a local-first AI agent workspace built for real work. It inspects projects, executes tools, produces artifacts with controlled permissions, and preserves model messages and tool calls as recoverable execution facts.
en.content: The repo includes a desktop app (Electron + React), a terminal TUI and CLI (maka, maka run), an evaluation tool (maka eval run), and the core Runtime Host and Runtime Event Log implementation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Electron and React for the desktop app, supporting multiple model connections (cloud API, local model, or compatible gateway), and local tools including Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, and Grep.
en.hot: With 460 stars added today and ranking #7 on the TypeScript trending list, its local-first, log-as-runtime architecture and Apache incubation status attract developers focused on AI agent reliability and recoverability.
uses: Daily AI-assisted development: let agents safely read/write files and run commands in local projects.
Teams needing auditable and recoverable AI agent workflows, with logs of every tool call.
AI agent evaluation: use maka eval for reproducible benchmark experiments.
Privacy-conscious users preferring local-first, data-stays-on-machine solutions.

zh.tag: 统一 AI 开发与部署平台，含 MAX 框架与 Mojo 语言
zh.what: Modular Platform 是一个开源平台，旨在统一 AI 开发与部署流程，包含 MAX 框架（用于模型推理和部署）和 Mojo 语言（一种面向 AI 的高性能编程语言）。它提供从模型编译、优化到服务部署的完整工具链，并支持 OpenAI 兼容的端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Mojo 编译器、Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库、MAX 推理服务器、MAX 模型流水线以及大量代码示例。目录结构清晰，分为 /KGEN、/mojo、/max 等模块，方便开发者浏览和贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Mojo 语言编写，同时涉及 Python（用于 MAX 的 Python API）和 C++（底层内核）。依赖 LLVM 等编译器基础设施，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证（含 LLVM 例外）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 268 星，总星数 27933，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。Mojo 语言和 MAX 框架的独特定位吸引了大量 AI 开发者，其高性能和统一平台理念备受关注。
uses: AI 开发者：使用 Mojo 语言编写高性能 AI 模型，或利用 MAX 框架进行模型部署和推理。
MLOps 工程师：通过 MAX 推理服务器快速搭建 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务。
研究人员：在 MAX 流水线中集成自定义模型架构，并利用加速器库优化性能。
开源贡献者：参与 Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库等模块的开发和改进。

en.tag: Unified AI development & deployment platform, including MAX framework and Mojo language
en.what: The Modular Platform is an open-source platform that unifies AI development and deployment, including the MAX framework for model inference and deployment, and the Mojo language, a high-performance programming language for AI. It provides a complete toolchain from model compilation and optimization to service deployment, with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
en.content: The repo contains the Mojo compiler, Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, MAX inference server, MAX model pipelines, and numerous code examples. The directory structure is clear, with modules like /KGEN, /mojo, /max, making it easy to navigate and contribute.
en.stack: Primarily written in Mojo, with Python for MAX's Python API and C++ for low-level kernels. It relies on LLVM and other compiler infrastructure, and is licensed under Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions.
en.hot: With 268 stars added today and 27,933 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. The unique positioning of Mojo and MAX attracts AI developers, drawing attention to its high performance and unified platform concept.
uses: AI developers: Use Mojo to write high-performance AI models or leverage MAX for deployment and inference.
MLOps engineers: Quickly set up OpenAI-compatible model serving with the MAX inference server.
Researchers: Integrate custom model architectures in MAX pipelines and optimize performance with the accelerator library.
Open-source contributors: Contribute to the Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, and more.

zh.tag: 一键生成高清短视频的AI自动化工具
zh.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一个利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据用户提供的主题或关键词，自动生成视频脚本、匹配素材、生成字幕和背景音乐，并合成高清短视频的一站式工具。用户只需输入一个主题或关键词，即可获得完整的短视频成品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 源代码、WebUI 界面、API 接口、文档和示例，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。提供 WebUI 和 API 两种交互方式，方便用户通过图形界面或程序化调用生成视频。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，依赖 AI 大模型（如 Kimi K3）进行文案生成和素材匹配，使用自动化工作流整合视频合成、字幕和背景音乐生成。
zh.hot: 凭借 10 万+ Star 和今日新增 470 星，它成为 GitHub Python 趋势榜第 13 名，因其极大降低了短视频创作门槛，让任何人都能快速生成专业级视频，满足了内容创作者和营销人员的强烈需求。
uses: 内容创作者：快速生成短视频素材，提升内容产出效率。
营销人员：根据产品关键词自动生成宣传视频，用于社交媒体推广。
教育工作者：将知识点转化为生动的视频讲解，辅助教学。
开发者：通过 API 集成到自己的应用或工作流中，实现自动化视频生成。

en.tag: One-click AI tool to auto-generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword
en.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an all-in-one AI tool that leverages large language models and automated workflows to generate HD short videos from a user-provided topic or keyword. It automatically creates the script, matches stock footage, generates subtitles and background music, and composes the final video.
en.content: The repository contains full Python source code, a WebUI, API endpoints, documentation, and examples, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It offers both a graphical WebUI and an API for programmatic video generation.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.11+, it relies on AI LLMs (e.g., Kimi K3) for script writing and material matching, and uses automated workflows to integrate video composition, subtitles, and background music generation.
en.hot: With over 100k stars and 470 new stars today, it ranks #13 on GitHub Trending (Python). Its popularity stems from dramatically lowering the barrier to short-video creation, enabling anyone to quickly produce professional-looking videos, meeting the strong demand from content creators and marketers.
uses: Content creators: Quickly generate short video material to boost output efficiency.
Marketers: Auto-generate promotional videos from product keywords for social media campaigns.
Educators: Turn knowledge points into engaging video explanations to aid teaching.
Developers: Integrate via API into their own apps or workflows for automated video generation.

zh.tag: 自托管、隐私优先的个人财务管理工具
zh.what: Securo 是一款开源的个人财务管理器，强调数据自主权，让用户在自己的基础设施上运行，完全掌控账户、支出和习惯，不向第三方泄露任何数据。它提供多账户管理、交易管理、自动分类、预算、目标追踪等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端、后端、文档和安装脚本，提供 Docker 镜像和 Helm chart，支持快速部署。主要目录包括 docs、src 等，包含完整的应用代码和测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，前端可能涉及 JavaScript/TypeScript，依赖 Docker 或 Podman 进行容器化部署，支持多种文件格式导入（OFX, QIF, CAMT, CSV）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 617 星，总星数达 2307，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 17 名。其隐私优先的理念和自托管特性吸引了关注数据安全的用户。
uses: 注重财务数据隐私的个人用户，希望完全掌控自己的财务信息。
技术爱好者或开发者，喜欢自托管服务并愿意自行部署和维护。
小型团队或家庭，需要集中管理多账户和预算，同时避免第三方服务。

en.tag: Self-hosted, privacy-first personal finance manager
en.what: Securo is an open-source personal finance manager that emphasizes data sovereignty, allowing users to run it on their own infrastructure, gaining full visibility into accounts, spending, and habits without surrendering data to third parties. It offers multi-account management, transaction management, auto-categorization, budgets, and goal tracking.

Research and education: for exploring new paradigms in agent context management.

zh.tag: 自愈式浏览器工具，让LLM直接操控真实浏览器
zh.what: Browser Harness 是一个开源工具，通过可编辑的 CDP WebSocket 将 LLM 直接连接到真实浏览器，使 AI 代理能够执行任意任务。它采用自愈机制：当代理缺少某个操作所需的辅助函数时，会自动编写并保存这些函数，从而在每次任务中不断改进自身能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含安装指南（install.md）、技能定义（SKILL.md）以及核心源码（src/browser_harness/），源码受保护，而代理在本地工作区中编写可复用的辅助函数。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.12，使用 uv 进行包管理，通过 CDP（Chrome DevTools Protocol）与浏览器通信，支持与 Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理集成。
zh.hot: 本周新增 373 星，总星数达 17162，位列 GitHub Python 周榜第 12。其自愈能力和直接连接真实浏览器的特性，解决了 AI 代理在网页自动化中的痛点，备受开发者关注。
uses: 开发者希望让 AI 代理自动完成网页操作，如文件上传、数据下载等。
需要构建可自我改进的浏览器自动化工具或研究 Web Agent 的学习能力。
希望通过编码代理（如 Claude Code）快速集成浏览器控制能力。

en.tag: Self-healing harness that connects LLMs to real browsers via CDP
en.what: Browser Harness is an open-source tool that connects LLMs directly to a real browser via an editable CDP WebSocket, enabling AI agents to perform any task. en.content: The repository includes installation guide (install.md), skill definition (SKILL.md), and core source code (src/browser_harness/), which is protected while the agent writes reusable helpers in its local workspace.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.12, uses uv for package management, communicates with browsers via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol), and integrates with coding agents like Claude Code and Codex.
en.hot: With 373 new stars this week and 17,162 total, ranking 12th on GitHub's Python weekly trending, its self-healing capability and direct real-browser connection address key pain points in web automation for AI agents, attracting significant developer attention.
uses: Developers who want AI agents to automate web tasks like file uploads and data downloads.
Researchers or builders creating self-improving browser automation tools or studying web agent learning.
Users who want to integrate browser control into coding agents like Claude Code quickly.

zh.tag: 在 Apple Silicon 上以多 token 预测加速本地 LLM 推理
zh.what: MTPLX 是一个原生 Mac 应用和命令行工具，利用模型自带的多 token 预测（MTP）头来加速本地大语言模型的推理。它通过批量验证多个草稿 token 并采用精确拒绝采样，在不改变输出分布的前提下实现最高 2.24 倍的加速。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Mac 应用（DMG 下载）和命令行工具，提供模型推荐、下载、安装和性能测量功能。内置多个 Qwen 3.8/3.6 的量化版本，如 Optimized Speed、Bare Speed 和 Optimized Quality，并支持自动选择最适合硬件的配置。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，使用 MLX 框架（Apple 的机器学习库）进行推理，支持 macOS 14+ 和 Apple Silicon（M1 及以上）。通过 PyPI 和 Homebrew 分发，并包含 CI 和许可证等标准项目文件。
zh.hot: 本周新增 370 星，总星数达 1589，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 17 名。它解决了 MLX 生态中一个痛点：大多数运行时未利用模型内置的 MTP 头，而 MTPLX 提供了显著的加速且不牺牲输出质量。
uses: Mac 用户（Apple Silicon）希望在不购买额外硬件的情况下加速本地 LLM 推理，适合开发者和 AI 爱好者。
需要运行 Qwen 3.8 27B 等大型模型的用户，通过多 token 预测获得接近两倍的解码速度。
对推理速度敏感的应用场景，如代码生成、交互式聊天等，且要求输出分布与标准解码完全一致。

en.tag: Multi-token prediction to speed up local LLM inference on Apple Silicon
en.what: MTPLX is a native Mac app and CLI that accelerates local LLM inference using the model's built-in multi-token prediction (MTP) heads. It verifies multiple drafted tokens in a single batched forward pass and uses exact rejection sampling, achieving up to 2.24x speedup without changing the output distribution.
en.content: The repo includes a full Mac app (DMG download) and CLI, offering model recommendation, download, installation, and performance measurement. It bundles several quantized versions of Qwen 3.8/3.6, such as Optimized Speed, Bare Speed, and Optimized Quality, and automatically selects the best configuration for the hardware.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.11+, uses the MLX framework (Apple's machine learning library) for inference, supports macOS 14+ and Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). Distributed via PyPI and Homebrew, with CI and standard project files.
en.hot: Gained 370 stars this week, reaching 1589 total, and ranked #17 on GitHub Trending (Python) weekly. It addresses a pain point in the MLX ecosystem: most runtimes don't use the built-in MTP heads, and MTPLX provides significant speedup without sacrificing output quality.
uses: Mac users (Apple Silicon) who want to speed up local LLM inference without extra hardware, suitable for developers and AI enthusiasts.
Users running large models like Qwen 3.8 27B, gaining nearly 2x decoding speed via multi-token prediction.
Applications sensitive to inference speed, such as code generation and interactive chat, while requiring output distribution identical to standard decoding.

zh.tag: macOS 菜单栏原生 LLM 推理服务器，支持连续批处理与 SSD 缓存

zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.11-3.13，针对 Apple Silicon 优化，可能包含自定义内核（如 GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3）。支持 Homebrew 安装，可选安装 MCP 依赖。

uses: Mac 用户希望在本地运行 LLM，并通过菜单栏轻松管理模型和上下文

en.tag: Native macOS menu bar LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching
en.what: oMLX is an LLM inference server optimized for Apple Silicon, featuring continuous batching and tiered KV caching that persists hot data in memory and cold data on SSD, enabling cache reuse across requests. Users can manage models, switch context lengths, and monitor performance directly from the macOS menu bar.
en.content: The repository includes a full macOS app (.dmg installer), Homebrew installation support, a CLI shim (~/.omlx/bin/omlx), and optional MCP support. It also provides multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/KO/JA) and a benchmarks page.
en.stack: Primarily Python 3.11-3.13, optimized for Apple Silicon, possibly with custom kernels (e.g., GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3). Supports Homebrew installation, with optional MCP dependencies.
en.hot: Addresses Mac users' pain point: balancing convenience and control by managing LLM servers from the menu bar, with SSD caching for long-context reuse, ideal for local AI development. With ~19k stars and +78 today, it ranks #8 on GitHub Trending daily.

Developers using tools like Claude Code for real coding, needing cross-request caching for efficiency

Those integrating with automation workflows via Homebrew or CLI (e.g., Apple Shortcuts)

多任务开发者：在无限画布上组织多个终端，避免标签页混乱，保持上下文。
远程工作场景：通过 Server Edition 在浏览器中访问同一画布，或使用 iOS 伴侣应用随时查看。
ADHD 或偏好视觉化工作流的人群：用空间布局代替隐藏标签，提升专注和效率。

en.tag: Terminal & AI agent manager on an infinite canvas
en.what: nodeterm is a node-based terminal manager that places multiple real terminals as draggable nodes on an infinite pan/zoom canvas. Built for AI coding agents, it turns every project into a Trello-style board of live Claude Code sessions.
en.content: The repo includes an Electron desktop app (macOS/Linux), a self-hosted browser version (Server Edition), and an iOS companion, all sharing a common service seam. It provides installers (.dmg, .AppImage, .deb), docs, architecture notes, and build-from-source instructions.
en.stack: Built with Electron and TypeScript, using tmux for terminal backend. Supports macOS (arm64/x64) and Linux (x64), with a browser Server Edition and an iOS companion that attaches to the same live sessions.
en.hot: Gained 78 stars today, reaching 956 total, ranking #9 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) daily. Its unique selling point is replacing stacked tabs with a spatial canvas, designed for ADHD and scattered workflows, while deeply integrating AI agents—hitting a nerve with developers.
uses: AI coding agent users: need to manage multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel, tracking progress via a kanban board.
Multitasking developers: organize multiple terminals on an infinite canvas to avoid tab clutter and maintain context.
Remote work scenarios: access the same canvas via the browser Server Edition or check in with the iOS companion.
People with ADHD or visual workflow preferences: spatial layout replaces hidden tabs, boosting focus and efficiency.

zh.tag: 可视化 AI 代理与工作流自动化平台
zh.what: n8n 是一个公平代码（fair-code）的工作流自动化平台，原生支持 AI 能力。它允许用户通过可视化画布结合自定义代码来构建和部署 AI 代理与多步骤工作流，支持自托管或云服务，并集成超过 1500 个应用和服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 n8n 的完整源代码，包括前端编辑器、后端服务、节点库（集成）、文档和示例工作流模板。项目采用 TypeScript 编写，支持通过 Docker 快速部署。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Node.js 构建。前端使用 Vue.js，后端使用 Express 和 Bull（任务队列），支持 Docker 部署，并集成多种 AI 模型提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）和开源模型。
zh.hot: n8n 在 GitHub 上拥有超过 20 万星标，本周新增 1435 星，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 9。其火爆源于 AI 原生自动化平台的定位，结合可视化构建与代码灵活性，满足从原型到生产的需求，且支持自托管，受到开发者和企业的广泛青睐。
uses: 开发者：快速构建和部署 AI 代理与自动化工作流，无需从零编写代码。
企业团队：利用可视化画布和 1500+ 集成，实现业务流程自动化，并支持自托管以满足安全合规要求。
AI 爱好者：通过连接多种模型和工具，实验多步骤 AI 代理，从原型到生产。
运维人员：使用 Docker 或云服务轻松部署 n8n，并利用角色权限和审计日志进行管理。

en.tag: Visual platform for AI agents and workflow automation
en.what: n8n is a fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. It lets users build and deploy AI agents and multi-step workflows by combining a visual canvas with custom code, self-hosted or in the cloud, with 1500+ integrations.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of n8n, including the frontend editor, backend services, node library (integrations), documentation, and example workflow templates. The project is written in TypeScript and supports quick deployment via Docker.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on Node.js. Frontend uses Vue.js, backend uses Express and Bull (job queue), supports Docker deployment, and integrates with various AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and open-source models.
en.hot: n8n has over 200k stars on GitHub, with 1,435 new stars this week, ranking 9th on the TypeScript weekly trending. Its popularity stems from being an AI-native automation platform that combines visual building with code flexibility, supporting self-hosting, and catering to both developers and enterprises.
uses: Developers: quickly build and deploy AI agents and automation workflows without writing code from scratch.
Enterprise teams: automate business processes with visual canvas and 1500+ integrations, with self-hosting for security and compliance.
AI enthusiasts: experiment with multi-step AI agents by connecting various models and tools, from prototype to production.
Ops personnel: easily deploy n8n with Docker or cloud services, and manage with role-based access and audit logs.

zh.tag: 内容驱动网站的现代 Web 构建工具
zh.what: Astro 是一个面向现代 Web 的网站构建工具，专注于内容驱动的网站。它提供强大的开发者体验，同时输出轻量级的静态页面，默认零 JavaScript，可按需加载组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 astro 包、create-astro 脚手架，以及 React、Preact、Solid、Svelte、Vue 等官方集成。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用 npm 管理，支持多种前端框架集成。
zh.hot: 本周新增 226 星，总星数超 6.2 万，因其创新的 Islands 架构和出色的性能而广受欢迎。
uses: 适合构建博客、文档站、营销页等以内容为核心的网站。
适合希望获得良好 SEO 和性能的开发者。
适合需要集成 React、Vue 等框架的团队。

en.tag: The web framework for content-driven websites
en.what: Astro is a website build tool for the modern web, focused on content-driven websites. It offers a powerful developer experience with lightweight output, shipping zero JavaScript by default and hydrating components on demand.
en.content: The repository contains the core astro package, the create-astro scaffolding tool, and official integrations for React, Preact, Solid, Svelte, and Vue.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, managed via npm, and supports integrations with multiple frontend frameworks.
en.hot: Gained 226 stars this week, with over 62k total, popular for its innovative Islands architecture and excellent performance.
uses: Ideal for building content-focused websites like blogs, docs, and marketing pages.
Great for developers who prioritize SEO and performance.
Suitable for teams needing to integrate frameworks like React or Vue.

zh.tag: 高质量 TypeScript 类型定义仓库
zh.what: DefinitelyTyped 是 TypeScript 社区维护的高质量类型定义仓库，为没有自带类型的 npm 包提供 .d.ts 文件。它通过社区贡献和严格审查，确保类型定义的准确性和可用性。
zh.content: 仓库包含数千个包的 @types 定义，采用 pnpm monorepo 结构，每个包独立管理，并有完善的贡献指南和自动化检查。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 pnpm 管理依赖，dtslint 进行类型检查和 lint，GitHub Actions 用于 CI。
zh.hot: 作为 TypeScript 生态的基础设施，star 数高达 51k，虽今日新增不多，但持续被开发者依赖和贡献。
uses: TypeScript 开发者：为缺少类型的 npm 包安装 @types 定义，提升开发体验。
库作者：通过贡献类型定义，让更多用户受益，同时提升自身库的可用性。
维护者/贡献者：参与社区审查，确保类型定义质量，积累开源经验。

en.tag: High-quality TypeScript type definitions repository
en.what: DefinitelyTyped is a community-maintained repository providing high-quality TypeScript type definitions (.d.ts files) for npm packages that lack built-in types. It relies on community contributions and rigorous review to ensure accuracy and usability.
en.content: The repo contains thousands of @types definitions for various packages, organized as a pnpm monorepo with independent package management, comprehensive contribution guidelines, and automated checks.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript, uses pnpm for dependency management, dtslint for type-checking and linting, and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: As a foundational piece of the TypeScript ecosystem, it has 51k stars; despite modest daily growth, it remains heavily relied upon and contributed to by developers.
uses: TypeScript developers: install @types definitions for packages lacking types to improve DX.
Library authors: contribute type definitions to benefit users and enhance library usability.
Maintainers/contributors: participate in community review to ensure quality and gain OSS experience.

zh.tag: 开源项目管理平台，Jira/Linear 替代品
zh.what: Plane 是一个开源的项目管理平台，旨在替代 Jira、Linear、Monday 和 ClickUp。它帮助团队管理任务、迭代（Cycles）、文档和问题分类（Triage），提供现代化的用户体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的项目管理系统源码，包括前端（TypeScript/React）、后端（Python/Django）以及部署配置（Docker、Kubernetes）。提供丰富的功能：工作项、周期、模块、视图等。
zh.stack: 前端使用 TypeScript 和 React，后端使用 Python 和 Django，数据库采用 PostgreSQL，支持 Docker 和 Kubernetes 部署。
zh.hot: Plane 在 GitHub 上拥有 56k+ stars，今日新增 98 个，位列 Trending 日榜第 15。其开源替代商业项目管理工具的理念吸引了大量开发者，且功能丰富、部署灵活。
uses: 团队项目管理：适合需要任务跟踪、迭代管理和文档协作的团队。
自托管需求：对数据隐私和基础设施有控制要求的企业或组织。
开发者社区：对开源项目管理工具感兴趣，希望参与贡献或定制的开发者。

en.tag: Open-source project management platform, Jira/Linear alternative
en.what: Plane is an open-source project management platform designed as an alternative to Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp. It helps teams manage tasks, cycles, docs, and triage with a modern user experience.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the project management system, including frontend (TypeScript/React), backend (Python/Django), and deployment configurations (Docker, Kubernetes). It offers rich features: work items, cycles, modules, views, etc.
en.stack: Frontend uses TypeScript and React, backend uses Python and Django, database is PostgreSQL, supports Docker and Kubernetes deployment.
en.hot: Plane has 56k+ stars on GitHub, with 98 new stars today, ranking 15th on the daily trending list. Its open-source alternative to commercial project management tools attracts many developers, with rich features and flexible deployment.
uses: Team project management: suitable for teams needing task tracking, cycle management, and document collaboration.
Self-hosting needs: enterprises or organizations requiring control over data and infrastructure.
Developer community: developers interested in open-source project management tools, wanting to contribute or customize.

zh.tag: 开源无头 CMS，现代出版与订阅平台
zh.what: Ghost 是一个开源、无头的 Node.js CMS，专为现代出版、会员、订阅和新闻通讯设计。它提供简洁的编辑体验和强大的 API，支持构建网站、博客和付费内容平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CMS 核心代码，包括前端、后端、主题系统、管理界面以及文档。支持自托管或使用官方托管服务 Ghost(Pro)。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/Node.js，基于 Express 框架，前端采用 Ember.js，数据库支持 MySQL 和 SQLite。
zh.hot: 拥有 5.5 万星标，是 GitHub 上最流行的开源 CMS 之一，持续活跃开发，今日新增 23 星，位列 JavaScript 日榜第三。
uses: 内容创作者和博主：需要简洁高效的写作平台，支持订阅和会员功能。
开发者：希望使用可定制、API 驱动的无头 CMS 构建现代网站或应用。
企业和媒体：需要可靠、可扩展的发布平台，支持多作者和付费墙。

en.tag: Open-source headless CMS for modern publishing, subscriptions & newsletters
en.what: Ghost is an open-source, headless Node.js CMS built for modern publishing, memberships, subscriptions, and newsletters. It offers a clean editing experience and powerful APIs for building websites, blogs, and paid content platforms.
en.content: The repo contains the full CMS core, including frontend, backend, theme system, admin UI, and documentation. Supports self-hosting or official managed service Ghost(Pro).
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript/Node.js, built on Express, frontend uses Ember.js, database supports MySQL and SQLite.
en.hot: With 55k stars, it's one of the most popular open-source CMS on GitHub, actively developed, gaining 23 stars today, ranking 3rd on JavaScript daily trending.
uses: Content creators and bloggers: need a clean, efficient writing platform with subscription and membership features.
Developers: want a customizable, API-driven headless CMS to build modern websites or apps.
Businesses and media: need a reliable, scalable publishing platform with multi-author and paywall support.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 编码工具用量监控桌面小组件
zh.what: Token Monitor 是一个桌面小组件，用于实时监控 29+ 款 AI 编码工具（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 等）的 token 用量、费用和账户限制。它支持多设备同步、历史趋势分析，并按工具、设备、模型、会话或项目维度进行统计。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码、安装包（支持 Windows/macOS/Linux）、演示 GIF、以及多语言 README（中/英/日/韩等）。核心功能包括实时用量监控、多设备同步、历史趋势和工具/设备/模型/会话/项目维度统计。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，桌面应用跨平台支持 Windows 10+、macOS 12+ 和 Linux x64。依赖本地数据路径读取（如 ~/.claude、~/.codex）实现无侵入监控，并集成多设备同步机制。
zh.hot: 本月新增 677 星（总星数 1323），登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（JavaScript）第 17 名。随着 AI 编码工具激增，开发者对用量透明化和成本控制的需求强烈，该工具填补了这一空白。
uses: 重度 AI 编码工具用户：实时监控 token 消耗，避免超出账户限制
团队管理者：跨设备同步用量数据，统一管理多成员的成本
成本敏感型开发者：按项目/模型/会话分析历史趋势，优化支出
自托管爱好者：本地优先存储，数据隐私可控

en.tag: Local-first desktop widget for tracking AI coding tool usage
en.what: Token Monitor is a desktop widget that provides real-time monitoring of token usage, costs, and account limits across 29+ AI coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode. It features multi-device sync, historical trends, and breakdowns by tool, device, model, session, or project.
en.content: The repository includes desktop app source code, installers for Windows/macOS/Linux, demo GIF, and multilingual READMEs (EN/CN/JP/KR etc.). Core features include live usage monitoring, multi-device sync, historical trends, and breakdowns by tool/device/model/session/project.
en.stack: Built primarily with JavaScript, the desktop app supports Windows 10+, macOS 12+, and Linux x64. It reads local data paths (e.g., ~/.claude, ~/.codex) for non-intrusive monitoring and integrates multi-device sync.
en.hot: Gained 677 stars this month (total 1323), ranking #17 on GitHub Trending monthly (JavaScript). With the proliferation of AI coding tools, developers strongly need usage transparency and cost control, and this tool fills that gap.
uses: Heavy AI coding tool users: monitor token consumption in real-time to avoid hitting account limits
Team managers: sync usage data across devices to manage costs for multiple members
Cost-conscious developers: analyze historical trends by project/model/session to optimize spending
Self-hosting enthusiasts: local-first storage for data privacy control

zh.tag: AI 代理全自动管理 YouTube 频道，免费 Gemini 可用
zh.what: 这是一个利用 AI 代理实现 YouTube 频道全自动管理的工具。它能够自动创建、优化并发布视频，全天候运行，无需人工干预。支持使用免费的 Gemini API 或 OpenAI，且无需编写代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的自动化流程：视频脚本生成、图像生成、语音合成、视频渲染（利用 FFmpeg）、以及 YouTube 发布队列。提供命令行工具（如 npm run setup、npm run walkthrough）进行配置和引导，支持多种 AI 提供商（OpenAI、Gemini、OpenRouter 等）。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Node.js（JavaScript），依赖 FFmpeg（通过 ffmpeg-static 捆绑）、dotenv 管理环境变量，并集成多个 AI 提供商的 API（OpenAI、Gemini、OpenRouter、Kimi、MiMo、GLM）。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 164 星，总星数达 2010，位列 JavaScript 趋势榜第 4。其吸引力在于提供完全免费（使用 Gemini）的自动化 YouTube 频道管理，大幅降低内容创作门槛，且持续更新修复问题，社区反响热烈。
uses: 内容创作者：希望自动化视频生成和发布，节省时间。
营销人员：需要批量生成视频内容以扩大品牌影响力。
开发者：对 AI 代理工作流和自动化管道感兴趣，可二次开发。
初学者：无需编程经验，通过引导式设置即可上手。

en.tag: Fully automated YouTube channel management with AI agents, works with free Gemini or OpenAI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI agents to fully automate YouTube channel management. It can automatically create, optimize, and publish videos, running 24/7 without manual intervention. It works with the free Gemini API or OpenAI, and requires no coding.
en.content: The repository contains a complete automation pipeline: video script generation, image generation, voice narration, video rendering (using FFmpeg), and a YouTube publishing queue. It provides CLI tools (e.g., npm run setup, npm run walkthrough) for configuration and guided setup, supporting multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily built on Node.js (JavaScript), with dependencies on FFmpeg (bundled via ffmpeg-static), dotenv for environment variables, and integrations with multiple AI provider APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Kimi, MiMo, GLM).
en.hot: The project is rapidly gaining traction on GitHub, with 164 stars today and 2010 total, ranking #4 on the JavaScript trending list. Its appeal lies in offering fully automated YouTube channel management for free (using Gemini), significantly lowering the barrier to content creation, and its continuous updates and issue fixes have garnered strong community response.
uses: Content creators: who want to automate video generation and publishing to save time.
Marketers: needing to produce video content at scale for brand reach.
Developers: interested in AI agent workflows and automation pipelines, can customize.
Beginners: no coding experience needed, guided setup makes it easy to start.

zh.tag: 免费获取个性化 .is-a.dev 子域名
zh.what: is-a.dev 是一个免费服务，允许开发者为其个人网站获取一个美观的 .is-a.dev 子域名。通过提交 PR 注册域名，审核通过后即可使用。

开源项目：为项目文档或演示页面提供专属域名。

en.tag: Get your own free .is-a.dev subdomain
en.what: is-a.dev is a free service that lets developers get a nice .is-a.dev subdomain for their personal websites. You register by opening a pull request, and once merged, your DNS records are published.

en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, relies on GitHub Actions for automation, and DNS management is powered by Cloudflare.
en.hot: With 72 new stars this week and over 11k total, it's popular for offering free, easy, and personalized subdomains for developers.

Open-source projects: provide a dedicated domain for docs or demos.
Students and hobbyists: obtain a professional-looking domain for learning or portfolios.

教育工作者：制作课件或教学材料，支持多主题和导出格式。

Developers interested in AI-assisted programming toolchains and improving agent efficiency

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的高性能 JS/TS 工具链集合

zh.hot: Oxc 因成为 Vite 下一代打包器 Rolldown 的核心而备受关注，其 Rust 实现带来显著的性能提升，吸引了大量 star（22k+），并在 GitHub Trending 上持续上榜。
uses: 前端工具链开发者：希望构建或集成高性能 JS 解析、转换、压缩功能的开发者。
使用 Vite/Rolldown 的团队：需要极速打包和开发体验的现代前端项目。
需要快速 lint 和格式化的项目：用 oxlint 和 oxfmt 替代传统工具以提升 CI 速度。
对 Rust 与 JS 互操作感兴趣的工程师：学习如何用 Rust 构建高性能 JS 工具。

en.tag: A collection of high-performance JavaScript/TypeScript tools written in Rust
en.what: Oxc (The Oxidation Compiler) is a collection of high-performance tools for JavaScript and TypeScript written in Rust, aiming to provide a unified, ultra-fast toolchain for the JS ecosystem. It powers Rolldown (Vite's bundler) and enables the next generation of seamlessly integrated, ultra-fast development tools.
en.content: The repository contains components such as a parser, transformer, minifier, module resolver, as well as linter (Oxlint) and formatter (Oxfmt), offering CLI tools and libraries for integration.

uses: Developers building or integrating high-performance JS parsing, transformation, or minification features.
Teams using Vite/Rolldown: modern frontend projects needing blazing-fast bundling and dev experience.
Projects needing fast linting and formatting: replace traditional tools with oxlint and oxfmt to speed up CI.
Engineers interested in Rust-JS interop: learn how to build high-performance JS tools in Rust.

隐私敏感应用：要求数据本地处理，避免云端 API 的合规场景。
Rust 与 Node.js 开发者：希望用 Rust 高性能内核，同时用 JavaScript 快速构建原型。

en.tag: Rust-native persistent memory DB for AI agents
en.what: RuVector is a high-performance, real-time, self-learning AI memory database built in Rust, designed for AI agents to remember across sessions. It combines local semantic embeddings, persistent vector retrieval, graph relationships, explicit feedback learning, and memory lifecycle controls, and runs without a database server or API key.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust core library (ruvector-core), Node.js bindings (npm package ruvector), a CLI tool (npx ruvector), and examples, supporting semantic embeddings (ONNX model) and vector storage.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with npm package and npx CLI, leveraging ONNX Runtime for local embeddings, supporting various distance metrics like cosine similarity.
en.hot: With 4,447 stars and 3 new stars today, RuVector ranks #14 on the Rust trending list, attracting developers with its unique value proposition of persistent memory for AI agents without external services.
uses: AI agent developers: chatbots or autonomous agents needing cross-session memory can quickly integrate persistent memory.
Privacy-sensitive applications: compliance scenarios requiring local data processing, avoiding cloud APIs.
Rust and Node.js developers: want high-performance Rust core with rapid JavaScript prototyping.

zh.tag: 类型安全、可扩展的友好编程语言
zh.what: Gleam 是一门面向类型安全和可扩展系统设计的友好编程语言。它结合了函数式编程的简洁性与静态类型的可靠性，旨在让开发者能够轻松构建健壮的应用程序。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Gleam 编译器的完整实现，包括解析器、类型检查器、代码生成器以及标准库。项目采用 Rust 编写，并配有丰富的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，依赖 Rust 生态中的多个库，如 serde、clap 等，用于序列化、命令行解析等。
zh.hot: Gleam 因其友好的语法和强大的类型系统而受到关注，在 Rust 社区中持续获得高热度，今日新增 31 星，总星数达 21819，位列日榜第七。
uses: 适合希望使用静态类型语言但追求更简洁语法的开发者，用于构建 Web 服务、CLI 工具等。
适合函数式编程爱好者，希望在不牺牲性能的前提下享受类型安全的保障。
适合教学场景，作为入门级函数式编程语言，帮助理解类型系统和编译原理。

en.tag: A friendly, type-safe language for building scalable systems
en.what: Gleam is a friendly programming language designed for building type-safe and scalable systems. It combines the simplicity of functional programming with the reliability of static typing, aiming to let developers easily build robust applications.
en.content: The repository contains the complete implementation of the Gleam compiler, including parser, type checker, code generator, and standard library. The project is written in Rust and comes with extensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, leveraging various libraries from the Rust ecosystem such as serde and clap for serialization and command-line parsing.
en.hot: Gleam gains attention for its friendly syntax and powerful type system, maintaining high popularity in the Rust community with 31 new stars today, reaching 21,819 total and ranking 7th on the daily trending list.
uses: Ideal for developers who prefer static typing but desire a cleaner syntax, suitable for building web services, CLI tools, etc.
Great for functional programming enthusiasts who want type safety without sacrificing performance.
Useful in educational settings as an introductory functional language to understand type systems and compiler design.

zh.tag: 终端工作区，开箱即用的终端复用器
zh.what: Zellij 是一个面向开发者、运维人员和终端爱好者的终端工作区，类似于终端复用器。它旨在不牺牲简单性的前提下提供强大功能，拥有开箱即用的优秀体验和高级特性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Zellij 的完整源代码，包括核心终端复用功能、布局系统、插件系统、Web 客户端以及文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，插件系统支持编译为 WebAssembly 的任何语言，内置 Web 客户端。
zh.hot: Zellij 因其独特的用户体验（如浮动和堆叠窗格）、真正的多人协作和插件系统而受到关注，在 GitHub 上拥有 35k+ 星标，本周新增 165 星。
uses: 开发者需要一个功能强大且易用的终端复用器来提升工作效率
运维人员希望通过布局和自动化来管理复杂的终端会话
喜欢定制终端环境的高级用户，可利用插件系统扩展功能

en.tag: A terminal workspace with batteries included, a powerful terminal multiplexer
en.what: Zellij is a terminal workspace aimed at developers, ops-oriented people, and anyone who loves the terminal. Similar to terminal multiplexers, it is designed around the philosophy that one must not sacrifice simplicity for power, offering a great out-of-the-box experience and advanced features.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Zellij, including core terminal multiplexing functionality, layout system, plugin system, web client, and documentation/examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with a plugin system supporting any language that compiles to WebAssembly, and a built-in web client.
en.hot: Zellij gains attention for its unique UX features like floating and stacked panes, true multiplayer collaboration, and plugin system, with 35k+ stars on GitHub and 165 new stars this week.
uses: Developers who need a powerful yet easy-to-use terminal multiplexer to boost productivity
Ops-oriented people who want to manage complex terminal sessions with layouts and automation
Power users who love customizing their terminal environment and can extend functionality via plugins

zh.tag: 极速 JavaScript 全家桶：运行时、打包器、测试器、包管理器
zh.what: Bun 是一个集 JavaScript 运行时、打包器、测试运行器和包管理器于一体的工具，旨在替代 Node.js。它由 Rust 编写，基于 JavaScriptCore 引擎，显著降低启动时间和内存占用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Bun 的源代码、文档、安装脚本和示例。核心是一个名为 `bun` 的单可执行文件，提供 `bun run`、`bun test`、`bun install` 等命令。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，底层依赖 JavaScriptCore 引擎，支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。
zh.hot: Bun 以极快的速度和一体化设计吸引了近 10 万 star，本周新增 358，成为开发者关注的焦点。
uses: 希望提升开发效率的 JavaScript/TypeScript 开发者，可用 Bun 替代 Node.js 和多个工具。
需要快速启动和低内存占用的服务端应用或 CLI 工具开发者。
想要简化项目依赖管理，减少 node_modules 体积的团队。

en.tag: Ultra-fast all-in-one JS toolkit: runtime, bundler, test runner, package manager
en.what: Bun is an all-in-one toolkit for JavaScript and TypeScript apps, serving as a drop-in replacement for Node.js. Written in Rust and powered by JavaScriptCore, it dramatically reduces startup times and memory usage.
en.content: The repository contains Bun's source code, documentation, installation scripts, and examples. The core is a single executable named `bun` with commands like `bun run`, `bun test`, and `bun install`.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging JavaScriptCore under the hood, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.hot: Bun's incredible speed and all-in-one design have attracted nearly 100k stars, with 358 new this week, making it a developer favorite.
uses: JavaScript/TypeScript developers seeking to boost productivity by replacing Node.js and multiple tools with one.
Developers building server-side apps or CLI tools that require fast startup and low memory usage.
Teams wanting to simplify dependency management and reduce node_modules size.

zh.tag: LLM 流量代理与协议翻译，让代理用上开源模型
zh.what: Switchyard 是一个 Rust 编写的 LLM 流量代理和库，用于在提供商之间路由请求，并在 OpenAI Chat、Anthropic Messages 和 OpenAI Responses 格式之间进行翻译。它支持将 Claude Code 或 Codex 等编码代理指向开源模型，同时保持代理使用其原生 API。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的代理服务器（switchyard-server）、命令行启动器（switchyard launch）以及可嵌入的库。提供协议翻译、多后端路由（随机、LLM 分类器、信号驱动等）和 Prometheus 指标。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Rust，使用 Cargo 构建。CLI 通过 uv 安装，支持 Python 3.10 环境。依赖 OpenRouter API 密钥进行启动，可配置 TOML 路由文件。
zh.hot: 今日新增 421 星，总星数 819，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名。它解决了将编码代理连接到开源模型的痛点，提供协议翻译和灵活路由，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 开发者希望用 Claude Code 或 Codex 等代理连接开源模型（如 vLLM、NVIDIA NIM、Ollama）
需要跨多个模型进行 A/B 测试或基准测试的团队
希望实现自定义路由算法或信号驱动路由的 AI 应用开发者
需要统一监控 LLM 流量指标（如延迟、令牌数）的运维人员

en.tag: Rust proxy for LLM traffic: translate APIs, route across backends, and run coding agents on open models
en.what: Switchyard is a Rust proxy and library for LLM traffic that routes requests across providers and translates between OpenAI Chat, Anthropic Messages, and OpenAI Responses formats. It enables coding agents like Claude Code or Codex to point at open-source models while keeping the agent speaking its native API.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust proxy server (switchyard-server), a CLI launcher (switchyard launch), and an embeddable library. It offers protocol translation, multi-backend routing (random, LLM-as-classifier, signal-driven), and Prometheus metrics.
en.stack: Primarily Rust with Cargo. The CLI is installed via uv with Python 3.10. It uses OpenRouter API keys for launching and supports TOML route configuration.
en.hot: Gained 421 stars today (total 819), ranking #11 on GitHub Trending. It addresses the pain point of connecting coding agents to open-source models with protocol translation and flexible routing, drawing significant attention.
uses: Developers who want to use coding agents like Claude Code or Codex with open-source models (vLLM, NVIDIA NIM, Ollama)
Teams needing A/B testing or benchmarking across multiple models
AI app developers wanting custom routing algorithms or signal-driven stage routing
Operators needing unified metrics (latency, tokens) for LLM traffic

zh.tag: 极速 DataFrame 查询引擎，Rust 编写，支持多语言
zh.what: Polars 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 DataFrame 分析查询引擎，提供惰性/急切执行、查询优化和流式处理，支持超出内存的数据集。它提供 Python、Rust、Node.js、R 和 SQL 绑定，并可选 GPU 加速。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 库、多语言绑定（Python、Node.js、R）、用户指南、文档和插件接口，以及用于扩展的 I/O 和表达式插件。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 实现，利用多线程和 SIMD 向量化执行，采用 Apache Arrow 列式格式进行零拷贝数据共享，支持 GPU 加速（NVIDIA）。
zh.hot: Polars 凭借其卓越的性能和易用性在数据科学社区广受欢迎，star 数接近 4 万，今日新增 13 个，持续活跃。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师：处理大型数据集，进行快速数据清洗和转换。
数据工程师：构建高效的数据管道，处理超出内存的数据。
Python/R/Node.js 开发者：在各自语言环境中利用高性能 DataFrame 操作。
需要 GPU 加速查询的用户：利用 NVIDIA GPU 加速数据处理。

en.tag: Ultra-fast DataFrame query engine in Rust with multi-language bindings
en.what: Polars is an extremely fast DataFrame analytical query engine written in Rust, featuring lazy/eager execution, query optimization, and streaming for larger-than-RAM datasets. It offers bindings for Python, Rust, Node.js, R, and SQL, with optional GPU acceleration.
en.content: The repository contains the core Rust library, multi-language bindings (Python, Node.js, R), user guide, documentation, and plugin interfaces for I/O and expression extensions.
en.stack: Built on Rust with multi-threaded, vectorized (SIMD) execution, uses Apache Arrow columnar format for zero-copy data sharing, and supports optional NVIDIA GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Polars is highly popular in the data science community for its outstanding performance and ease of use, with nearly 40k stars and 13 new stars today, showing sustained activity.
uses: Data scientists and analysts: for fast data cleaning and transformation on large datasets.
Data engineers: building efficient data pipelines handling larger-than-RAM data.
Python/R/Node.js developers: leveraging high-performance DataFrame operations in their preferred language.
Users needing GPU acceleration: accelerating data processing with NVIDIA GPUs.

zh.tag: Rust 桌面 UI 组件库，基于 GPUI 构建跨平台应用
zh.what: 这是一个基于 GPUI 的 Rust 桌面 UI 组件库，提供 60+ 跨平台组件，包括表格、列表、图表、代码编辑器等。它分为两层：gpui-component 提供开箱即用的样式组件，gpui-base 提供无样式的基础行为与基础设施，让开发者可以自由定制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的组件库源码、文档、示例和测试。核心是 gpui-component 和 gpui-base 两个 crate，以及用于展示的 website 目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 GPUI 框架，以及 Tree Sitter 用于语法高亮，支持 Markdown 渲染和虚拟化列表/表格。
zh.hot: 凭借丰富的组件、高性能和双层架构设计，在 Rust 社区迅速走红，今日新增 123 星，总星数达 12809，位列 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 7。
uses: Rust 开发者：希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，需要现成 UI 组件。
桌面应用团队：需要高性能表格、编辑器等复杂组件，同时希望保持设计一致性。
设计系统开发者：希望基于 gpui-base 构建自己的设计系统，同时复用交互逻辑。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library for building cross-platform apps with GPUI
en.what: This is a Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI, offering 60+ cross-platform components including tables, lists, charts, and a code editor. It is structured in two layers: gpui-component provides styled, ready-to-use components, while gpui-base offers unstyled behavior and infrastructure for full customization.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for the component library, documentation, examples, and tests. The core is two crates: gpui-component and gpui-base, along with a website directory for showcasing.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the GPUI framework, with Tree Sitter for syntax highlighting, Markdown rendering, and virtualized lists/tables.
en.hot: With its rich components, high performance, and two-layer architecture, it has quickly gained popularity in the Rust community, adding 123 stars today and reaching 12,809 total, ranking #7 on GitHub Trending for Rust today.
uses: Rust developers: Want to build cross-platform desktop apps with Rust and need ready-made UI components.
Desktop app teams: Need high-performance complex components like tables and editors while maintaining design consistency.
Design system developers: Want to build their own design system on gpui-base while reusing interaction logic.

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面，自托管替代 TeamViewer
zh.what: RustDesk 是一款用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面软件，开箱即用，无需配置。它允许用户完全控制自己的数据，支持自建中继/中转服务器，是 TeamViewer 的隐私友好替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端和服务器端代码，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 等多平台。提供二进制下载、Docker 构建方式，以及多语言翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Flutter 用于跨平台 UI，使用 Sciter 或原生 GUI。服务器端基于 Rust 的异步网络框架。
zh.hot: 拥有 119k+ Stars，今日新增 121，因其完全开源、自托管、隐私安全且性能优异，成为 TeamViewer 等商业软件的热门替代。
uses: 个人用户：需要安全远程访问家庭或办公电脑
企业 IT：自建远程支持平台，保障数据隐私
开发者：定制远程桌面功能或集成到自有系统

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust, working out of the box with no configuration. It gives users full control over their data and supports self-hosted rendezvous/relay servers, serving as a privacy-friendly alternative to TeamViewer.
en.content: The repository contains full client and server code, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and more. It offers binary downloads, Docker build instructions, and multilingual translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Flutter for cross-platform UI and Sciter or native GUI. The server side uses Rust's async networking framework.
en.hot: With 119k+ stars and 121 new today, it's a hot alternative to commercial software like TeamViewer due to its fully open-source, self-hosted, privacy-focused, and high-performance nature.
uses: Individual users: secure remote access to home or office computers
Enterprise IT: self-hosted remote support platform with data privacy
Developers: customize remote desktop features or integrate into own systems

zh.tag: 多模态 AI 数据湖仓，开发者友好的嵌入式向量检索库
zh.what: LanceDB 是一个开源的多模态数据湖仓，专为 AI/ML 应用设计，提供快速、可扩展、生产级的向量搜索。它基于 Lance 列式格式，支持存储、索引和搜索 PB 级的多模态数据及向量。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心数据库引擎（Rust 实现）、Python/JS 客户端库、文档、示例和教程。提供向量搜索、全文搜索和 SQL 查询，支持零拷贝、自动版本管理和 GPU 加速索引构建。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，基于 Lance 列式格式，提供 Python 和 JavaScript 客户端接口。支持 GPU 加速索引构建，并集成多种向量索引算法。
zh.hot: 随着多模态 AI 应用爆发，LanceDB 提供了一体化的数据管理方案，简化了向量搜索与数据存储。本周新增 92 星，总星数 11298，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: AI 应用开发者：快速构建基于向量搜索的推荐、问答或图像检索系统。
数据工程师：管理大规模多模态数据集，进行版本控制和高效查询。
机器学习研究人员：存储和检索嵌入向量，加速模型训练与评估。

en.tag: Developer-friendly embedded vector retrieval for multimodal AI, built on Lance format
en.what: LanceDB is an open-source multimodal data lakehouse designed for AI/ML applications, offering fast, scalable, and production-ready vector search. Built on the Lance columnar format, it enables storing, indexing, and searching petabytes of multimodal data and vectors.
en.content: The repository contains the core database engine (Rust), Python/JS client libraries, documentation, examples, and tutorials. It offers vector search, full-text search, and SQL queries, with zero-copy, automatic versioning, and GPU-accelerated index building.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the Lance columnar format, with Python and JavaScript client bindings. Supports GPU-accelerated index building and integrates various vector indexing algorithms.
