en.hot: With the surge of multimodal AI applications, LanceDB offers an all-in-one data management solution, simplifying vector search and data storage. Gaining 92 stars this week, reaching 11,298 total, it continues to attract developer attention.
uses: AI app developers: quickly build vector-search-based recommendation, QA, or image retrieval systems.
Data engineers: manage large-scale multimodal datasets with versioning and efficient queries.
ML researchers: store and retrieve embedding vectors to accelerate model training and evaluation.

zh.tag: 订阅转 API 网关，拼车共享 AI 额度
zh.what: Sub2API 是一个开源 AI API 网关平台，用于将 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Grok 等订阅统一转换为 API 接口，支持拼车共享，降低使用成本。它允许用户将订阅额度分配给多个成员，并通过标准 API 无缝使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Vue 3 前端面板、Docker 部署配置，以及多语言 README（英文、中文、日文）。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Go 1.26.5、Vue 3.4+、PostgreSQL 15+、Redis 7+，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 37.8k 星标和日增 153 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因其解决 AI 订阅成本高昂的痛点，提供拼车共享方案，受到开发者追捧。
uses: 个人开发者：将多个 AI 订阅统一为 API，便于集成到自己的工具。
小团队：拼车共享订阅额度，降低 AI 使用成本。
AI 应用开发者：需要稳定 API 网关，支持多模型路由。

en.tag: Subscription-to-API gateway for sharing AI quotas
en.what: Sub2API is an open-source AI API gateway platform that converts subscriptions from Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, etc., into unified API endpoints, supporting carpooling to share quotas and reduce costs. It allows users to distribute subscription quotas among members and use them seamlessly via standard APIs.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend, Vue 3 frontend panel, Docker deployment configs, and multilingual READMEs (English, Chinese, Japanese).
en.stack: Tech stack: Go 1.26.5, Vue 3.4+, PostgreSQL 15+, Redis 7+, Docker-ready.
en.hot: With 37.8k stars and +153 today, it hit the GitHub trending chart, addressing the pain point of high AI subscription costs via carpooling, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Individual developers: unify multiple AI subscriptions into APIs for integration into own tools.
Small teams: share subscription quotas to reduce AI costs.
AI app developers: need a stable API gateway with multi-model routing.

zh.tag: 多协议多用户的 Xray 管理面板
zh.what: 3X-UI 是一个开源的 Xray-core 服务器管理面板，提供多语言 Web 界面，支持部署、配置和监控多种代理协议。它支持单节点和多节点部署，并提供了丰富的用户管理功能，如流量限制、到期时间和 IP 限制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的面板源码、多语言翻译文件、文档和自定义订阅模板。主要组件包括 Web 界面、RESTful API、Telegram 机器人以及内置的订阅服务器。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，依赖 Xray-core 作为核心代理引擎。前端使用 Vue.js 和 Element Plus 构建，后端采用 Gin 框架，并支持 SQLite 和 PostgreSQL 数据库。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 45k 星标，今日新增 86 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 8。其强大的功能、活跃的社区和持续的更新使其成为 Xray 面板的热门选择。
uses: 个人用户：搭建和管理自己的代理服务器，支持多种协议和用户管理
小型团队或组织：在多台服务器上部署统一管理面板，实现集中监控和配置
开发者：通过 RESTful API 集成到自己的应用或服务中，实现自动化管理

en.tag: Multi-protocol, multi-user Xray management panel
en.what: 3X-UI is an open-source web control panel for managing Xray-core servers, offering a multi-language interface for deploying, configuring, and monitoring various proxy protocols. It supports both single and multi-node setups, with per-client management including traffic quotas, expiry dates, and IP limits.
en.content: The repository contains the full panel source code, multi-language translation files, documentation, and custom subscription templates. Key components include a web interface, RESTful API, Telegram bot, and built-in subscription server.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging Xray-core as the core proxy engine. The frontend is built with Vue.js and Element Plus, while the backend uses the Gin framework, with support for SQLite and PostgreSQL databases.
en.hot: With over 45k stars and 86 new stars today, ranking 8th on the Go trending list, its powerful features, active community, and continuous updates make it a popular choice for Xray panels.
uses: Individual users: set up and manage their own proxy servers with multi-protocol support and user management
Small teams or organizations: deploy a unified panel across multiple servers for centralized monitoring and configuration
Developers: integrate via RESTful API into their own applications or services for automated management

zh.tag: JavaScript 的超集，为大型应用提供类型系统
zh.what: TypeScript 是一种开源的编程语言，是 JavaScript 的超集，通过添加可选的静态类型来提升代码的可维护性和可扩展性。它编译为干净的、基于标准的 JavaScript，可在任何浏览器、主机或操作系统上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编译器的完整源代码，包括解析器、类型检查器、转换器和命令行工具。还包含测试套件、文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写（自举），构建工具使用 Gulp，测试框架使用 Mocha 等。
zh.hot: TypeScript 已成为现代 JavaScript 开发的标准，拥有超过 11 万 star，今日新增 168，在 GitHub Trending 上持续热门。
uses: 前端开发者：在 React、Vue 等框架中使用 TypeScript 提升代码质量和开发效率。
后端开发者：使用 Node.js 和 TypeScript 构建可维护的服务器端应用。
大型团队：通过类型系统减少协作中的错误，提高代码可读性。

en.tag: A superset of JavaScript that adds static types for large-scale applications
en.what: TypeScript is an open-source programming language that is a superset of JavaScript, adding optional static types to improve code maintainability and scalability. It compiles to clean, standards-based JavaScript that runs on any browser, host, or OS.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the TypeScript compiler, including the parser, type checker, emitter, and command-line tools. It also includes test suites, documentation, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript (self-hosted), built with Gulp, and tested with Mocha and other tools.
en.hot: TypeScript has become the standard for modern JavaScript development, with over 110k stars and 168 new stars today, keeping it trending on GitHub.
uses: Frontend developers: Use TypeScript with frameworks like React and Vue to improve code quality and productivity.
Backend developers: Build maintainable server-side applications with Node.js and TypeScript.
Large teams: Reduce errors and improve code readability through the type system.

zh.tag: 把文档变成可查询RAG、自主推理Agent和自维护Wiki的LLM知识平台
zh.what: WeKnora是腾讯开源的LLM知识平台，将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理的Agent和自维护的Wiki。它支持多源数据导入、树状文件夹视图、块编辑与版本回滚，并提供交互式知识图谱。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、架构文档、API参考、开发者指南，以及多语言README（中英日韩）。核心功能包括RAG快速问答、ReAct Agent、Wiki模式、知识图谱、多源导入（飞书、Notion、语雀、RSS等）和网站嵌入组件。
zh.stack: 主语言为Go，基于LLM能力构建，涉及RAG、ReAct Agent、MCP工具集成、向量检索等技术。支持多种文档格式和外部服务（如飞书、Notion、RSS）。
zh.hot: 上线后迅速获得2万+星标，今日新增105星，位列GitHub Go语言日榜第5。其将文档自动转化为可交互知识图谱和自维护Wiki的能力，解决了企业知识管理的痛点，备受开发者关注。
uses: 企业知识库建设：将内部文档自动整理为可查询的RAG和自维护Wiki，提升员工检索效率。
智能客服与问答系统：利用RAG快速问答能力，构建基于私有知识的对话机器人。
复杂任务自动化：通过ReAct Agent编排检索、工具调用和网络搜索，完成多步骤分析。
个人知识管理：导入个人文档，生成知识图谱和Wiki，辅助学习和研究。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. It supports multi-source ingestion, tree-structured folder views, chunk editing with revision history, and an interactive knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, architecture docs, API reference, developer guide, and multi-language READMEs (EN, CN, JA, KO). Key features include RAG-based Q&A, ReAct Agent, Wiki mode, knowledge graph, multi-source ingestion (Feishu, Notion, Yuque, RSS, etc.), and website embed widgets.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on LLM capabilities, incorporating RAG, ReAct Agent, MCP tool integration, and vector retrieval. Supports various document formats and external services like Feishu, Notion, and RSS.
en.hot: Quickly gained over 20k stars with 105 new stars today, ranking #5 on GitHub Go daily trending. Its ability to auto-convert documents into interactive knowledge graphs and self-maintaining wikis addresses enterprise knowledge management pain points, drawing significant developer attention.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Automatically organize internal documents into queryable RAG and self-maintaining Wiki to boost employee retrieval efficiency.
Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.
Complex task automation: Use ReAct Agent to orchestrate retrieval, tool calls, and web search for multi-step analysis.
Personal knowledge management: Import personal documents to generate knowledge graphs and wikis for learning and research.

zh.tag: 用 Markdown 定义 AI 代理工作流，安全运行于 GitHub Actions
zh.what: gh-aw 是 GitHub 官方的 CLI 扩展，让开发者用 Markdown 加 YAML frontmatter 定义 AI 代理工作流，并编译为标准的 GitHub Actions 工作流。它用于需要推理或解释的任务，如问题分类、PR 审查、CI 失败调查等，补充而非替代传统 CI/CD。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 扩展源码、文档（快速开始、工作原理、安全指南）、示例工作流以及社区贡献。核心是编译命令 `gh aw compile`，将 Markdown 源文件转换为 GitHub Actions 执行的 `.lock.yml` 工作流。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，作为 GitHub CLI 扩展构建。内置 AI 引擎支持 GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Google Gemini 和 Pi，依赖 GitHub Actions 执行。
zh.hot: GitHub 官方出品，将 AI 代理与 Actions 安全结合，引发关注。本周新增 56 星，总星数近 5000，位列 Go 周榜第 19，反映开发者对 AI 自动化工作流的需求。
uses: 开发者希望用 AI 自动化仓库维护任务，如 issue 分类、PR 审查、CI 失败调查。
团队需要在现有 CI/CD 流程中安全引入 AI 代理，且不牺牲安全性和可控性。
对 GitHub Actions 熟悉，想探索 AI 代理工作流最佳实践的技术负责人。

en.tag: Define AI agent workflows in Markdown, run securely on GitHub Actions
en.what: gh-aw is an official GitHub CLI extension that lets developers define AI-powered repository automation in Markdown with YAML frontmatter, compiling each workflow into a standard GitHub Actions workflow. It handles tasks requiring reasoning or interpretation, such as issue triage, PR review, CI failure investigation, complementing rather than replacing traditional CI/CD.
en.content: The repository contains the CLI extension source, documentation (quick start, how it works, security), sample workflows, and community contributions. The core is the `gh aw compile` command that transforms Markdown source into `.lock.yml` workflows executed by GitHub Actions.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built as a GitHub CLI extension. Built-in AI engines include GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini, and Pi, relying on GitHub Actions for execution.
en.hot: Official GitHub project combining AI agents with Actions securely, gaining traction. With 56 new stars this week and nearly 5k total, ranking #19 on Go weekly trending, it reflects developer demand for AI-driven automation workflows.
uses: Developers looking to automate repo maintenance tasks like issue triage, PR review, and CI failure investigation with AI.
Teams wanting to safely integrate AI agents into existing CI/CD pipelines without compromising security and control.
Tech leads familiar with GitHub Actions who want to explore best practices for AI agent workflows.

zh.tag: 高密度多路复用、亚秒级挂起/恢复的 Agent 运行时基础设施
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个为大规模 Agent 部署提供高性能、高密度运行时环境的系统。它通过控制平面管理 Agent 沙箱的完整生命周期，支持亚秒级的挂起/恢复操作，并允许将大量 Agent 多路复用到底层计算基础设施上。该系统并非用于构建 Agent 的 SDK，而是用于大规模运行 Agent 的底层系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心控制平面实现，支持多种沙箱技术（如 microVM 和 gVisor），并基于 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 Worker 生命周期管理。提供演示视频和详细文档，展示如何将约 250 个有状态 Actor 多路复用到 8 个物理 Pod 上。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes（Pod 和自动扩缩容）进行基础设施管理，并集成 microVM 和 gVisor 等沙箱技术。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）排名第 3，今日新增 26 颗星，总星数达 1270。其核心卖点——亚秒级挂起/恢复和高密度多路复用——解决了 Agent 部署中的关键痛点，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 需要大规模运行 AI Agent 的团队，希望降低基础设施成本并提高资源利用率
构建 Agent 编排平台的开发者，需要底层生命周期管理和流量路由
从事强化学习（RL）场景的工程师，需要统一管理 Agent、推理和训练基础设施

en.tag: High-density, sub-second suspend/resume runtime infrastructure for large-scale agent deployments
en.what: Agent Substrate is a system that provides a performant, high-density runtime environment for large-scale agent deployments. Its control plane manages the full lifecycle of agent sandboxes, enabling sub-second suspend/resume operations and heavy multiplexing of agents onto shared compute infrastructure. It is not an SDK for building agents but a system for running them at scale.
en.content: The repository contains the core control plane implementation, supporting multiple sandbox technologies (e.g., microVMs and gVisor), and leverages Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management. It includes a demo video and detailed documentation showing how to multiplex ~250 stateful actors across just 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it leverages Kubernetes (Pods and autoscaling) for infrastructure management and integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor.
en.hot: Ranked #3 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily, gaining 26 stars today to reach 1270 total. Its key selling points—sub-second suspend/resume and high-density multiplexing—address critical pain points in agent deployment, driving significant interest.
uses: Teams deploying AI agents at scale, aiming to reduce infrastructure costs and improve resource utilization
Developers building agent orchestration platforms that require underlying lifecycle management and traffic routing
Engineers working on reinforcement learning (RL) scenarios needing unified management of agentic, inference, and training infrastructure

zh.tag: 安全连接本地 MCP 服务器到 OpenAI 产品的客户端守护进程
zh.what: 这是一个由客户运行的客户端，用于通过 OpenAI 托管的 MCP 隧道端点，将私有或 localhost 上的 MCP 服务器安全地连接到 ChatGPT、Codex、Responses API 和 AgentKit，而无需将 MCP 服务器暴露在公共互联网上。它解决了安全策略不允许开放入站防火墙规则或公共端点的场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的客户端二进制、文档（onboarding、architecture、permissions、deployment、troubleshooting、protocol）以及一个 Go SDK 示例，支持将 MCP 服务器嵌入同一进程。还提供健康检查端点 /healthz、/readyz、/metrics 和 /ui。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk 实现 MCP 协议，支持 Docker、Kubernetes 和 VM 部署。
zh.hot: 随着 MCP 生态的兴起，开发者需要将本地 MCP 服务器安全地连接到 ChatGPT 等产品，而该工具正好解决了这一痛点。尽管 star 数仅 310，但本周新增 30，登上 Go 趋势榜，表明社区关注度正在上升。
uses: 拥有本地或私有 MCP 服务器，希望将其连接到 ChatGPT 或 Codex 的开发者。
在安全受限环境中，无法开放公共端点或防火墙规则的团队。
需要可观测性（如健康检查、指标）的运维人员，用于监控连接状态。
希望将 MCP 服务器嵌入 Go 进程并直接使用 SDK 的开发者。

en.tag: Customer-run daemon to securely connect private/localhost MCP servers to OpenAI products
en.what: This is a customer-run client that securely connects private or localhost MCP servers to ChatGPT, Codex, the Responses API, and AgentKit via an OpenAI-hosted MCP tunnel endpoint, without exposing the MCP server to the public internet. It addresses scenarios where security policies prohibit opening inbound firewall rules or public endpoints.
en.content: The repository includes a Go client binary, documentation (onboarding, architecture, permissions, deployment, troubleshooting, protocol), and a Go SDK example for embedding an MCP server in the same process. It also provides health endpoints /healthz, /readyz, /metrics, and /ui.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it depends on the modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk for MCP protocol support and supports deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, and VMs.
en.hot: With the rise of the MCP ecosystem, developers need to securely connect local MCP servers to products like ChatGPT, and this tool addresses that pain point. Despite only 310 stars, it gained 30 this week and made the Go trending list, indicating growing community interest.
uses: Developers with local or private MCP servers who want to connect them to ChatGPT or Codex.
Teams in security-constrained environments where opening public endpoints or firewall rules is not allowed.
Operators who need observability (e.g., health checks, metrics) to monitor connection status.
Developers who want to embed an MCP server in a Go process and use the SDK directly.

zh.tag: 复古终端音乐播放器，致敬 Winamp
zh.what: cliamp 是一款受 Winamp 启发的复古终端音乐播放器，支持播放本地文件、流媒体、播客、YouTube、Spotify 等众多来源。它提供频谱可视化、参数均衡器和播放列表管理，将现代音乐服务带入终端环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的完整播放器代码，基于 Bubbletea、Lip Gloss、Beep 和 go-librespot 构建。提供安装脚本、Homebrew、AUR、Nix 等多种安装方式，并附有文档和演示视频。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Charmbracelet 的 Bubbletea 和 Lip Gloss 构建 TUI，使用 Beep 处理音频，go-librespot 支持 Spotify。可选依赖包括 ffmpeg 和 yt-dlp 以扩展格式和平台支持。
zh.hot: 凭借对 Winamp 的怀旧情怀和强大的多平台支持，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，3.4k stars 且日增 61，登上 Go 趋势榜第 4 名。
uses: 终端爱好者：喜欢在终端中完成所有操作，追求极客风格的音乐播放体验。
多平台用户：需要统一播放本地、流媒体、播客等多种来源的音乐，且跨平台使用。
怀旧玩家：怀念 Winamp 的界面和功能，希望在终端中重现类似体验。

en.tag: Retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp
en.what: cliamp is a retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp, supporting local files, streams, podcasts, YouTube, Spotify, and more. It features a spectrum visualizer, parametric EQ, and playlist management, bringing modern music services to the terminal.
en.content: The repository contains the full player code written in Go, built with Bubbletea, Lip Gloss, Beep, and go-librespot. It offers multiple installation methods including script, Homebrew, AUR, Nix, and includes documentation and demo videos.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, using Charmbracelet's Bubbletea and Lip Gloss for the TUI, Beep for audio processing, and go-librespot for Spotify support. Optional dependencies include ffmpeg and yt-dlp for extended format and platform support.
en.hot: Riding on Winamp nostalgia and robust multi-platform support, it quickly gained traction with 3.4k stars and 61 daily additions, ranking #4 on the Go trending list.
uses: Terminal enthusiasts: enjoy doing everything in the terminal and seek a geeky music playback experience.
Multi-platform users: need a unified player for local files, streams, podcasts, etc., across different OSes.
Nostalgic users: miss Winamp's interface and features and want a similar experience in the terminal.

zh.tag: 自托管一站式软件研发服务平台
zh.what: Gitea 是一个用 Go 编写的轻量级、自托管的 Git 服务，旨在提供最简单、快速、无痛的软件开发体验。它集成了 Git 托管、代码审查、问题跟踪、项目看板、Wiki、团队协作、包注册表和 CI/CD 等功能，并且可以复用 GitHub Actions。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Gitea 源代码、文档、构建脚本和 Docker 镜像配置。项目结构清晰，包含前端、后端、文档等模块，支持多平台和多架构。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能使用 Vue.js 等，依赖 Go 标准库和多种第三方库。支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 等平台，以及 x86、ARM、RISC-V 等架构。
zh.hot: Gitea 作为 GitHub 的轻量级替代品，因其易用性和自托管特性而广受欢迎。本周新增 153 颗星，总星数达 57,625，位列 Go 语言周榜第 13 名，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队希望自建 Git 服务，避免依赖第三方平台。
企业需要内部代码托管和协作平台，且要求数据完全自主可控。
开源项目维护者希望提供一个轻量、快速的代码托管环境，并支持 CI/CD。

en.tag: Self-hosted all-in-one software development service
en.what: Gitea is a lightweight, self-hosted Git service written in Go, aiming to provide the easiest, fastest, and most painless way to set up a development service. It includes Git hosting, code review, issue tracking, project kanban, wiki, team collaboration, package registry, and CI/CD, with support for GitHub Actions.
en.content: The repository contains the full Gitea source code, documentation, build scripts, and Docker image configurations. The project structure is clear, with frontend, backend, documentation, and supports multiple platforms and architectures.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with frontend possibly using Vue.js, and relies on Go standard library and various third-party libraries. Supports Linux, macOS, Windows, and architectures like x86, ARM, RISC-V.
en.hot: Gitea is popular as a lightweight alternative to GitHub, known for its ease of use and self-hosting capabilities. With 153 new stars this week and a total of 57,625 stars, it ranks 13th on the Go weekly trending list, continuing to attract developer attention.
uses: Individual developers or small teams who want to self-host their Git service to avoid reliance on third-party platforms.
Enterprises needing an internal code hosting and collaboration platform with full data control.
Open-source maintainers seeking a lightweight, fast code hosting environment with CI/CD support.

zh.tag: 开源电动车充电控制器与家庭能源管理系统
zh.what: evcc 是一个可扩展的电动车充电控制器和家庭能源管理系统，旨在提供本地能源管理，不依赖云服务。它支持多种充电桩、智能开关和热泵，并具有简洁的用户界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、截图和构建配置，支持通过 Docker 部署，并集成了多种设备驱动。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种开源库，支持 Docker 容器化部署，并集成 EEBus、OCPP 等协议。
zh.hot: 随着电动汽车和太阳能充电的普及，evcc 提供了本地化、开源的能源管理解决方案，受到广泛关注，当前在 GitHub 上拥有 7125 颗星。
uses: 电动汽车车主希望优化太阳能充电，降低电费。
家庭能源管理者需要集成多种设备，实现智能用电。
开源爱好者对自托管能源管理系统感兴趣。

en.tag: Open-source EV charge controller and home energy management system
en.what: evcc is an extensible EV charge controller and home energy management system that provides local energy management without relying on cloud services. It supports a wide range of chargers, smart switches, and heat pumps, and features a clean user interface.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, screenshots, and build configuration, with Docker deployment support and integration of various device drivers.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging various open-source libraries, supporting Docker containerization, and integrating protocols like EEBus and OCPP.
en.hot: With the rise of EVs and solar charging, evcc offers a local, open-source energy management solution, gaining significant attention with 7,125 stars on GitHub.
uses: EV owners looking to optimize solar charging and reduce electricity costs.
Home energy managers needing to integrate multiple devices for smart power usage.
Open-source enthusiasts interested in self-hosted energy management systems.

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供单点登录与多因素认证的开源门户
zh.what: Authelia 是一个开源的身份认证和授权服务器，为 Web 应用提供单点登录（SSO）和多因素认证（MFA）。它作为反向代理的认证门户，保护应用并集中管理用户身份。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Authelia 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置、Docker 镜像构建文件以及用于测试的自动化脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Redis 或 SQLite 作为存储后端，支持 LDAP 和 OAuth2/OIDC 集成。
zh.hot: 因其开源、自托管且通过 OpenID 认证的 SSO/MFA 方案而广受好评，本周新增 89 星，总星数达 28661，位列 Go 周榜第 11。
uses: 希望为家庭或自建服务添加统一登录和双因素认证的开发者
需要为企业内部应用提供集中身份认证和访问控制的管理员
对数据隐私敏感、希望避免使用商业 SSO 服务的组织

en.tag: Open-source SSO and MFA portal for web apps, OpenID Certified
en.what: Authelia is an open-source authentication and authorization server providing Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for web applications. It acts as an authentication portal behind a reverse proxy, securing apps and centralizing user identity.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configurations, Docker image build files, and automated test scripts for Authelia.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with Redis or SQLite as storage backends, and supports LDAP and OAuth2/OIDC integration.
en.hot: Praised for its open-source, self-hosted, OpenID Certified SSO/MFA solution, it gained 89 stars this week, reaching 28,661 total, ranking #11 on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Developers looking to add unified login and 2FA to home-lab or self-hosted services
Administrators needing centralized authentication and access control for internal enterprise apps
Organizations with data privacy concerns that prefer avoiding commercial SSO services

zh.tag: Go 语言高性能并行 Lint 工具
zh.what: golangci-lint 是一个快速运行的 Go 语言 linter 聚合工具，它并行执行多个 linter，利用缓存加速，支持 YAML 配置，并集成主流 IDE。它内置超过一百种 linter，帮助开发者发现代码中的错误、风格问题和潜在缺陷。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 源码、文档（位于 golangci-lint.run）、安装脚本、CI 配置、Docker 镜像以及贡献者列表。核心是一个命令行工具，通过配置文件选择并运行多个 linter。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 生态中的各种 linter 库，支持 YAML 配置，并提供 Docker 镜像和 CI 集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 社区的标准 lint 工具，拥有 19k+ star，今日新增 9 星并登上 Go 日榜，因其高效并行和丰富 linter 集成而广受欢迎。
uses: Go 开发者：在本地开发或 CI 中运行 lint 检查，提升代码质量
团队协作：统一代码风格和规范，减少 review 时间
开源项目维护者：集成到 CI 流程，自动检查 PR 代码

en.tag: Fast parallel linter runner for Go with caching and 100+ linters
en.what: golangci-lint is a fast linter runner for Go that executes linters in parallel, uses caching, supports YAML configuration, and integrates with major IDEs. It includes over a hundred linters to help developers catch errors, style issues, and potential bugs.
en.content: The repository contains Go source code, documentation (hosted at golangci-lint.run), installation scripts, CI configs, Docker images, and a contributors list. The core is a CLI tool that runs multiple linters via configuration.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging various linter libraries from the Go ecosystem, supports YAML config, and provides Docker images and CI integration.
en.hot: As the standard lint tool for Go, it has 19k+ stars, gained 9 stars today, and ranked #4 on the Go daily trending list, popular for its parallel efficiency and extensive linter integration.
uses: Go developers: run lint checks locally or in CI to improve code quality
Teams: unify code style and standards, reduce review time
Open-source maintainers: integrate into CI to automatically check PRs

zh.tag: 开源基础设施即代码工具，Terraform 的替代品
zh.what: OpenTofu 是一个开源的基础设施即代码工具，允许用户以声明式方式安全高效地构建、更改和版本化管理云基础设施。它支持众多主流服务提供商和自定义内部解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenTofu 的完整源代码、贡献指南、社区会议信息以及关键特性文档，如执行计划、资源图和变更自动化。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖云提供商 SDK 和 Terraform 生态。
zh.hot: 作为 Terraform 的社区驱动分支，OpenTofu 在许可证变更后迅速获得关注，近 3 万星标表明其作为开源替代方案的强劲需求。
uses: 云基础设施工程师：使用代码管理多云环境，实现版本控制和自动化部署。
DevOps 团队：通过执行计划和资源图优化变更流程，减少人为错误。
寻求开源 IaC 解决方案的企业：避免商业许可限制，保持对基础设施管理的控制。

en.tag: Open-source Infrastructure as Code tool, a Terraform alternative
en.what: OpenTofu is an open-source Infrastructure as Code tool that lets you declaratively manage cloud infrastructure safely and efficiently. It supports popular service providers and custom in-house solutions.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, contribution guide, community meeting info, and documentation of key features like execution plans, resource graph, and change automation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging cloud provider SDKs and the Terraform ecosystem.
en.hot: As a community-driven fork of Terraform, OpenTofu gained traction after license changes, with nearly 30k stars indicating strong demand for an open-source alternative.
uses: Cloud infrastructure engineers: manage multi-cloud environments with code, enabling version control and automated deployment.
DevOps teams: optimize change processes with execution plans and resource graphs, reducing human errors.
Enterprises seeking open-source IaC: avoid commercial license restrictions and maintain control over infrastructure management.

zh.tag: 统一 AI 模型网关与资产管理平台
zh.what: New API 是一个集中式 AI 模型网关，支持将多种 LLM 统一转换为 OpenAI、Claude 或 Gemini 兼容格式，便于聚合与分发。它提供个人和企业级模型管理、认证、用量统计与成本核算，并支持私有化部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web 前端（基于 React 等）、Docker 部署配置、多语言 README（中英法日等）以及详细的文档和快速入门指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能采用 React 等现代框架，依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，并集成多种 LLM API 协议转换。
zh.hot: 凭借 45.5k 星标和日增 115 星，New API 成为 AI 基础设施的热门选择，因其解决了多模型统一接入的痛点，并支持私有化部署，深受开发者和企业青睐。
uses: 开发者：需要统一管理多个 LLM API 密钥和调用格式的开发者
企业：希望构建内部 AI 网关，实现成本控制和审计的企业
自托管用户：偏好私有化部署，避免依赖第三方服务的用户
AI 应用团队：需要将不同模型快速集成到现有应用中的团队

en.tag: Unified AI model gateway and asset management platform
en.what: New API is a centralized AI model gateway that aggregates and distributes various LLMs by converting them into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. It offers personal and enterprise-grade model management, authentication, usage analytics, cost accounting, and supports private deployment.
en.content: The repository includes a Go-based backend service, a web frontend (e.g., React), Docker deployment configurations, multilingual READMEs (Chinese, English, French, Japanese, etc.), and comprehensive documentation and quick-start guides.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with a modern frontend framework like React, containerized via Docker, and integrates protocol conversion for various LLM APIs.
en.hot: With 45.5k stars and 115 new stars today, New API is a popular choice for AI infrastructure, solving the pain point of unified multi-model access and supporting private deployment, which appeals to developers and enterprises.
uses: Developers: those needing to manage multiple LLM API keys and formats in one place
Enterprises: seeking an internal AI gateway for cost control and auditing
Self-hosters: users preferring private deployment to avoid third-party dependencies
AI application teams: teams needing to quickly integrate various models into existing apps

zh.tag: 运维AI代理：从聊天工具诊断并修复基础设施故障
zh.what: Ongrid 是一个运维 AI 代理，能够理解你的基础设施，自动定位故障根因，并直接在 Slack、Telegram、Lark 或 DingTalk 中修复问题。它整合了指标、日志、追踪、拓扑和远程执行，实现告警驱动的自动调查。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端代理、TypeScript/React 的 Web 界面，以及文档和演示。核心功能包括协调器与专家代理（SRE/网络/数据库）、告警自动调查、根因关联、零入站端口的安全架构，以及 Kubernetes 生命周期管理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写后端，前端采用 TypeScript 和 React。依赖 Kubernetes、Prometheus 等可观测性工具，并支持 Slack、Telegram、Lark、DingTalk 等聊天平台集成。
zh.hot: 今日新增 48 星，总星数 895，登上 Go 趋势榜。它解决了运维痛点：直接在聊天工具中自动诊断和修复，减少人工介入，且零入站端口设计提升了安全性。
uses: SRE 和运维团队：在 Slack 或 Telegram 中快速响应告警，自动定位根因并执行修复。
开发人员：通过聊天界面调查生产环境问题，无需切换工具或手动排查。
平台工程团队：利用 Kubernetes 生命周期管理功能，简化集群运维。
中小型企业：以较低成本获得 AI 驱动的运维助手，提升基础设施可靠性。

en.tag: Ops AI agent that diagnoses and fixes infrastructure issues from chat
en.what: Ongrid is an ops AI agent that understands your infrastructure, finds root causes, and fixes issues directly from Slack, Telegram, Lark, or DingTalk. It integrates metrics, logs, traces, topology, and remote execution for alert-driven auto-investigation.
en.content: The repo contains a Go backend agent, a TypeScript/React web UI, plus docs and demos. Key features include coordinator and specialist agents (SRE/network/DB), alert-driven auto-investigation, root-cause correlation, zero inbound ports security, and Kubernetes lifecycle management.
en.stack: Backend written in Go, frontend in TypeScript and React. Integrates with Kubernetes, Prometheus, and observability tools, plus chat platforms like Slack, Telegram, Lark, and DingTalk.
en.hot: Gained 48 stars today, reaching 895 total, trending in Go. It addresses ops pain points by auto-diagnosing and fixing issues in chat, reducing manual toil, with zero inbound ports for security.
uses: SRE and ops teams: respond to alerts and fix issues directly from Slack or Telegram.
Developers: investigate production issues via chat without switching tools.
Platform engineering teams: leverage Kubernetes lifecycle management for cluster ops.
SMBs: get an AI ops assistant at low cost to improve infrastructure reliability.

zh.tag: 海量文件分布式存储，O(1) 磁盘访问，轻松水平扩展
zh.what: SeaweedFS 是一个分布式存储系统，支持对象存储（S3 兼容）、文件系统以及 Iceberg 表。它专为处理数十亿文件而设计，提供 O(1) 磁盘访问和简单的水平扩展能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SeaweedFS 的完整源代码、文档、Wiki 链接、Docker 镜像、客户端库（如 Java、Go）以及用于不同平台的二进制发布。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖包括 gRPC、S3 兼容 API、FUSE 等。
zh.hot: 拥有 34k+ 星标，本周新增 154 星，因其高性能、可扩展性和对 S3 及 Iceberg 的支持而广受欢迎。
uses: 适合需要存储海量小文件的应用，如社交媒体、日志存储等。
适合构建私有云存储或需要 S3 兼容接口的场景。
适合数据湖和 Iceberg 表存储，支持大数据分析。

en.tag: Distributed storage for billions of files with O(1) disk access and effortless scaling
en.what: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for object storage (S3), file systems, and Iceberg tables, designed to handle billions of files with O(1) disk access and effortless horizontal scaling.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, Wiki links, Docker images, client libraries (e.g., Java, Go), and binary releases for different platforms.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with dependencies on gRPC, S3-compatible API, FUSE, and more.
en.hot: With 34k+ stars and 154 new stars this week, it's popular for its high performance, scalability, and support for S3 and Iceberg.
uses: Ideal for applications storing billions of small files, such as social media and log storage.
Suitable for building private cloud storage or scenarios requiring S3-compatible interfaces.
Great for data lake and Iceberg table storage, supporting big data analytics.

zh.tag: Go 构建的高性能 WhatsApp 集成 API
zh.what: Evolution Go 是一个基于 Go 语言的高性能 WhatsApp API，属于 Evolution Foundation 生态系统的一部分。它利用 whatsmeow 库提供稳定、轻量的 WhatsApp 集成方案，支持 RESTful API、实时事件、媒体处理等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码、Docker 配置、Swagger 文档、Makefile 构建脚本，以及示例环境配置。核心功能包括 REST API、WebSocket/Webhook/AMQP/NATS 事件、MinIO/S3 媒体存储、PostgreSQL 消息持久化、QR 码配对和许可证管理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 whatsmeow 库，支持 PostgreSQL、MinIO/S3、AMQP/RabbitMQ、NATS 等外部服务，并提供 Docker 镜像。
zh.hot: 本周新增 134 星，登上 Go 周榜第 19 名。作为 WhatsApp 非官方 API 的现代替代品，其高性能和丰富功能吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者需要将 WhatsApp 集成到 CRM、客服系统或自动化流程中。
企业希望构建自定义聊天机器人或消息通知服务。
对性能敏感、需要轻量级部署的场景，如低资源服务器或容器化环境。

en.tag: High-performance WhatsApp integration API built in Go
en.what: Evolution Go is a high-performance WhatsApp API built in Go, part of the Evolution Foundation ecosystem. It leverages the whatsmeow library to provide a robust, lightweight integration solution, featuring RESTful API, real-time events, media handling, and more.
en.content: The repository contains complete Go source code, Docker configuration, Swagger docs, Makefile build scripts, and sample environment config. Core features include REST API, WebSocket/Webhook/AMQP/NATS events, MinIO/S3 media storage, PostgreSQL persistence, QR code pairing, and license management.
en.stack: Primarily Go, using the whatsmeow library, with support for PostgreSQL, MinIO/S3, AMQP/RabbitMQ, NATS, and Docker images.
en.hot: Gained 134 stars this week, ranking #19 on the Go weekly trending. As a modern alternative for unofficial WhatsApp APIs, its high performance and rich feature set attract many developers.
uses: Developers needing to integrate WhatsApp into CRM, customer support, or automation workflows.
Businesses looking to build custom chatbots or notification services.
Performance-sensitive, lightweight deployment scenarios like low-resource servers or containerized environments.

zh.tag: 跨平台高性能机器学习推理与训练加速器
zh.what: ONNX Runtime 是一个跨平台的机器学习推理和训练加速器，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow/Keras 等深度学习框架以及 scikit-learn、LightGBM、XGBoost 等经典机器学习库。它通过硬件加速器、图优化和变换，在不同硬件、驱动和操作系统上提供最佳性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ONNX Runtime 的完整源代码、文档、示例和发布版本，以及用于推理和训练的示例仓库和插件执行提供程序（如 QNN）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种语言绑定（如 Python、C#、Java），并依赖 ONNX 格式和硬件加速库（如 CUDA、TensorRT）。
zh.hot: 作为微软开源的跨平台推理引擎，ONNX Runtime 在 AI 部署领域具有重要地位，本月新增 306 星，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 需要在多种硬件（CPU、GPU、NPU）上部署机器学习模型的开发者
希望加速 PyTorch 或 TensorFlow 模型推理的工程团队
需要跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）统一推理解决方案的企业
研究模型优化和硬件加速的 AI 基础设施工程师

en.tag: Cross-platform, high-performance ML inference and training accelerator
en.what: ONNX Runtime is a cross-platform inference and training accelerator for machine learning, supporting models from deep learning frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow/Keras, as well as classical ML libraries such as scikit-learn, LightGBM, and XGBoost. It leverages hardware accelerators, graph optimizations, and transforms to deliver optimal performance across various hardware, drivers, and operating systems.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and releases for ONNX Runtime, along with companion sample repositories for inference and training, and plugin execution providers like QNN.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with bindings for multiple languages (e.g., Python, C#, Java), and relies on the ONNX format and hardware acceleration libraries (e.g., CUDA, TensorRT).
en.hot: As Microsoft's open-source cross-platform inference engine, ONNX Runtime holds a key position in AI deployment, gaining 306 stars this month and continuing to attract developer attention.
uses: Developers deploying ML models on diverse hardware (CPU, GPU, NPU)
Engineering teams looking to accelerate PyTorch or TensorFlow model inference
Enterprises needing a unified cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS) inference solution
AI infrastructure engineers researching model optimization and hardware acceleration

zh.tag: 英特尔开源 AI 推理优化与部署工具包
zh.what: OpenVINO 是一个开源工具包，用于优化和部署深度学习模型，提升推理性能。它支持多种主流框架（如 PyTorch、TensorFlow、ONNX）的模型转换与部署，并覆盖从边缘到云的多种硬件平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理引擎、模型优化工具、文档、教程以及 Python/C++/Node.js 等语言的 API 绑定。还提供与 Hugging Face Optimum Intel 的集成，便于直接部署 transformers 和 diffusers 模型。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python、C++、Node.js 等 API。依赖 CMake、ONNX、TensorFlow 等，并支持 Intel CPU、GPU、NPU 等硬件加速。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 推理需求激增，OpenVINO 作为成熟的优化工具持续获得关注。今日新增 12 星，总星数达 10726，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 4，体现其在开发者社区中的稳定热度。
uses: AI 应用开发者：优化模型推理性能，降低延迟和资源消耗。
边缘计算工程师：在资源受限的设备上高效部署深度学习模型。
研究学者：快速将 PyTorch/TensorFlow 模型转换并部署到多种硬件。
企业团队：利用 OpenVINO 实现从云端到边缘的统一推理方案。

en.tag: Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
en.what: OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models, boosting inference performance. It supports model conversion and deployment from popular frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and ONNX, and runs on a wide range of platforms from edge to cloud.
en.content: The repository contains the core inference engine, model optimization tools, documentation, tutorials, and API bindings for Python, C++, and Node.js. It also integrates with Hugging Face Optimum Intel for direct deployment of transformers and diffusers models.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with APIs for Python, C++, and Node.js. It relies on CMake, ONNX, TensorFlow, and supports acceleration on Intel CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs.
en.hot: With the surge in AI inference demand, OpenVINO remains a mature optimization tool. Gaining 12 stars today, it reached 10,726 total stars and ranked 4th on the C++ trending list, reflecting steady popularity among developers.
uses: AI app developers: optimize model inference performance, reducing latency and resource usage.
Edge computing engineers: efficiently deploy deep learning models on resource-constrained devices.
Researchers: quickly convert and deploy PyTorch/TensorFlow models across various hardware.
Enterprise teams: leverage OpenVINO for unified inference solutions from cloud to edge.

zh.tag: 单卡极限推理引擎，专为精选Qwen模型打造
zh.what: NInfer 是一个从零开始用 C++/CUDA 编写的高性能推理引擎，专门在单张 NVIDIA RTX 5090 上运行精选的 Qwen 模型检查点。它支持文本、图像和视频提示，通过本地 CLI 或兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic 的 HTTP API 提供服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎源码、预转换的 NInfer 模型工件（如 Qwen3.6-27B 等），以及性能基准测试数据。
zh.stack: 基于 C++/CUDA，利用 Tensor Core MMA、CUDA Graphs 和 MTP3 等技术实现极致性能。
zh.hot: 本周新增 269 星，登顶 C++ 周榜，因其在单卡上实现接近硬件极限的推理速度，吸引追求极致性能的开发者。
uses: 在 RTX 5090 上运行 Qwen3.6/3.8 系列模型，追求最高吞吐量的 AI 应用开发者。
需要本地部署多模态模型（文本/图像/视频）并兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic API 的工程师。
对 CUDA 优化和推理引擎设计感兴趣的研究者，可参考其实现。

en.tag: Single-GPU inference engine for selected Qwen checkpoints
en.what: NInfer is a from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine for explicitly registered Qwen checkpoints on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090. It runs text, image, and video prompts through a local CLI or OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible HTTP APIs.
en.content: The repository contains engine source code, pre-converted NInfer model artifacts (e.g., Qwen3.6-27B), and performance benchmarks.
en.stack: Built with C++/CUDA, leveraging Tensor Core MMA, CUDA Graphs, and MTP3 for extreme performance.
en.hot: Gained 269 stars this week, topping the C++ weekly chart, due to its near-hardware-limit inference speed on a single GPU, attracting performance-focused developers.
uses: AI developers running Qwen3.6/3.8 models on RTX 5090 seeking maximum throughput.
Engineers deploying multimodal models locally with OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs.
Researchers interested in CUDA optimization and inference engine design.

zh.tag: MySQL 社区分支，功能丰富且兼容的开源关系型数据库
zh.what: MariaDB 是一个由 MySQL 原核心团队发起的开源关系型数据库，是 MySQL 的分支，保持高度兼容性，同时提供更多原生功能。它广泛应用于从小型应用到大规模生产系统的工作负载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MariaDB 服务器的完整源代码，包括存储引擎（InnoDB、Aria、MyRocks 等）、复制与集群模块、SQL 解析器、向量搜索支持，以及构建和测试框架。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 MySQL 兼容的客户端协议，支持多种存储引擎，并集成 HNSW 索引等现代特性。
zh.hot: 作为 MySQL 的流行替代品，MariaDB 持续获得关注，今日新增 7 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 12 名，其原生向量搜索等新特性吸引了开发者。
uses: 需要从 MySQL 迁移且希望获得更多功能的企业级应用开发者
对原生向量搜索和多种存储引擎感兴趣的数据工程师
构建高可用集群或需要同步多主复制的系统架构师
学习数据库内部实现和参与开源贡献的开发者

en.tag: Community-developed MySQL fork, feature-rich and compatible open-source relational database
en.what: MariaDB is an open-source relational database, a fork of MySQL initiated by the original core team, maintaining high compatibility while offering additional native features. It powers workloads from small applications to large-scale production systems.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the MariaDB server, including storage engines (InnoDB, Aria, MyRocks, etc.), replication and clustering modules, SQL parser, vector search support, and build and test frameworks.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on MySQL-compatible client protocol, supports multiple storage engines, and integrates modern features like HNSW indexing.
en.hot: As a popular MySQL alternative, MariaDB continues to gain attention, with 7 stars today, ranking 12th on the C++ trending list, and its native vector search and other new features attract developers.
uses: Enterprise developers migrating from MySQL and seeking more features
Data engineers interested in native vector search and multiple storage engines
System architects building high-availability clusters or needing synchronous multi-primary replication
Developers learning database internals and contributing to open source

zh.tag: Matter 智能家居互联标准的开源参考实现
zh.what: connectedhomeip 是 Matter（原 Project CHIP）标准的开源 SDK，旨在统一智能家居设备的连接协议，让不同品牌的设备能够无缝协作。它由 Connectivity Standards Alliance 指导，为制造商提供开发工具，为消费者提升兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Matter 协议栈实现、跨平台示例应用（如 ESP32、EFR32、Linux 等）、测试套件、构建脚本和文档，以及持续集成配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，并支持多种平台和工具链，包括 Android、Darwin、FreeRTOS、Zephyr 等，依赖 GN 构建系统和 Pigweed 等库。
zh.hot: 作为 Matter 标准的官方参考实现，它吸引了大量智能家居开发者的关注，虽然本周新增 star 不多，但长期保持高热度，是行业标准的关键推动者。
uses: 智能家居设备制造商：基于 Matter SDK 开发兼容设备，确保跨品牌互操作性
嵌入式开发者：参考示例代码，快速在 ESP32、EFR32 等平台上实现 Matter 支持
测试与认证机构：利用测试套件验证设备是否符合 Matter 规范

en.tag: Open-source reference implementation of the Matter smart home standard
en.what: connectedhomeip is the open-source SDK for the Matter standard (formerly Project CHIP), aiming to unify smart home device connectivity protocols for seamless interoperability across brands. Guided by the Connectivity Standards Alliance, it simplifies development for manufacturers and enhances compatibility for consumers.
en.content: The repository contains the full Matter protocol stack implementation, cross-platform example apps (e.g., ESP32, EFR32, Linux), test suites, build scripts, documentation, and CI configurations.
en.stack: Primarily C++, supporting multiple platforms and toolchains including Android, Darwin, FreeRTOS, Zephyr, with dependencies on the GN build system and Pigweed libraries.
en.hot: As the official reference implementation of the Matter standard, it attracts significant attention from smart home developers. Despite modest weekly star growth, it maintains high long-term popularity as a key driver of the industry standard.
uses: Smart home device manufacturers: Develop compatible devices using the Matter SDK to ensure cross-brand interoperability
Embedded developers: Reference example code to quickly implement Matter support on platforms like ESP32, EFR32
Testing and certification bodies: Use test suites to verify device compliance with the Matter specification

zh.tag: 原生高性能桌面命令面板，支持 Raycast 生态扩展
zh.what: Vicinae 是一个面向桌面的原生命令面板，提供应用搜索、剪贴板历史、文本扩展、文件搜索、浏览器标签切换、表情选择、计算器、窗口切换等功能。它支持通过 React/TypeScript 扩展、脚本命令和 dmenu 风格菜单进行扩展，兼容 Raycast 生态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心源码、文档（docs 目录）、扩展示例、截图和品牌资源。项目采用模块化设计，支持通过 Vicinae 商店和 Raycast 商店安装扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，扩展支持 React/TypeScript，兼容 Raycast 扩展 API。依赖包括 CMake、Node.js 等构建工具。
zh.hot: 凭借 9130 颗星和今日新增 77 颗，Vicinae 在 C++ 日榜排名第 12。其原生性能与 Raycast 生态兼容性吸引开发者，成为桌面效率工具的热门选择。
uses: 桌面用户寻求快速启动应用、搜索文件和管理剪贴板的一体化工具
开发者希望使用 React/TypeScript 构建自定义扩展，并复用 Raycast 生态
Linux 用户偏好 dmenu 风格的轻量级菜单交互

en.tag: Native high-performance desktop command palette with Raycast-compatible extensions
en.what: Vicinae is a native command palette for the desktop, offering app search, clipboard history, text expansion, file search, browser tab switching, emoji picking, calculator, and window switching. It can be extended via React/TypeScript extensions, script commands, and dmenu-style menus, compatible with the Raycast ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains C++ core source code, documentation (docs directory), extension examples, screenshots, and branding assets. The project is modular, supporting extensions from both the Vicinae store and the Raycast store.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with extensions in React/TypeScript, compatible with Raycast's extension API. Build dependencies include CMake, Node.js, etc.
en.hot: With 9,130 stars and 77 added today, Vicinae ranks #12 on the C++ daily trending list. Its native performance and Raycast ecosystem compatibility attract developers, making it a popular desktop productivity tool.
uses: Desktop users seeking an all-in-one tool for quick app launching, file search, and clipboard management
Developers who want to build custom extensions with React/TypeScript and reuse the Raycast ecosystem
Linux users who prefer dmenu-style lightweight menu interactions

zh.tag: 在 Windows 上原生运行 Linux 的官方工具
zh.what: WSL 是微软官方推出的 Windows 子系统，允许用户直接在 Windows 上运行未经修改的 Linux 命令行工具、实用程序和应用程序，无需传统虚拟机或双系统。它通过轻量级虚拟化技术提供完整的 Linux 内核兼容层，支持主流发行版。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WSL 的源代码、构建脚本、文档（如贡献指南、开发者文档）以及相关子仓库的链接（如 WSL2-Linux-Kernel 和 WSLg）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Windows 内核接口和 Linux 内核（通过 WSL2-Linux-Kernel 子仓库），支持 PowerShell 命令行安装。
zh.hot: WSL 是开发者必备工具，拥有 3.3 万+ 星标，今日新增 12 星，持续活跃。它消除了 Windows 和 Linux 之间的壁垒，极大提升了开发效率。
uses: Windows 开发者：无需虚拟机即可使用 Linux 命令行工具和脚本，进行开发、测试和部署。
跨平台开发团队：在 Windows 上统一开发环境，同时利用 Linux 生态的包管理器和工具链。
学习 Linux 的用户：通过 WSL 快速体验 Linux 环境，无需安装双系统或虚拟机。

en.tag: Run Linux natively on Windows without a VM
en.what: WSL is Microsoft's official subsystem that lets you run unmodified Linux command-line tools, utilities, and apps directly on Windows without a traditional VM or dual-boot setup. It provides a lightweight virtualization layer with full Linux kernel compatibility, supporting major distributions.
en.content: The repo contains WSL's source code, build scripts, documentation (e.g., contributing guide, developer docs), and links to related sub-repos like WSL2-Linux-Kernel and WSLg.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on Windows kernel interfaces and the Linux kernel (via the WSL2-Linux-Kernel sub-repo), installable via PowerShell command.
en.hot: WSL is a must-have for developers, with 33k+ stars and steady daily additions (12 today). It bridges Windows and Linux, boosting productivity significantly.
uses: Windows developers: Use Linux command-line tools and scripts without a VM for development, testing, and deployment.
Cross-platform teams: Unify dev environments on Windows while leveraging Linux package managers and toolchains.
Linux learners: Quickly experience a Linux environment via WSL without dual-booting or using a VM.

zh.tag: 零解析、零拷贝的高效内存序列化库
zh.what: FlatBuffers 是一个跨平台的高效序列化库，旨在最大化内存效率。它允许直接访问序列化数据而无需先解析或解包，同时保持很好的向前/向后兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 flatc 编译器、多语言运行时库、示例代码（如 monster.fbs）和文档。支持 C++、C、C#、Dart 等多种语言。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，支持 C++11 及以上。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 出品的成熟序列化库，持续受到关注，本周新增 82 星，总星数达 26406，在 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 类别中排名第 14。
uses: 游戏开发中需要高效加载大量资源（如模型、地图）的场景
移动应用或嵌入式系统内存受限，需要低开销数据交换
需要跨语言、跨版本兼容的数据传输协议设计

en.tag: Memory-efficient serialization library with zero-copy access
en.what: FlatBuffers is a cross-platform serialization library architected for maximum memory efficiency. It allows direct access to serialized data without parsing/unpacking, while maintaining excellent forward/backward compatibility.
en.content: The repository contains the flatc compiler, runtime libraries for multiple languages, sample code (e.g., monster.fbs), and documentation. Supports C++, C, C#, Dart, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with CMake, requires C++11 or later.
en.hot: As a mature serialization library from Google, it continues to attract attention, gaining 82 stars this week, reaching 26,406 total stars, ranking #14 in the C++ category on GitHub Trending weekly.
uses: Game development scenarios requiring efficient loading of large assets (e.g., models, maps)
Mobile apps or embedded systems with limited memory needing low-overhead data exchange
Designing data transmission protocols that require cross-language and cross-version compatibility

zh.tag: Telegram 官方桌面客户端，跨平台消息应用
zh.what: 这是 Telegram 官方桌面客户端的完整源代码，基于 Telegram API 和 MTProto 安全协议构建。它提供了消息收发、语音通话、文件共享等核心功能，并支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、构建说明、多平台安装包（Windows、macOS、Linux）以及旧版本兼容信息。还列出了第三方依赖如 Qt、OpenSSL 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 OpenSSL、WebRTC、zlib 等库，支持 CMake 构建。
zh.hot: 作为 Telegram 官方桌面客户端，拥有 3.2 万星标，持续维护，是跨平台消息应用的重要参考实现。
uses: 开发者可学习大型 C++ 跨平台应用的架构与构建流程。
用户可下载官方客户端，享受安全、快速的即时通讯服务。
对 MTProto 协议感兴趣的开发者可研究其实现细节。

en.tag: Official Telegram desktop client, cross-platform messaging app
en.what: This is the complete source code of the official Telegram desktop client, built on the Telegram API and MTProto secure protocol. It offers messaging, voice calls, file sharing, and more, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.content: The repo contains full source code, build instructions, multi-platform installers (Windows, macOS, Linux), and legacy version compatibility info. Third-party dependencies like Qt and OpenSSL are listed.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Qt framework, depends on OpenSSL, WebRTC, zlib, and others, built with CMake.
en.hot: As the official Telegram desktop client, it has 32k+ stars, actively maintained, and serves as a key reference for cross-platform messaging apps.
uses: Developers can learn architecture and build process of large-scale C++ cross-platform apps.
Users can download the official client for secure and fast instant messaging.
Developers interested in MTProto protocol can study its implementation details.

zh.tag: 极简 Markdown 写作应用，自动跟随系统深浅色模式
zh.what: Omawrite 是一款基于 Qt Quick 和 C++ 的极简 Markdown 写作应用，专注于提供无干扰的写作体验。它自动跟随系统的深色/浅色模式，并支持快捷键操作、文件监控和草稿恢复。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Qt Quick 应用源码、界面截图、安装说明和快捷键参考，并内置了 iA Writer Mono 字体（基于 IBM Plex，遵循 SIL OFL 1.1 许可）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 6（qt6-base, qt6-declarative, qt6-quickcontrols2），依赖 xdg-desktop-portal 实现文件对话框和打印等功能。
zh.hot: 尽管 star 数不高（158），但本周新增 29 星，进入 C++ 周榜，因其极简设计和与 Omarchy 发行版的集成而受到关注。
uses: 喜欢极简写作工具的 Markdown 用户，追求无干扰的写作体验。
Omarchy 发行版用户，因为该应用默认预装并深度集成。
对 Qt Quick 和 C++ 开发感兴趣的开发者，可参考其简洁实现。

en.tag: A dead-simple Markdown writing app with Qt Quick and C++ that follows system dark/light mode
en.what: Omawrite is a dead-simple Markdown writing app built with Qt Quick and C++ that automatically follows system dark/light mode. It offers a distraction-free writing environment with keyboard shortcuts, file watching, and draft recovery.
en.content: The repository contains the full Qt Quick application source, screenshots, installation instructions, and a keyboard shortcut reference. It bundles the iA Writer Mono font (based on IBM Plex, under SIL OFL 1.1).
en.stack: Built with C++ and Qt 6 (qt6-base, qt6-declarative, qt6-quickcontrols2), relying on xdg-desktop-portal for file dialogs and printing.
en.hot: Despite modest stars (158), it gained 29 stars this week and entered the C++ weekly trending, thanks to its minimal design and integration with the Omarchy distro.
uses: Markdown writers who prefer minimal tools for distraction-free writing.
Users of the Omarchy distribution, where the app is preinstalled and integrated.
Developers interested in Qt Quick and C++ who want a clean reference implementation.

zh.tag: 隐私优先的 Chromium 浏览器，无广告无臃肿
zh.what: Helium 是一款基于 Chromium 的网页浏览器，强调隐私保护和无偏见广告拦截。它去除了谷歌服务，提供快速、简洁的浏览体验，目前处于测试阶段。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器核心代码、补丁目录（patches/）以及品牌资源，并链接到各平台打包仓库（macOS/Linux/Windows）和相关服务组件。
zh.stack: 基于 Chromium 和 ungoogled-chromium，使用 C++ 开发，并整合了来自其他开源浏览器的补丁。
zh.hot: 本周新增 394 星，总星数近 2 万，因其隐私保护和开源特性受到关注，在 C++ 周榜排名第 7。
uses: 注重隐私的普通用户，希望摆脱谷歌追踪和广告干扰。
开源浏览器爱好者，想体验或贡献基于 Chromium 的替代品。
开发者，需要参考或复用其补丁集和构建工具。

en.tag: Privacy-first Chromium browser with unbiased ad-blocking, no bloat
en.what: Helium is a Chromium-based web browser focused on privacy and unbiased ad-blocking. It removes Google services, offering a fast and clean browsing experience, currently in beta.
en.content: The repo contains the browser core code, a patches directory, and branding assets, with links to platform packaging repos (macOS/Linux/Windows) and related service components.
en.stack: Built on Chromium and ungoogled-chromium, developed in C++, incorporating patches from other open-source browsers.
en.hot: Gained 394 stars this week, reaching ~19.8k total, ranking #7 on the C++ weekly trending, driven by its privacy focus and open-source nature.
uses: Privacy-conscious users seeking to avoid Google tracking and ad clutter.
Open-source browser enthusiasts wanting to try or contribute to a Chromium alternative.
Developers interested in its patch set and build tooling for reference or reuse.

zh.tag: 微软官方 WinUI 现代 Windows UI 框架
zh.what: WinUI 是微软推出的现代 UI 框架，提供丰富的控件和样式，用于构建高性能的 Windows 应用程序。当前版本 WinUI 3 作为 Windows App SDK 的一部分发布，支持 Fluent Design，并可通过 .NET 或 C++ 开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WinUI 的源代码、文档、示例和 WinUI 3 Gallery 交互式演示，涵盖控件库、样式、工具和迁移指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，基于 Windows App SDK，支持 C#/.NET 和 C++ 开发，面向 x86、x64 和 ARM 架构。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方 UI 框架，WinUI 是 Windows 应用开发的核心，本月新增 140 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 5，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Windows 桌面应用开发者，希望使用现代 Fluent Design 构建应用
需要跨版本兼容（Windows 10 1809+）的 Win32 或 UWP 开发者
学习微软官方 UI 框架和 Windows App SDK 的学生或爱好者

en.tag: Microsoft's official WinUI framework for modern Windows apps
en.what: WinUI is Microsoft's modern UI framework with a rich set of controls and styles for building high-performance Windows apps. The current version, WinUI 3, ships as part of the Windows App SDK, embracing Fluent Design and supporting development with .NET or C++.
en.content: The repo contains the source code, documentation, samples, and the WinUI 3 Gallery interactive demo, covering control libraries, styles, tools, and migration guides.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, built on the Windows App SDK, supporting C#/.NET and C++ development for x86, x64, and ARM architectures.
en.hot: As Microsoft's official UI framework, WinUI is central to Windows app development, gaining 140 stars this month and ranking 5th in the C++ monthly trending, showing sustained developer interest.
uses: Windows desktop app developers wanting modern Fluent Design
Win32 or UWP developers needing cross-version compatibility (Windows 10 1809+)
Students or enthusiasts learning Microsoft's official UI framework and Windows App SDK

zh.tag: Google 跨语言结构化数据序列化协议
zh.what: Protocol Buffers 是 Google 开发的跨语言、跨平台的数据交换格式，用于高效序列化结构化数据。它通过定义 .proto 文件，自动生成多种语言的代码，实现数据的快速编码与解码。
zh.content: 仓库包含协议编译器（protoc）的 C++ 实现、各语言运行时库、以及丰富的文档和构建配置（如 Bazel 和 CMake）。
zh.stack: 核心使用 C++ 编写，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建，并集成 OpenSSF Scorecard 安全评估。
zh.hot: 作为数据序列化的行业标准，被无数项目和系统依赖，star 数高达 7 万+，持续稳定更新。
uses: 后端服务间通信协议定义（如 gRPC）
大数据与分布式系统的数据存储与交换
跨语言 API 开发，需要高效序列化的场景
学习高性能序列化设计与实现

en.tag: Google's language-neutral data serialization protocol
en.what: Protocol Buffers is Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible mechanism for serializing structured data. It uses .proto files to generate code in multiple languages for efficient encoding and decoding.
en.content: The repository contains the C++ implementation of the protocol compiler (protoc), runtime libraries for various languages, and extensive documentation and build configurations (e.g., Bazel and CMake).
en.stack: Core written in C++, built with Bazel and CMake, and integrated with OpenSSF Scorecard for security assessment.
en.hot: As an industry standard for data serialization, it is relied upon by countless projects and systems, with over 70k stars and continuous stable updates.
uses: Defining communication protocols between backend services (e.g., gRPC)
Data storage and exchange in big data and distributed systems
Cross-language API development requiring efficient serialization
Learning high-performance serialization design and implementation

zh.tag: 用配置文件控制 ESP32 等设备的智能家居固件系统
zh.what: ESPHome 是一个通过简单而强大的配置文件来控制 ESP32、ESP8266、BK72xx 和 RP2040 等微控制器的系统。它允许用户远程控制这些设备，并集成到家庭自动化系统中。用户无需编写复杂的代码，只需编写 YAML 配置文件即可定义设备行为。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ESPHome 的核心代码，包括配置解析、编译、上传和与 Home Assistant 等平台集成的功能。还包含文档、示例配置和用于构建自定义固件的工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Arduino 框架和 ESP-IDF，支持多种微控制器平台。还使用 Python 进行配置处理和命令行工具。
zh.hot: 本周新增 48 颗星，总星数达 11611，在 GitHub Trending 周榜（C++）中排名第 18。其受欢迎程度源于智能家居爱好者的广泛需求，以及配置驱动的开发方式降低了 DIY 门槛。
uses: 智能家居爱好者：通过配置文件轻松自制传感器、开关等设备，并接入 Home Assistant 等平台。
嵌入式开发者：快速原型开发，无需深入底层 C++ 编程，即可实现复杂逻辑。
DIY 玩家：利用 ESP32 等硬件制作个性化物联网项目，如环境监测、自动化控制。

en.tag: Firmware system to control ESP32/ESP8266/BK72xx/RP2040 via config files for home automation
en.what: ESPHome is a system to control microcontrollers like ESP32, ESP8266, BK72xx, and RP2040 using simple yet powerful configuration files. It enables remote control and integration with home automation systems. Users define device behavior in YAML config files without writing complex code.
en.content: The repository contains the core ESPHome code, including configuration parsing, compilation, uploading, and integration with platforms like Home Assistant. It also includes documentation, example configs, and tools for building custom firmware.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging Arduino framework and ESP-IDF, supporting multiple microcontroller platforms. Also uses Python for configuration processing and CLI tools.
en.hot: Gained 48 stars this week, reaching 11,611 total, ranking #18 on GitHub Trending weekly (C++). Its popularity stems from high demand among smart home enthusiasts and the config-driven approach lowering the DIY barrier.
uses: Smart home enthusiasts: Easily create custom sensors, switches, and more via config files, integrating with Home Assistant and other platforms.
Embedded developers: Rapid prototyping with complex logic without deep C++ programming.
DIY hobbyists: Build personalized IoT projects using ESP32 and similar hardware, such as environmental monitoring and automation.

zh.tag: Windows 开源用户态调试器，专攻逆向与恶意软件分析
zh.what: x64dbg 是一款面向 Windows 平台的开源用户态调试器，专为逆向工程和恶意软件分析设计，支持调试没有源代码的可执行文件。它提供了丰富的调试功能和全面的插件系统，允许用户扩展自定义功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的调试器源码，包括 32 位和 64 位版本（x32dbg.exe 和 x64dbg.exe），以及图形界面、内存映射、图形视图等模块。还包含插件系统、文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Qt 框架构建图形界面，并利用 TitanEngine 等库进行底层调试操作。支持插件开发，提供丰富的 API。
zh.hot: 作为老牌逆向工程工具，x64dbg 持续活跃，拥有近 5 万 star，本周新增 136 星，稳居 C++ 周榜前列。其开源、免费且功能强大的特性吸引了大量安全研究者和逆向爱好者。
uses: 逆向工程师：分析恶意软件、漏洞研究、破解软件保护，深入理解二进制程序。
安全研究员：在 Windows 环境下进行动态分析，调试漏洞利用代码和 shellcode。
软件开发者：调试无源码的第三方库或遗留系统，排查崩溃和异常问题。
CTF 玩家：在逆向工程挑战中快速定位关键函数和算法，提升解题效率。

en.tag: Open-source user-mode debugger for Windows, focused on reverse engineering and malware analysis
en.what: x64dbg is an open-source user-mode debugger for Windows, designed for reverse engineering and malware analysis, enabling debugging of executables without source code. It offers a rich set of debugging features and a comprehensive plugin system for extensibility.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the debugger, including 32-bit and 64-bit versions (x32dbg.exe and x64dbg.exe), along with GUI, memory map, graph view, and other modules. It also includes a plugin system, documentation, and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, using the Qt framework for the GUI, and leveraging libraries like TitanEngine for low-level debugging operations. It supports plugin development with a rich API.
en.hot: As a long-standing reverse engineering tool, x64dbg remains highly active with nearly 50k stars, adding 136 stars this week and ranking high on the C++ weekly trending list. Its open-source, free, and powerful features attract many security researchers and reverse engineering enthusiasts.
uses: Reverse engineers: analyze malware, vulnerability research, crack software protections, and deeply understand binary programs.
Security researchers: perform dynamic analysis on Windows, debug exploit code and shellcode.
Software developers: debug third-party libraries or legacy systems without source code, troubleshoot crashes and exceptions.
CTF players: quickly locate critical functions and algorithms in reverse engineering challenges, improving solving efficiency.

zh.tag: 开源跨平台矢量地图渲染引擎
zh.what: MapLibre Native 是一个免费开源的库，用于在 iOS、Android 等平台的应用和桌面程序中发布地图。它通过 GPU 加速的矢量瓦片渲染实现快速地图显示，是 Mapbox GL Native 在 2020 年转向非开源许可后的分支。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MapLibre Native 的完整源代码，涵盖 Android 和 iOS 的 SDK、渲染引擎、样式解析、地理数据处理等模块，并提供示例代码和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 OpenGL/GPU 加速，支持 Android、iOS、macOS 等平台，并集成到 Gradle 和 CocoaPods 等构建系统。
zh.hot: 本周新增 20 颗星，位列 C++ 周榜第 10，因其作为 Mapbox 的开源替代品，持续获得开发者关注，尤其在需要自主可控地图解决方案的社区中热度不减。
uses: 移动应用开发者：在 iOS 或 Android 应用中集成高性能离线地图，避免依赖商业地图服务。
地图服务提供商：基于 MapLibre Native 构建自定义地图渲染引擎，提供差异化服务。
开源贡献者：参与地图渲染技术的开发，改进性能或添加新功能，推动开源地图生态。

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform vector map rendering engine
en.what: MapLibre Native is a free and open-source library for publishing maps in apps and desktop applications on various platforms. It achieves fast map display through GPU-accelerated vector tile rendering, and originated as a fork of Mapbox GL Native before their switch to a non-OSS license in December 2020.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of MapLibre Native, including SDKs for Android and iOS, rendering engine, style parsing, geodata processing, along with examples and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging OpenGL/GPU acceleration, supporting Android, iOS, macOS, and integrated with build systems like Gradle and CocoaPods.
en.hot: Gained 20 stars this week, ranking 10th on the C++ weekly trending list. As an open-source alternative to Mapbox, it continues to attract developers, especially in communities needing self-hosted map solutions.
uses: Mobile app developers: Integrate high-performance offline maps into iOS or Android apps, avoiding reliance on commercial map services.
Map service providers: Build custom map rendering engines on top of MapLibre Native to offer differentiated services.
Open-source contributors: Participate in developing map rendering technology, improving performance or adding features, and advancing the open-source map ecosystem.

zh.tag: 将 N64 游戏静态重编译为原生可执行文件的工具
zh.what: N64Recomp 是一个静态重编译器，能将 N64 二进制文件转换为 C 代码，进而编译为任意平台的原生可执行文件。它比解释器或动态重编译更快，可用于移植、模拟或独立运行 N64 代码片段。
zh.content: 仓库包含重编译器的核心实现，支持符号与元数据输入、函数级重编译、分支延迟槽处理、跳转表优化，以及 RSP 微码支持。还提供单文件输出模式和构建指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 MIPS 工具链和 C 编译器（如 gcc、clang）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 53 星，总星数达 8088，登上 C++ 周榜第 20 名。它让 N64 游戏移植和逆向工程变得高效，吸引了复古游戏社区和开发者。
uses: N64 游戏移植到 PC、移动端等现代平台
逆向工程与代码分析，加速游戏理解
模拟器开发者优化性能或实现特定功能
教育用途，学习静态重编译技术

en.tag: Tool to statically recompile N64 games into native executables
en.what: N64Recomp is a static recompiler that converts N64 binaries into C code, which can then be compiled into native executables for any platform. It is faster than interpreters or dynamic recompilation and can be used for ports, tools, or running parts of N64 binaries standalone.
en.content: The repository contains the core recompiler implementation, supporting symbol and metadata input, function-level recompilation, branch delay slot handling, jump table optimization, and RSP microcode support. It also includes single-file output mode and build instructions.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, it relies on MIPS toolchains and C compilers (e.g., gcc, clang).
en.hot: With 53 new stars this week and 8,088 total, it ranks #20 on the C++ weekly trending list. Its ability to enable efficient N64 game ports and reverse engineering attracts retro gaming enthusiasts and developers.
uses: Porting N64 games to modern platforms like PC and mobile
Reverse engineering and code analysis to accelerate game understanding
Emulator developers optimizing performance or implementing specific features
Educational purposes to learn static recompilation techniques

zh.tag: 用 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用的开源框架
zh.what: Electron 是一个开源框架，允许开发者使用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 构建跨平台桌面应用。它基于 Node.js 和 Chromium，被 Visual Studio Code 等众多知名应用采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 的完整源代码、文档、示例以及构建和测试脚本。它提供了预编译的二进制文件，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 JavaScript，依赖 Chromium 和 Node.js。通过 npm 安装，支持多种平台架构。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 12 万颗星，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的桌面应用框架之一。今日新增 8 颗星，持续保持高热度。
uses: 开发者：希望用 Web 技术快速构建跨平台桌面应用的开发者
团队：需要为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供一致体验的产品团队
学习者：想学习桌面应用开发或了解 Chromium 和 Node.js 集成的学习者

en.tag: Open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop apps with web tech
en.what: Electron is an open-source framework that lets developers build cross-platform desktop apps using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. It is based on Node.js and Chromium and is used by many well-known apps like Visual Studio Code.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and build/test scripts for Electron. It provides prebuilt binaries for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and JavaScript, relying on Chromium and Node.js. Installed via npm, supporting multiple platforms and architectures.
en.hot: With over 120k stars, it's one of the most popular desktop app frameworks on GitHub. Gained 8 stars today, maintaining high popularity.
uses: Developers: those who want to quickly build cross-platform desktop apps using web technologies
Teams: product teams needing consistent experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Learners: those interested in desktop app development or the integration of Chromium and Node.js

zh.tag: 实验性 PS Vita 模拟器，支持多平台
zh.what: Vita3K 是一款实验性的 PlayStation Vita 模拟器，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 Android 平台。它能够运行大部分自制软件和商业游戏，为玩家提供在 PC 或移动设备上体验 Vita 游戏的可能。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器的源代码、构建脚本、文档（如 Wiki）、兼容性列表页面链接，以及游戏截图展示。项目采用 C++ 编写，并依赖 Unicorn 等外部库。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 Unicorn 模拟框架，支持 CMake 构建，并提供 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 Android 的构建配置。
zh.hot: 本周新增 36 颗星，总星数达 5660，位列 GitHub 周榜 C++ 第 20 名。作为少数能运行商业游戏的 Vita 模拟器，持续吸引复古游戏爱好者关注。
uses: 复古游戏玩家：想在 PC 或手机上体验 PS Vita 独占游戏，如《女神异闻录4 黄金版》。
模拟器开发爱好者：研究 Vita 硬件模拟和 C++ 大型项目，参与开源贡献。
游戏测试人员：利用兼容性列表评估游戏运行效果，反馈问题。

en.tag: Experimental PlayStation Vita emulator for Windows, Linux, macOS and Android
en.what: Vita3K is an experimental PlayStation Vita emulator supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android. It can run most homebrew programs and commercial games, enabling players to experience Vita titles on PC or mobile devices.
en.content: The repository contains the emulator's source code, build scripts, documentation (like Wiki), links to compatibility lists, and game screenshots. The project is written in C++ and relies on external libraries such as Unicorn.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with the Unicorn emulation framework, built via CMake, with build configurations for Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android.
en.hot: Gained 36 stars this week, reaching 5,660 total, ranking #20 on GitHub Trending for C++. As one of the few Vita emulators capable of running commercial games, it continues to attract retro gaming enthusiasts.
uses: Retro gamers: want to experience PS Vita exclusives like Persona 4 Golden on PC or mobile.
Emulator developers: interested in Vita hardware emulation and large C++ projects, contributing to open source.
Game testers: use compatibility lists to evaluate game performance and report issues.

zh.tag: AI 代理团队级记忆中枢，沉淀对话、文档与代码为可复用资产
zh.what: TencentDB Agent Memory 是一个为 AI 代理设计的团队级记忆中枢，将对话、文档和代码转化为四种可复用的记忆资产（聊天记忆、技能、LLM 维基、代码图谱），并支持跨代理和框架的治理、共享与装备。它旨在减少重复工作，让代理在团队中持续积累知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含部署脚本（一键启动 memory-core、memory-hub 和 proxy）、核心服务代码、迁移工具，以及详细的安装文档（中英文）。提供面板用于管理记忆资产。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js >=22.16，支持 OpenClaw 和 Hermes 等代理框架，使用 TencentDB 作为存储后端。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1057 星，总星数达 16543，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。其“团队记忆”理念切中 AI 代理协作痛点，且提供一键部署，迅速吸引开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理添加持久记忆，减少重复上下文输入。
团队协作场景：共享代理记忆，提升团队知识复用效率。
个人开发者：构建“一人公司”式的代理团队，自动化工作流。
研究爱好者：探索代理记忆管理与跨框架集成。

en.tag: Team-level memory hub for AI agents, turning conversations, docs, and code into reusable assets
en.what: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents, transforming conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks. It aims to reduce repetitive work by enabling agents to accumulate knowledge persistently.
en.content: The repo includes deployment scripts (one-click start for memory-core, memory-hub, and proxy), core service code, migration tools, and detailed installation docs (EN/CN). A panel is provided for managing memory assets.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js >=22.16, supports agent frameworks like OpenClaw and Hermes, and uses TencentDB as the storage backend.
en.hot: Gained 1,057 stars today, reaching 16,543 total, and topped the GitHub Trending daily chart. Its 'team memory' concept addresses the pain point of AI agent collaboration, and one-click deployment quickly attracts developers.
uses: AI agent developers: add persistent memory to agents, reducing repetitive context input.
Team collaboration: share agent memory to improve knowledge reuse efficiency.
Solo developers: build a 'one-person company' agent team for automated workflows.
Researchers/enthusiasts: explore agent memory management and cross-framework integration.

zh.tag: AI 驱动的逆向/渗透测试技能路由与工具链自举包
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 编程客户端（如 Claude Code、Cursor 等）设计的技能路由包，当遇到 APK、二进制、前端 JS 加密、CTF 或渗透测试目标时，它会自动路由到正确的方法论，检查可用工具，并执行可重复的工作流，而不是猜测命令。它支持按需自举工具链，并拥有自动进化的知识库。
zh.content: 仓库包含主路由脚本（master-route.ps1）、规则文件（RULES.md）、场景技能模块、工具/MCP 配置、运维契约（ops）以及自动进化的经验库，并配有中文和英文文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 PowerShell 编写路由脚本，依赖 AI 客户端的技能调用机制，可能涉及 MCP 工具集成。
zh.hot: 本周新增超过 1 万 star，总 star 接近 2 万，跃居 GitHub Trending 周榜第一。它精准解决了 AI 在安全测试中缺乏结构化方法论的问题，将逆向和渗透测试流程标准化，极大提升了 AI 代理的实用性和效率。
uses: 安全研究人员：利用 AI 辅助进行逆向工程和漏洞分析，提高效率。
渗透测试人员：在授权测试中，快速引导 AI 执行标准化的渗透流程。
CTF 玩家：借助 AI 路由解决逆向和密码学挑战。
AI 工具开发者：参考其架构，为特定领域构建技能路由包。

en.tag: AI-driven skill router & toolchain bootstrapper for reverse engineering and pentesting
en.what: This is a skill router package for AI coding clients (like Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) that, upon encountering APKs, binaries, frontend JS encryption, CTF challenges, or pentesting targets, routes to the right methodology, checks available tools, and executes repeatable workflows instead of guessing commands. It supports on-demand toolchain bootstrapping and features a self-evolving knowledge base.
en.content: The repo includes a master routing script (master-route.ps1), rules file (RULES.md), scenario skill modules, tool/MCP configurations, ops contracts, and a self-evolving knowledge base, with documentation in both Chinese and English.
en.stack: Primarily written in PowerShell for routing scripts, leverages AI client skill invocation mechanisms, and may integrate with MCP tools.
en.hot: Gained over 10k stars this week, approaching 20k total, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending weekly. It precisely addresses the lack of structured methodology for AI in security testing, standardizing reverse engineering and pentesting workflows, greatly enhancing AI agents' practicality and efficiency.
uses: Security researchers: Use AI-assisted reverse engineering and vulnerability analysis to boost efficiency.
Penetration testers: Guide AI to execute standardized pentesting workflows in authorized engagements.
CTF players: Leverage AI routing to solve reverse engineering and crypto challenges.
AI tool developers: Reference its architecture to build skill routers for other domains.

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

zh.tag: 人类与AI代理共存的蜂巢思维协作平台
zh.what: Buzz是一个自托管的团队协作空间，人类和AI代理可以在同一频道中共同工作。所有消息、操作和事件都记录在Nostr中继上，形成统一的审计日志。它让代理像人类队友一样参与代码审查、工作流运行和项目管理。
zh.content: 仓库包含Rust实现的核心中继、客户端界面、文档（愿景、架构等）以及截图示例。提供频道、画布、工作流、语音会议等功能，并支持代理自主操作。
zh.stack: 主要使用Rust编写，基于Nostr协议，依赖大量Rust crate。前端可能使用Web技术，但核心是Rust后端。
zh.hot: 在GitHub Trending月榜排名第一，28.7k星，本月新增301星。它解决了AI代理协作中的信任和审计问题，提供统一的事件日志，吸引了开发者和团队。
uses: 团队希望让AI代理参与开发流程，同时保持完整审计记录。
开发者需要自托管的协作平台，数据完全掌控。
对Nostr协议感兴趣，想探索去中心化社交与工作结合。
研究AI代理安全与权限管理的场景。

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate on a Nostr relay
en.what: Buzz is a self-hosted team workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate in shared channels. Every message, action, and event is recorded on a Nostr relay, creating a unified audit trail. Agents can participate in code review, workflow runs, and project management like human teammates.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-implemented core relay, client UI, documentation (vision, architecture, etc.), and screenshot examples. It offers channels, canvases, workflows, voice huddles, and agent autonomy.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the Nostr protocol, with a suspicious number of Rust crates. The frontend may use web technologies, but the core is Rust backend.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending monthly with 28.7k stars and +301 this month. It addresses trust and audit in AI agent collaboration with a unified event log, attracting developers and teams.
uses: Teams wanting AI agents in dev workflows with full audit trails.
Developers needing self-hosted collaboration with data ownership.
Those interested in Nostr and decentralized social-work integration.
Researchers exploring AI agent security and permissioning.

zh.tag: 微软出品的12周AI入门课程，适合零基础学习
zh.what: 这是一个为期12周、共24课时的AI入门课程，包含实践课程、测验和实验室。课程内容涵盖神经网络、计算机视觉、自然语言处理等，并介绍TensorFlow和PyTorch等工具，同时强调AI伦理。
zh.content: 仓库包含课程大纲、每课的Markdown教程、Jupyter Notebook代码示例、测验和实验室，以及多语言翻译（如中文、阿拉伯语等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用Jupyter Notebook，依赖TensorFlow、PyTorch等深度学习框架，支持Binder在线运行。
zh.hot: 本月新增近1.3万星，总星数超6.5万，因其免费、高质量且由微软维护，成为AI学习者的热门选择。
uses: AI初学者：系统学习AI基础概念和工具
教育工作者：作为课程素材或教学参考
自学者：通过实践项目和测验巩固知识
企业培训：用于内部AI技能提升

en.tag: Microsoft's 12-week AI curriculum for beginners, hands-on and free
en.what: A 12-week, 24-lesson curriculum for learning AI from scratch, featuring practical lessons, quizzes, and labs. It covers topics like neural networks, computer vision, and NLP, with hands-on tools like TensorFlow and PyTorch, plus AI ethics.
en.content: The repo contains a curriculum outline, Markdown tutorials for each lesson, Jupyter Notebook code samples, quizzes, labs, and multi-language translations (e.g., Chinese, Arabic).
en.stack: Primarily Jupyter Notebook, with deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch, and Binder support for online execution.
en.hot: Gained ~13k stars this month, total over 65k, due to its free, high-quality, Microsoft-backed content, making it a go-to for AI learners.
uses: AI beginners: systematic learning of AI basics and tools
Educators: as course material or teaching reference
Self-learners: reinforce knowledge with hands-on projects and quizzes
Corporate training: for internal AI skill development

zh.tag: 让 AI 助手直接给答案，告别啰嗦铺垫
zh.what: 这是一个用于编码助手的技能包，强制 AI 输出简洁、可操作的答案，避免冗长铺垫和无关内容。它基于 ADHD 友好原则，让回复直接给出行动步骤，适合所有希望提高效率的用户。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 SKILL.md 文件，定义了 10 条规则，如“先行动”“步骤编号”“结尾给出下一步”等。还提供安装说明、多语言 README 和示例对比，展示启用前后的输出差异。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Claude Code 的插件系统，使用 Markdown 定义技能规则。无复杂依赖，仅需 Python 环境（用于仓库元数据）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 20926 星，总星数 21466，登顶 GitHub Trending 月榜。它精准击中开发者对 AI 助手冗长回复的痛点，以极简方式提升效率，引发广泛共鸣。
uses: 开发者：希望 AI 编程助手直接给出可执行步骤，减少阅读负担。
团队：统一 AI 输出风格，提升代码审查和协作效率。
任何 AI 用户：厌倦了“Great question!”式开场，想要更直接的答案。

en.tag: Make coding agents answer directly, no fluff.
en.what: A skill for coding assistants that enforces concise, actionable answers, cutting out verbose preambles and tangents. Based on ADHD-friendly principles, it makes responses direct and step-by-step, benefiting anyone who wants faster, clearer outputs.
en.content: The repo contains a SKILL.md file with 10 rules like 'Lead with the next action' and 'Number multi-step tasks'. It also includes installation instructions, multilingual READMEs, and before/after examples showing the output difference.
en.stack: Built on Claude Code's plugin system, using Markdown to define skill rules. No heavy dependencies; Python is only for repo metadata.
en.hot: With 20,926 stars added this month (total 21,466), it topped the GitHub Trending monthly chart. It hits the pain point of verbose AI responses, offering a minimalist fix that resonates widely.
uses: Developers who want coding assistants to give actionable steps without extra reading.
Teams standardizing AI output style for faster code reviews and collaboration.

zh.what: Orca 是一款 Agent Development Environment（ADE），让用户能够并行运行多种主流 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），各自在隔离的 git worktree 中执行任务。同时提供移动端伴侣应用，方便用户随时随地监控、接收通知并追加指令。
