zh.stack: 主要基于 TypeScript 构建，提供跨平台桌面客户端与移动端配套应用，通过集成多家第三方 AI 编程代理的 API 实现统一调度。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程代理百花齐放的背景下，Orca 以「并行工作树 + 移动端遥控」解决了多代理对比与随时监控的痛点；一周内新增 5,409 Star 并以 21.3k 总星数冲上 GitHub 周榜第 7，足见开发者对统一代理调度界面的强烈需求。
uses: 需要同时对比多个 AI 编程代理输出的开发者——在独立 git worktree 中并行运行多个代理，择优合并结果
追求随时随地掌控编码任务的技术团队——通过移动端伴侣应用远程监控代理状态并追加指令
希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理
需要保持代码库隔离的谨慎工程师——每个代理在独立工作树中操作，避免污染主分支

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that lets developers run a fleet of popular coding agents—such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode—in parallel within isolated git worktrees. It also offers a mobile companion app to monitor progress, receive notifications, and send follow-up instructions from anywhere.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop application source (macOS/Windows/Linux), a mobile companion app (iOS and Android), and core modules for parallel agent execution, git worktree management, and result comparison/merging.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it provides cross-platform desktop clients and mobile companion apps, integrating third-party AI coding agent APIs for unified orchestration.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, Orca's parallel worktrees and mobile companion solve the pain of comparing multiple agents and monitoring them on the go; the project gained 5,409 stars this week, hitting #7 on GitHub Trending with 21.3k total stars, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent orchestration interface.
uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: 开源智能体操作系统，让 AI 代理自主运行
zh.what: elizaOS 是一个开源的 TypeScript 框架和产品栈，用于构建和运行自主 AI 代理。它提供核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务和原生桥接，支持从聊天、语音到设备控制等多种能力。
zh.content: 该仓库是一个 monorepo，包含核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务、原生桥接和第一方插件。可引导的 Linux 和 Android 发行版在单独的 elizaOS/os 仓库中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 Bun 和 Node.js，使用 Turbo 进行构建，支持子模块和补丁。
zh.hot: 本周新增 115 颗星，总星数达 19064，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 19 名。其“智能体操作系统”的定位和全栈能力吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者：使用 CLI 和文档构建自定义 AI 代理或插件
企业：通过 Eliza Cloud 部署和管理 AI 代理
个人用户：下载 Eliza 应用用于个人助理、自动化等场景
研究者：探索自主代理和操作系统级集成的可能性

en.tag: Open-source agentic operating system for autonomous AI agents
en.what: elizaOS is an open-source TypeScript framework and product stack for building and running autonomous AI agents. It provides a core runtime, the Eliza app, CLI, cloud services, and native bridges, enabling capabilities from chat and voice to device control.
en.content: This repository is a monorepo containing the core runtime, the Eliza app, the CLI, cloud services, native bridges, and first-party plugins. Bootable Linux and Android distributions live in a separate elizaOS/os repository.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Bun and Node.js dependencies, built using Turbo, supporting submodules and patches.
en.hot: Gained 115 stars this week, reaching 19,064 total, ranking #19 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) weekly. Its positioning as an 'agentic operating system' with full-stack capabilities attracts many developers.
uses: Developers: build custom AI agents or plugins using the CLI and docs
Enterprises: deploy and manage AI agents via Eliza Cloud
Individuals: download the Eliza app for personal assistant, automation, etc.
Researchers: explore autonomous agents and OS-level integration

zh.tag: 隐私优先的开源简历生成器
zh.what: Reactive Resume 是一款免费开源的简历生成器，简化了创建、更新和分享简历的流程。它提供多种模板，用户填写信息后即可导出为 PDF，无需注册账户即可使用基本功能。该应用以隐私为核心，用户完全拥有自己的数据，且支持自托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端应用（apps/web）、后端服务（apps/server）以及相关文档，采用 monorepo 结构。支持 Docker 部署，提供多语言界面，并集成了赞助商展示。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，前端基于 React（Next.js），后端使用 NestJS，数据库支持 PostgreSQL 和 MongoDB，使用 Docker 进行容器化部署。
zh.hot: 该项目拥有超过 4 万星标，今日新增 255 星，位列 GitHub 趋势榜（TypeScript）第 5 名。其隐私保护、开源免费和自托管特性吸引了大量用户，且持续更新维护。
uses: 求职者：快速制作专业简历并导出 PDF，无需注册。
注重隐私的用户：希望完全掌控个人数据，可自托管部署。
开发者：可定制和扩展简历生成器，或贡献代码。

en.tag: Privacy-first open-source resume builder
en.what: Reactive Resume is a free and open-source resume builder that simplifies creating, updating, and sharing resumes. It offers templates, lets you fill in details and export to PDF, no account required for basic use. Built with privacy as a core principle, it gives users complete ownership of their data and can be self-hosted.
en.content: The repository contains a frontend app (apps/web), backend server (apps/server), and documentation, structured as a monorepo. It supports Docker deployment, offers multi-language UI, and includes sponsor showcases.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, frontend built with React (Next.js), backend with NestJS, databases support PostgreSQL and MongoDB, and Docker for containerized deployment.
en.hot: With over 40k stars and 255 new stars today, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its privacy-first, open-source, free, and self-hostable features attract many users, and it is actively maintained.
uses: Job seekers: quickly create professional resumes and export to PDF without registration.
Privacy-conscious users: want full control over personal data and can self-host.
Developers: can customize and extend the resume builder or contribute code.

zh.tag: 轻量云原生 GIS 平台，跨端运行且数据本地化
zh.what: GeoLibre 是一个免费开源的轻量级云原生 GIS 平台，用于可视化、探索和分析地理空间数据。它可在浏览器、桌面、移动端和 Jupyter 笔记本中运行，同时保持数据本地和私密。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、示例和插件系统，提供 Web 应用、桌面应用、移动应用以及 Python/R 包。内置 1000+ 地理处理工具，基于 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行。
zh.stack: 基于 Tauri v2、React、TypeScript、MapLibre GL JS、DuckDB-WASM Spatial 和 deck.gl 构建。支持多平台分发，包括 Microsoft Store、Mac App Store、App Store、Google Play 等。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4325 星，总星数达 6035，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜第 20 名。其跨平台能力、数据隐私保护和丰富的内置工具吸引了大量关注。
uses: GIS 专业人士和地理数据科学家，用于快速可视化和分析空间数据。
开发人员，希望集成地理空间功能到 Web、桌面或移动应用。
教育工作者和学生，在 Jupyter 笔记本中教学和学习 GIS。
需要本地化、隐私保护的地理数据处理场景。

en.tag: Lightweight cloud-native GIS platform, cross-platform with local-first data
en.what: GeoLibre is a free and open-source, lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform for visualizing, exploring, and analyzing geospatial data. It runs in the web browser, on the desktop, on mobile, and inside Jupyter notebooks, all while keeping your data local and private.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, examples, and a plugin system, offering web, desktop, mobile apps, and Python/R packages. It ships 1,000+ geoprocessing tools that run entirely in the browser via WebAssembly.
en.stack: Built with Tauri v2, React, TypeScript, MapLibre GL JS, DuckDB-WASM Spatial, and deck.gl. Distributed across multiple platforms including Microsoft Store, Mac App Store, App Store, Google Play, and more.
en.hot: Gained 4,325 stars this month, reaching 6,035 total, ranking #20 on GitHub Trending monthly. Its cross-platform capability, data privacy, and rich built-in tools have attracted significant attention.
uses: GIS professionals and geospatial data scientists for quick visualization and analysis.
Developers integrating geospatial capabilities into web, desktop, or mobile apps.
Educators and students teaching/learning GIS in Jupyter notebooks.
Scenarios requiring local, privacy-preserving geospatial data processing.

zh.tag: 终端里的开源 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Qwen Code 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，直接在终端中运行，提供交互式 UI 和代理功能。它支持自动记忆、自动技能、子代理、代理团队和 MCP，无需配置即可动态工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的核心框架，提供 CLI 工具、交互式终端 UI、IDE 插件、桌面应用、守护进程模式、SDK 以及 IM 机器人（Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu）。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js（>=22），支持多种 API 协议（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen），可接入第三方或本地模型（Ollama/vLLM）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 389 星，总星数达 26.9k，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 8 名。其开箱即用的代理特性和多协议支持吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接使用 AI 编程代理，无需离开命令行。
团队需要支持多种模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen）的灵活工具。
希望利用 MCP 和子代理构建复杂自动化工作流的用户。
对开源、可定制、无供应商锁定的 AI 工具感兴趣的人。

en.tag: Open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal
en.what: Qwen Code is an open-source AI coding agent that runs in your terminal, offering an interactive UI and agentic capabilities. It features auto-memory, auto-skills, subagents, agent teams, and MCP, enabling dynamic workflows with zero setup.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based core framework, providing a CLI tool, interactive terminal UI, IDE plugins, desktop app, daemon mode, SDKs, and IM bots (Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu).
en.stack: Built on Node.js (>=22), supports multiple API protocols (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen), and can integrate third-party or local models (Ollama/vLLM).
en.hot: Gained 389 stars this week, reaching 26.9k total, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) this week. Its out-of-the-box agentic features and multi-protocol support attract many developers.
uses: Developers who want an AI coding agent directly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Teams needing a flexible tool that supports multiple model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen).
Users who want to build complex automated workflows with MCP and subagents.
Those interested in open-source, customizable, vendor-lock-in-free AI tools.

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 自托管 AI 伴侣，复刻 Neuro-sama，支持实时语音与游戏

zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 和现代 Web 技术栈，支持跨平台部署。
zh.hot: 4.4 万 Star 且日增 572，因其复刻热门虚拟主播 Neuro-sama 的独特概念，结合自托管与游戏互动功能，吸引了大量 AI 和二次元爱好者。

二次元/虚拟主播粉丝 —— 复刻 Neuro-sama，打造个性化虚拟角色
游戏玩家 —— 在 Minecraft/Factorio 中与 AI 伴侣一起游玩
开发者 —— 学习或贡献 TypeScript 全栈 AI 应用

en.tag: Self-hosted AI companion, recreating Neuro-sama, with real-time voice and game support
en.what: AIRI is a self-hosted AI companion project that recreates the interactive experience of virtual streamer Neuro-sama. It supports real-time voice chat and game interactions like Minecraft and Factorio, giving users their own AI virtual character.
en.content: The repo includes full client (Web/macOS/Windows) and server code, documentation, and community links like Discord/Telegram.

Anime/vTuber fans — recreate Neuro-sama and customize virtual characters
Gamers — play Minecraft/Factorio with an AI companion
Developers — learn or contribute to a full-stack TypeScript AI app

zh.tag: AI 生产力工作室：智能对话、自主代理与 300+ 助手
zh.what: Cherry Studio 是一个 AI 生产力套件，提供智能聊天、自主代理和超过 300 个预设助手，统一访问前沿大语言模型。它旨在为用户提供一个集成的 AI 工作环境，支持多种任务和场景。

zh.hot: 凭借 5 万+ 星标和月增 2100+ 的势头，Cherry Studio 凭借丰富的助手生态和自主代理功能，成为 AI 生产力工具的热门选择。

专业人士：利用 300+ 助手提升写作、编程、设计等效率
开发者：通过自主代理实现自动化任务和复杂工作流

en.tag: AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants
en.what: Cherry Studio is an AI productivity suite offering smart chat, autonomous agents, and over 300 preset assistants, with unified access to frontier LLMs. It aims to provide an integrated AI workspace for various tasks and scenarios.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop app source code, including build icons, documentation, and development guides. It is primarily developed in TypeScript and supports multiple languages.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, likely using Electron for desktop, integrating multiple LLM APIs.
en.hot: With 50k+ stars and 2,100+ monthly additions, Cherry Studio's rich assistant ecosystem and autonomous agents make it a popular AI productivity tool.

Professionals: leverage 300+ assistants to boost writing, coding, design efficiency
Developers: use autonomous agents for automated tasks and complex workflows

zh.tag: 开源可观测性平台，替代 Datadog/Splunk，成本降低 140 倍
zh.what: OpenObserve 是一个云原生的可观测性平台，统一处理日志、指标、追踪、前端监控和 LLM 可观测性。它旨在以极低的存储成本和简单的部署方式，替代 Datadog、Splunk 和 Elasticsearch 等传统工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台源码，包括前端界面、后端服务、文档、架构说明和快速入门指南。支持单二进制部署，并集成了 OpenTelemetry 原生支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，后端基于 Rust 构建，利用 Parquet 列式存储和 S3 原生架构实现高性能和低成本。
zh.hot: 凭借 140 倍存储成本降低和单二进制部署的卖点，吸引了大量关注，本月新增 1100 星，总星数突破 2.1 万，成为可观测性领域的热门开源项目。
uses: 寻求替代昂贵商业可观测性工具的中小团队，希望降低成本而不牺牲功能。
需要统一管理日志、指标、追踪和前端监控的 DevOps 或 SRE 团队。
对 LLM 应用进行可观测性监控的 AI 工程师，需要追踪模型调用和性能。
希望快速部署自托管可观测性平台，且要求简单运维的开发者。

en.tag: Open-source observability platform, a cost-effective alternative to Datadog/Splunk with 140x lower storage cost
en.what: OpenObserve is a cloud-native observability platform that unifies logs, metrics, traces, frontend monitoring, and LLM observability. It aims to replace traditional tools like Datadog, Splunk, and Elasticsearch with dramatically lower storage costs and simple deployment.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform source code, including frontend UI, backend services, documentation, architecture overview, and quickstart guides. It supports single-binary deployment and has native OpenTelemetry integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, with a Rust-based backend. It leverages Parquet columnar storage and an S3-native architecture for high performance and low cost.
en.hot: With its 140x storage cost reduction and single-binary deployment, it has gained significant traction, adding 1,100 stars this month and surpassing 21,000 total stars, making it a hot open-source project in the observability space.
uses: Small to medium teams looking for a cost-effective alternative to expensive commercial observability tools without sacrificing features.
DevOps or SRE teams needing to unify logs, metrics, traces, and frontend monitoring in one platform.
AI engineers monitoring LLM applications, requiring tracing of model calls and performance.
Developers who want a self-hosted observability platform with simple deployment and low operational overhead.

zh.tag: 为AI代理提供万级现成爬虫的MCP服务器
zh.what: Apify MCP服务器让AI代理（如Claude、Cursor）通过MCP协议调用Apify Store上的数千个现成爬虫、抓取器和自动化工具，从社交媒体、搜索引擎、地图、电商等网站提取数据。它支持OAuth认证，可托管使用或本地运行。

zh.stack: 基于TypeScript构建，使用MCP SDK，支持Streamable HTTP传输。依赖Apify平台和Actor运行环境，兼容任何MCP客户端。

en.tag: MCP server giving AI agents access to thousands of ready-made scrapers
en.what: The Apify MCP server enables AI agents (like Claude, Cursor) to use thousands of ready-made scrapers, crawlers, and automation tools from Apify Store via the Model Context Protocol, extracting data from social media, search engines, maps, e-commerce, and more. en.hot: With 67k stars and 2,191 new stars this month, Cline is a star project in the coding agent space, attracting developers with its multi-form support and autonomous capabilities.

zh.tag: 开源低代码平台，构建内部工具与AI代理
zh.what: ToolJet 是一个开源的低代码平台，用于快速构建内部工具、仪表盘、业务应用和工作流。它提供可视化拖拽界面，支持连接数据库、API 和 SaaS 应用，并集成了 AI 能力，可生成应用和智能代理。

en.what: A collection of skills for AI agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) to handle Korea-specific tasks like booking SRT/KTX tickets, checking subway and weather, and searching lost items. No extra API layer needed; install via npx.

AI agent enthusiasts: explore building practical localized skills
Non-programmers: install and use skills without coding

zh.tag: 高效开源广告拦截器，专注隐私与性能
zh.what: uBlock Origin 是一款轻量级、高效的浏览器扩展，用于拦截广告、跟踪器和恶意域名。它通过 CPU 和内存占用极低的方式，为用户提供更干净、更快的网页浏览体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含扩展的完整源代码，包括核心拦截引擎、过滤列表管理、用户界面（如弹出面板和设置页）、以及针对不同浏览器的构建配置。

技术爱好者，希望自定义过滤规则或研究广告拦截技术。
开发者和维护者，需要参考或贡献于开源广告拦截解决方案。

en.tag: Efficient open-source ad blocker focused on privacy and performance
en.what: uBlock Origin is a lightweight and efficient browser extension that blocks ads, trackers, and malicious domains. It provides a cleaner and faster browsing experience with minimal CPU and memory usage.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the extension, including the core blocking engine, filter list management, user interface (popup panel and settings pages), and build configurations for various browsers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with HTML/CSS for the UI, and leverages browser extension APIs like webRequest and declarativeNetRequest for network request blocking.
en.hot: As major browsers phase out Manifest V2, uBlock Origin remains a crucial tool for users to fight ads and tracking. Its efficiency and reliability keep it popular on GitHub, gaining 890 stars this month.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to block ads and trackers for faster browsing and privacy protection.
Tech enthusiasts who want to customize filter rules or study ad-blocking techniques.
Developers and maintainers looking to reference or contribute to an open-source ad-blocking solution.

Developers: Customizable and extensible, frontend migrating to React, suitable for contributing code.

zh.tag: 轻量跨浏览器 JavaScript 3D 库，WebGL/WebGPU 渲染

uses: Web 开发者：在网页中快速实现 3D 可视化、产品展示或交互式动画。
游戏开发者：使用 three.js 构建浏览器游戏或原型，无需安装插件。
数据可视化工程师：将复杂数据以 3D 形式呈现，增强理解与交互。
教育领域：用于教学演示、虚拟实验室或在线课程中的 3D 内容。

en.tag: Lightweight, cross-browser JavaScript 3D library with WebGL and WebGPU renderers
en.what: three.js is an easy-to-use, lightweight, cross-browser, general-purpose 3D library for creating and displaying 3D graphics on the web. It provides core components like scenes, cameras, geometries, materials, and renderers, supporting WebGL and WebGPU rendering, with SVG and CSS3D renderers available as addons.
en.content: The repository contains complete JavaScript source code, examples, docs, manual, and Wiki, along with build configurations and tests. Core modules include renderers, scene graph, cameras, geometries, materials, animation, and loaders.

uses: Web developers: quickly implement 3D visualizations, product showcases, or interactive animations in web pages.
Game developers: build browser games or prototypes with three.js without needing plugins.
Data visualization engineers: present complex data in 3D to enhance understanding and interaction.
Education: use for teaching demonstrations, virtual labs, or 3D content in online courses.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打造的设计语言与技能集，终结千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风
zh.what: Impeccable 是一套面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）的设计指导语言与 CLI 工具。它通过 23 条标准化命令和 46 条确定性检测规则，帮助 AI 在生成前端界面时摆脱千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风格，产出更具品牌感与专业度的设计。开发者只需在项目中运行初始化命令，即可建立包含品牌语境、视觉规范与组件库的设计上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含可安装在 AI 工具中的核心技能包、用于本地检测的 CLI 与浏览器扩展，以及一套由 PRODUCT.md 和 DESIGN.md 驱动的设计上下文系统。整体以命令式交互为主，支持实时浏览器迭代与无需 LLM 的离线规则检测。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，通过 npm 分发并以 npx 方式安装，同时提供浏览器扩展用于实时迭代检测。设计规则以确定性逻辑实现，可独立于 LLM 运行。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上已获得 47.7K Star，本周新增 2,331 星并跻身 Trending 周榜第 14 名，反映出开发者对「AI 生成前端同质化」的强烈痛点共鸣。它精准击中了当前 AI 编码工具产出界面千篇一律的普遍问题，提供了可落地的设计工程化方案。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 希望让 AI 助手生成更专业、不千篇一律的界面代码
独立创始人/产品经理 —— 需要快速建立品牌感强、视觉一致的产品界面
设计工程师 —— 想将设计规范转化为 AI 可执行的确定性规则与检测流程

en.tag: A design language and skillset for AI coding agents to escape generic SaaS templates
en.what: Impeccable is a design guidance language and CLI tool for AI coding agents like Claude and Cursor. It provides 23 standardized commands and 46 deterministic detection rules to help AI-generated frontend designs break away from generic SaaS templates and achieve stronger brand identity. Developers can set up a comprehensive design context—including brand voice, visual guidelines, and component libraries—through a single initialization command.
en.content: The repository includes a core skill package for AI tools, a CLI and browser extension for local auditing, and a design context system driven by PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md. It focuses on command-based interactions, supporting live browser iteration and offline deterministic rule checks without requiring an LLM or API key.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, distributed via npm and installed through npx, with a browser extension for real-time iteration and auditing. The design rules are implemented as deterministic logic that can run independently of any LLM or API key.
en.hot: With 47.7K stars and 2,331 new stars this week landing it at #14 on GitHub Trending, the project resonates strongly with developers frustrated by homogenized AI-generated frontend designs. It directly addresses the pain point of repetitive SaaS templates by offering a practical, engineering-grade design system for AI agents.
uses: Frontend developers who want their AI assistants to generate professional, non-generic UI code
Indie founders and product managers looking to quickly build brand-conscious, visually consistent interfaces
Design engineers seeking to convert design specifications into deterministic, AI-executable rules and audit workflows

zh.tag: 微软官方 Power Platform 开发插件市场
zh.what: 这是一个插件市场，为 Claude Code 和 GitHub Copilot 提供 Power Platform 开发插件。包含可复用的技能、代理和命令，帮助开发者构建和部署 Power Platform 解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个插件，如 Power Pages、Model Apps、MCP Apps、Code Apps、Mobile Apps、Canvas Apps 和 Power Automate。每个插件都有独立的 README 和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Claude Code 或 GitHub Copilot CLI。部分插件使用 React、TypeScript、Expo、.NET 等技术栈。
zh.hot: 本周新增 49 颗星，位列 JavaScript 周榜第 3。作为微软官方项目，它填补了 AI 编码助手与 Power Platform 之间的空白，吸引大量低代码开发者。
uses: Power Platform 开发者 —— 使用 AI 助手快速构建和部署应用
低代码/无代码爱好者 —— 结合 Claude Code 或 Copilot 提升开发效率
企业 IT 团队 —— 标准化 Power Platform 开发流程

en.tag: Official Microsoft plugin marketplace for Power Platform development
en.what: This is a plugin marketplace providing Power Platform development plugins for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot. It includes reusable skills, agents, and commands to help developers build and deploy Power Platform solutions.
en.content: The repository contains multiple plugins such as Power Pages, Model Apps, MCP Apps, Code Apps, Mobile Apps, Canvas Apps, and Power Automate. Each plugin has its own README and installation scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, relying on Claude Code or GitHub Copilot CLI. Some plugins use React, TypeScript, Expo, .NET, etc.
en.hot: Gained 49 stars this week, ranking 3rd in JavaScript weekly trending. As an official Microsoft project, it bridges AI coding assistants and Power Platform, attracting many low-code developers.
uses: Power Platform developers — quickly build and deploy apps using AI assistants
Low-code/no-code enthusiasts — boost development efficiency with Claude Code or Copilot
Enterprise IT teams — standardize Power Platform development workflows

zh.tag: 洛雪音乐自定义音源合集，一键导入即听全网音乐
zh.what: 这是一个为洛雪音乐（LX Music）播放器提供自定义音源（API 接口）的仓库，用户通过导入这些音源链接，即可在播放器中搜索和播放来自多个网络来源的音乐。它聚合了多个第三方音源，并提供了原始链接和加速链接两种导入方式。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含多个音源文件夹（如 SixYin、Huibq、Flower、LX、ikun、Grass、JuheApi、QDY），每个文件夹内有一个 latest.js 文件，即音源脚本。README 中列出了所有音源的原始链接和加速链接，并提供了数据来源和项目地址。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 JavaScript，音源脚本以 JS 文件形式提供。依赖洛雪音乐播放器（lx-music-desktop/mobile）来加载这些音源。
zh.hot: 该仓库因提供免费、便捷的音乐源聚合而受到欢迎，本月新增 735 星，总星数达 7956，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜。用户无需自建服务即可扩展播放器功能，满足听歌需求。
uses: 洛雪音乐播放器用户：一键导入音源，免费听全网音乐
喜欢折腾的音乐爱好者：通过自定义音源探索不同曲库
开发者：参考音源实现，学习如何为 LX Music 编写音源插件

en.tag: A collection of custom music sources for LX Music, one-click import to listen to music across the web
en.what: This repository provides custom music sources (API endpoints) for the LX Music player. By importing these source links, users can search and play music from various online sources within the player. It aggregates multiple third-party sources and offers both raw and accelerated import links.
en.content: The repository mainly contains multiple source folders (e.g., SixYin, Huibq, Flower, LX, ikun, Grass, JuheApi, QDY), each with a latest.js file as the source script. The README lists raw and accelerated links for all sources, along with data origins and related project links.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with source scripts provided as JS files. It depends on the LX Music player (lx-music-desktop/mobile) to load these sources.
en.hot: The repo is popular for providing free and convenient aggregated music sources. With 735 stars added this month and 7,956 total, it made the GitHub Trending monthly list. Users can extend their player's capabilities without self-hosting, satisfying music listening needs.
uses: LX Music player users: import sources with one click to listen to music for free
Music enthusiasts who like tinkering: explore different music libraries via custom sources
Developers: reference source implementations to learn how to write LX Music source plugins

zh.tag: 现代 JavaScript 实用工具库，模块化、高性能、功能丰富
zh.what: Lodash 是一个广受欢迎的 JavaScript 工具库，提供数组、对象、字符串等数据操作的便捷方法，简化了日常编程。它支持模块化按需引入，并包含函数式编程（FP）风格，提升代码可读性和性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Lodash 源码、构建配置（使用 lodash-cli）、文档链接、贡献指南以及治理文件。提供核心版（约 4 kB gzipped）和完整版（约 24 kB gzipped）构建，支持浏览器、npm 和 Node.js 环境。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript，使用 UMD 模块格式，可通过 npm 安装，支持浏览器和 Node.js。构建工具为 lodash-cli，依赖较少，兼容现代环境。
zh.hot: Lodash 是 JavaScript 生态中最常用的工具库之一，拥有超过 6 万星标，本月新增 176 星，持续受到开发者信赖。近期获得 Sovereign Tech Agency 支持，将进入功能完善阶段，确保长期稳定和安全，引发社区关注。
uses: 前端开发者：在 React/Vue 等项目中简化数组、对象操作，提升开发效率。
Node.js 后端开发者：使用 Lodash 处理数据转换、深拷贝等常见任务。
函数式编程爱好者：利用 lodash/fp 模块实现柯里化和数据优先的编程风格。
学习 JavaScript 最佳实践：通过阅读源码理解模块化设计和性能优化技巧。

en.tag: A modern JavaScript utility library delivering modularity, performance, & extras.
en.what: Lodash is a popular JavaScript utility library that provides convenient methods for working with arrays, objects, strings, etc., simplifying everyday programming. It supports modular imports and includes a functional programming (FP) style, enhancing code readability and performance.
en.content: The repository contains the full Lodash source code, build configuration (using lodash-cli), documentation links, contributing guidelines, and governance files. It provides core (~4 kB gzipped) and full (~24 kB gzipped) builds, supporting browser, npm, and Node.js environments.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript, uses UMD module format, installable via npm, supports browser and Node.js. Build tool is lodash-cli, with minimal dependencies and modern environment compatibility.
en.hot: Lodash is one of the most used utility libraries in the JavaScript ecosystem, with over 61k stars and 176 new stars this month, maintaining developer trust. Recently received support from the Sovereign Tech Agency, transitioning to Feature-Complete stage for long-term stability and security, sparking community interest.
uses: Frontend developers: simplify array and object manipulation in React/Vue projects, boosting productivity.
Node.js backend developers: use Lodash for data transformation, deep cloning, and other common tasks.
Functional programming enthusiasts: leverage lodash/fp for currying and data-last style.
Learners of JavaScript best practices: study source code for modular design and performance optimization.

zh.tag: 开源模块化智能魔镜平台，把镜子变成个人助理
zh.what: MagicMirror² 是一个开源的模块化智能镜子平台，允许用户将普通镜子（如玄关镜或浴室镜）改造成个人助理。它基于 Electron 封装，无需额外安装 Web 服务器或浏览器即可运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心平台代码、模块系统、安装文档和贡献指南。核心采用模块化插件架构，支持大量可安装的第三方模块来扩展功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 Electron 框架，利用 Node.js 生态。依赖包括 npm 包管理、GitHub Actions 用于自动化测试。
zh.hot: 本月新增 129 星，总星数达 23.8k，位列 JavaScript 月榜第 19。作为智能家居和 DIY 项目的热门选择，社区活跃且贡献者众多。
uses: DIY 爱好者：想自制智能镜子，展示天气、日历、新闻等信息的个人项目。
智能家居玩家：将魔镜集成到家庭自动化系统中，作为信息中心或控制面板。
开发者：学习模块化架构和 Electron 应用开发，或贡献自己的模块。

en.tag: Open-source modular smart mirror platform turning mirrors into personal assistants
en.what: MagicMirror² is an open-source modular smart mirror platform that lets you turn a regular mirror (e.g., in a hallway or bathroom) into a personal assistant. It is built on Electron as an application wrapper, so no separate web server or browser installation is needed.
en.content: The repository contains the core platform code, a modular plugin system, installation documentation, and contribution guidelines. The core uses a modular plugin architecture, supporting a growing list of installable third-party modules to extend functionality.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on Electron, leveraging the Node.js ecosystem. Dependencies include npm for package management and GitHub Actions for automated testing.
en.hot: Gained 129 stars this month, reaching 23.8k total, ranking 19th on the JavaScript monthly trending. It's a popular choice for smart home and DIY projects, with an active community and many contributors.
uses: DIY enthusiasts: personal projects to build a smart mirror displaying weather, calendar, news, etc.
Smart home hobbyists: integrating the mirror into home automation as an info hub or control panel.
Developers: learning modular architecture and Electron app development, or contributing custom modules.

zh.tag: 微软出品的12周Web开发入门课程
zh.what: 这是一个面向初学者的Web开发课程，共24节课，涵盖JavaScript、CSS和HTML。课程通过实践项目（如玻璃容器、浏览器扩展和太空游戏）教授基础知识，并配有测验、讨论和作业。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的课程材料，包括每课的README、代码示例、测验和作业，以及多语言翻译（通过GitHub Action自动更新）。
zh.stack: 主要使用JavaScript、HTML和CSS，课程材料以Markdown编写，并利用GitHub Actions进行翻译自动化。
zh.hot: 凭借微软的品牌和高质量的项目式教学，该仓库已获得96k+星标，本月新增599星，持续受到初学者和教育工作者的欢迎。
uses: 零基础想系统学习Web开发的初学者，可按照12周计划循序渐进。
教育工作者或培训师，可将课程作为教学大纲或参考资料。
自学者需要免费、结构化且带实践项目的学习资源。

en.tag: Microsoft's 12-week web dev curriculum for beginners
en.what: A 12-week comprehensive course for beginners, featuring 24 lessons on JavaScript, CSS, and HTML. It uses hands-on projects like terrariums, browser extensions, and space games, with quizzes, discussions, and assignments.
en.content: The repo contains full curriculum materials: lesson READMEs, code samples, quizzes, assignments, and multi-language translations (auto-updated via GitHub Action).
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, HTML, and CSS; course materials in Markdown, with GitHub Actions for translation automation.
en.hot: With Microsoft's brand and high-quality project-based pedagogy, it has amassed 96k+ stars, adding 599 this month, remaining popular among beginners and educators.
uses: Beginners with no prior experience who want a structured 12-week plan to learn web development.
Educators or trainers seeking a ready-made curriculum or reference material.
Self-learners needing free, structured resources with hands-on projects.

zh.tag: 跨平台终端与远程连接客户端，支持多协议
zh.what: electerm 是一个开源的终端/SSH/SFTP/FTP/Telnet/Serialport/RDP/VNC/Spice 客户端，支持 Linux、Mac、Windows、Android 和 HarmonyOS。它提供图形化界面，方便用户管理远程连接和文件传输。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端（Electron）、移动端（Android/HarmonyOS）和 Web 版（electerm-web）的代码，以及主题、Docker 镜像和在线演示等资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Electron 构建，使用 JavaScript 开发，支持多种操作系统和架构，包括旧版系统和国产 Linux 发行版。
zh.hot: 因其跨平台支持和多协议集成而广受欢迎，本月新增 383 星，总星数达 14918，反映了用户对统一远程连接工具的需求。
uses: 系统管理员和运维人员，需要管理多台服务器的 SSH 和文件传输。
开发者，希望在统一界面中处理远程开发、调试和文件同步。
需要支持旧系统或国产 Linux 发行版的用户，如 UOS、麒麟等。
移动办公用户，可通过 Android 或 HarmonyOS 应用进行远程连接。

en.tag: Cross-platform terminal & remote connection client supporting multiple protocols
en.what: electerm is an open-source terminal/SSH/SFTP/FTP/Telnet/Serialport/RDP/VNC/Spice client supporting Linux, Mac, Windows, Android, and HarmonyOS. It provides a graphical interface for managing remote connections and file transfers.
en.content: The repository includes code for desktop (Electron), mobile (Android/HarmonyOS), and web (electerm-web) versions, along with themes, Docker images, and online demos.
en.stack: Built with Electron, developed in JavaScript, supporting multiple OSes and architectures, including legacy systems and Chinese Linux distributions.
en.hot: Popular for its cross-platform support and multi-protocol integration, gaining 383 stars this month to reach 14918 total, reflecting demand for a unified remote connection tool.
uses: System administrators and DevOps needing SSH and file transfer for multiple servers.
Developers who want a unified interface for remote development, debugging, and file sync.
Users requiring support for legacy systems or Chinese Linux distributions like UOS and Kylin.
Mobile workers who need remote connections via Android or HarmonyOS apps.

zh.tag: Rust 编写的下一代 Coding Agent Harness，极致性能与多会话支持
zh.what: jcode 是一款基于 Rust 的下一代 Coding Agent Harness，旨在提升 AI 编程助手的技能上限。它专为多会话工作流、无限可定制性与极致性能而设计，能够在本地以极低资源消耗运行复杂编程任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心运行时、跨平台 CLI 安装脚本（Linux/macOS/Windows），以及展示内存与启动速度优势的基准测试数据。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主语言，强调零成本抽象与资源效率；支持可选本地嵌入模型，通过 Bash/PowerShell 脚本实现一键跨平台安装。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程工具同质化严重的背景下，jcode 凭借 8421 Star 和 Rust 日榜第 11 名的热度，以单会话 27.8 MB 的超低内存占用和多会话架构，精准击中开发者对高性能本地 Agent 的需求。
uses: 追求本地低内存、高性能 AI 编程体验的核心开发者
需要长期运行多会话复杂工作流的高级用户
希望深度定制 Coding Agent 行为与工具链的极客与团队

en.tag: Next-gen coding agent harness in Rust for multi-session, low-RAM workflows
en.what: jcode is a next-generation coding agent harness built in Rust to raise the skill ceiling of AI coding assistants. It is designed for multi-session workflows, infinite customizability, and extreme performance, allowing complex coding tasks to run locally with minimal resource usage.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust core runtime, cross-platform CLI installers for Linux/macOS/Windows, and benchmark data highlighting its memory and boot-up speed advantages.
en.stack: Primarily Rust with zero-cost abstraction and resource efficiency in mind; supports optional local embeddings and one-click cross-platform installation via Bash/PowerShell scripts.
en.hot: With 8,421 stars and a spot at #11 on GitHub's Rust daily trending list, jcode stands out in the crowded AI coding space by delivering an ultra-low 27.8 MB RAM footprint per session and a multi-session architecture that meets developers' demand for high-performance local agents.
uses: Core developers seeking local, low-memory, high-performance AI coding experiences
Power users running long-term, complex multi-session workflows
Hackers and teams wanting infinite customizability of their coding agent behavior and toolchain

zh.tag: 开源可扩展的离线语音转录桌面工具
zh.what: Handy 是一款跨平台的桌面语音转文字应用，主打完全离线、隐私优先的转录体验。用户只需按下可配置的快捷键说话，即可将语音实时转换为文本并自动输入到任意文本框中。所有音频处理均在本地完成，无需联网或上传云端。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面客户端源码、基于 Rust 的本地音频处理管线，以及集成 Whisper 和 Parakeet V3 的离线转录引擎，同时提供了 Raycast 插件等扩展集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，使用 Silero VAD 进行语音活动检测，支持 Whisper（Small/Medium/Turbo/Large）和 Parakeet V3 本地模型，并可在 GPU 加速下运行。
zh.hot: 在隐私焦虑与云服务费高涨的背景下，Handy 以「完全开源、完全离线」的差异化定位迅速获得开发者关注，本月新增近 3,000 Star，累计突破 2.6 万，登榜 GitHub Rust 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 需要在本地完成语音输入、拒绝云端上传的写作者与专业人士。
开发者与极客 —— 希望 Fork 并二次扩展自定义模型或工作流的技术用户。
跨平台办公场景 —— 在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上追求高效语音转文字输入的远程工作者。
可访问性需求者 —— 需要无障碍语音输入工具但不愿付费订阅的辅助功能使用者。

en.tag: Free, open-source & extensible offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app that transcribes your voice entirely offline with a privacy-first approach. Press a configurable shortcut, speak, and it pastes the transcribed text directly into any text field. All audio processing happens locally on your machine, with no data sent to the cloud.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop client source, a Rust-based local audio pipeline, and an offline transcription engine integrating Whisper and Parakeet V3 models, plus integrations like a Raycast extension.
en.stack: Built in Rust, it uses Silero VAD for voice-activity detection and supports local Whisper (Small/Medium/Turbo/Large) and Parakeet V3 models with optional GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Amid rising privacy concerns and cloud-service costs, Handy's 'fully open-source and fully offline' positioning has resonated strongly with developers, adding nearly 3,000 stars this month to reach 26.7K+ and ranking 17th on GitHub's Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — writers and professionals who need local voice input without cloud uploads.
Developers & tinkers — technical users who want to fork and extend custom models or workflows.
Cross-platform workers — remote workers on Windows, macOS, or Linux seeking efficient offline dictation.
Accessibility seekers — users needing assistive voice-input tools without paid subscriptions.

zh.tag: 一站式开发环境管理工具
zh.what: mise 是一个开发工具、环境变量和任务运行器的统一 CLI。它通过一个 mise.toml 文件管理项目工具、环境变量和任务，确保新 shell、检出和 CI 作业从相同的设置开始。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、演示 GIF 和配置文件。核心功能包括安装和切换数百种开发工具、按项目目录加载环境变量（包括 .env 文件），以及定义和运行构建、测试、lint 和部署任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态。支持多种后端，如 npm、pip、go 等，用于安装工具。
zh.hot: mise 在 Rust 社区中热度高，今日新增 258 星，总星数达 31926。它解决了开发环境配置的痛点，将多个工具整合为一个 CLI，受到开发者的欢迎。
uses: 开发者：需要管理多个项目工具版本和环境的个人开发者
团队：希望统一开发环境配置，减少新成员上手成本的团队
CI/CD：需要确保 CI 作业与本地环境一致的持续集成场景
多语言开发者：频繁切换 Node、Python、Go 等语言的开发者

en.tag: All-in-one dev environment manager
en.what: mise is a unified CLI for dev tools, environment variables, and task runner. It manages project tools, env vars, and tasks in one mise.toml file, ensuring new shells, checkouts, and CI jobs start from the same setup.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, demo GIFs, and configuration files. Core features include installing and switching between hundreds of dev tools, loading environment variables per project directory (including .env files), and defining and running tasks for building, testing, linting, and deploying.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Supports various backends like npm, pip, go, etc., for installing tools.

Teams: teams wanting to unify dev environment config and reduce onboarding cost

Polyglot developers: those frequently switching between Node, Python, Go, etc.

zh.tag: 零配置终端 IDE，兼具 VS Code 体验与极速性能

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的编程语言，让代理少犯错
zh.what: BAML 是一种专为 AI 代理设计的编程语言，它看起来像 TypeScript，但内置了类型安全、运行时类型、静态错误分析等特性，帮助开发者构建更可靠的代理应用。它提供了代理专用的标准库和测试框架，并支持从多种主流语言调用。

It provides an agent-specific standard library and testing framework, and can be called from multiple mainstream languages.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust implementation of the BAML compiler, command-line tools (baml), IDE plugins, Python package (baml-py), and documentation/examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python bindings (baml-py), and callable from TypeScript, Python, Go, C#, Java, etc.
en.hot: With the surge in AI agent development, BAML offers a more rigorous programming paradigm that addresses common errors in agent development, quickly gaining attention with nearly 9k stars and growing.
uses: AI agent developers who want to build complex agent logic with type safety
Teams needing to call agent functions from multiple languages, as BAML supports interop
Scenarios requiring high reliability, such as automated workflows and intelligent customer service

小型团队：希望自托管部署平台，避免云服务成本。
开发者：想要自动化构建和部署流程，提高效率。

en.tag: Build and deploy software across many servers

zh.tag: 电话号OSINT信息收集框架
zh.what: PhoneInfoga 是一个用于扫描国际电话号码的信息收集框架，可获取国家、地区、运营商和线路类型等基本信息，并利用多种技术尝试查找 VoIP 提供商或识别机主。它通过可配置的扫描器集合工作，旨在辅助调查而非自动化一切。

en.what: PhoneInfoga is an information gathering framework for scanning international phone numbers, providing basic details like country, area, carrier, and line type, and using various techniques to find VoIP providers or identify owners. It works with a collection of configurable scanners to assist investigations, not fully automate them.
en.content: The repository includes a Go-based core framework, CLI, web GUI, and REST API docs, enabling OSINT footprinting via external APIs, phone books, and search engines, plus checks for reputation reports, social media, and disposable numbers.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, offering a REST API and Go modules for programmatic use, with Docker support and Swagger documentation.
en.hot: Despite being unmaintained, its powerful OSINT capabilities and ease of use keep it at 17k+ stars, with 29 new stars today, ranking #14 on Go trending, showing sustained community demand.

Investigative journalists verifying phone-related information
Penetration testers for pre-engagement reconnaissance
General users looking up basic info on unknown numbers

Scenarios needing dynamic route updates, such as frequent scaling or service changes
